verses.textZh: 基督耶稣的仆人保罗，蒙召作使徒，奉派传神的福音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基督耶稣的仆人保罗，蒙召作使徒，奉派传神的福音。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣基督的仆人保罗，奉召为使徒，特派传神的福音。
verses.textEnNiv: Paul, a servant of Christ Jesus, called to be an apostle and set apart for the gospel of God—
verses.textEnEsv: Paul, a servant of Christ Jesus, called to be an apostle, set apart for the gospel of God,
verses.textEnNkjv: Paul, a bondservant of Jesus Christ, called tobe an apostle, separated to the gospel of God
verses.textEnNlt: This letter is from Paul, a slave of Christ Jesus, chosen by God to be an apostle and sent out to preach his Good News.
verses.textEnNasb: Paul, a bond-servant of Christ Jesus, called as an apostle, set apart for the gospel of God,
verses.textEn: Paul, a servant of Christ Jesus, called to be an apostle and set apart for the gospel of God—

verses.textZh: 这福音是神借着众先知在圣经上预先所应许的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这福音是神借着众先知在圣经上预先所应许的，
verses.textZhCuv: 这福音是神从前藉众先知在圣经上所应许的，
verses.textEnNiv: the gospel he promised beforehand through his prophets in the Holy Scriptures
verses.textEnEsv: which he promised beforehand through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,
verses.textEnNkjv: which He promised before through His prophets in the Holy Scriptures,
verses.textEnNlt: God promised this Good News long ago through his prophets in the holy Scriptures.
verses.textEnNasb: which He promised beforehand through His prophets in the holy Scriptures,
verses.textEn: the gospel he promised beforehand through his prophets in the Holy Scriptures

verses.textZh: 就是论到他的儿子我们的主耶稣基督：按肉身说，他是从大卫的后裔生的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是论到他的儿子我们的主耶稣基督：按肉身说，他是从大卫的后裔生的；
verses.textZhCuv: 论到他儿子－我主耶稣基督。按肉体说，是从大卫后裔生的；
verses.textEnNiv: regarding his Son, who as to his earthly life was a descendant of David,
verses.textEnEsv: concerning his Son, who was descended from David according to the flesh
verses.textEnNkjv: concerning His Son Jesus Christ our Lord, who was born of the seed of David according to the flesh,
verses.textEnNlt: The Good News is about his Son. In his earthly life he was born into King David’s family line,
verses.textEnNasb: concerning His Son, who was born of a descendant of David according to the flesh,
verses.textEn: regarding his Son, who as to his earthly life was a descendant of David,

verses.textZh: 按圣洁的灵说，因为从死人中复活，显明他是大有能力的、神的儿子 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 按圣洁的灵说，因为从死人中复活，显明他是大有能力的、神的儿子 。
verses.textZhCuv: 按圣善的灵说，因从死里复活，以大能显明是神的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: and who through the Spirit of holiness was appointed the Son of God in power by his resurrection from the dead: Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: and was declared to be the Son of God in power according to the Spirit of holiness by his resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,
verses.textEnNkjv: and declared tobe the Son of God with power according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead.
verses.textEnNlt: and he was shown to be the Son of God when he was raised from the dead by the power of the Holy Spirit. He is Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: who was declared the Son of God with power according to the Spirit of holiness by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,
verses.textEn: and who through the Spirit of holiness was appointed the Son of God in power by his resurrection from the dead: Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.textZh: 我们从他领受了恩典和使徒的职分，在万族中使人因他的名相信而顺服，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们从他领受了恩典和使徒的职分，在万族中使人因他的名相信而顺服，
verses.textZhCuv: 我们从他受了恩惠并使徒的职分，在万国之中叫人为他的名信服真道；
verses.textEnNiv: Through him we received grace and apostleship to call all the Gentiles to the obedience that comes from faith for his name’s sake.
verses.textEnEsv: through whom we have received grace and apostleship to bring about the obedience of faith for the sake of his name among all the nations,
verses.textEnNkjv: Through Him we have received grace and apostleship for obedience to the faith among all nations for His name,
verses.textEnNlt: Through Christ, God has given us the privilege and authority as apostles to tell Gentiles everywhere what God has done for them, so that they will believe and obey him, bringing glory to his name.
verses.textEnNasb: through whom we have received grace and apostleship to bring about the obedience of faith among all the Gentiles in behalf of His name,
verses.textEn: Through him we received grace and apostleship to call all the Gentiles to the obedience that comes from faith for his name’s sake.

verses.textZh: 其中也有你们这蒙耶稣基督所召的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其中也有你们这蒙耶稣基督所召的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 其中也有你们这蒙召属耶稣基督的人。
verses.textEnNiv: And you also are among those Gentiles who are called to belong to Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: including you who are called to belong to Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnNkjv: among whom you also are the called of Jesus Christ;
verses.textEnNlt: And you are included among those Gentiles who have been called to belong to Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: among whom you also are the called of Jesus Christ;
verses.textEn: And you also are among those Gentiles who are called to belong to Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 我写信给各位住在罗马，为神所爱，蒙召为圣徒的人。愿恩惠平安从我们的父神和主耶稣基督临到你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我写信给各位住在罗马，为神所爱，蒙召为圣徒的人。愿恩惠平安从我们的父神和主耶稣基督临到你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我写信给你们在罗马、为神所爱、奉召作圣徒的众人。愿恩惠、平安从我们的父神并主耶稣基督归与你们！
verses.textEnNiv: To all in Rome who are loved by God and called to be his holy people: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: To all those in Rome who are loved by God and called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: To all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called tobe saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: I am writing to all of you in Rome who are loved by God and are called to be his own holy people. May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.
verses.textEnNasb: to all who are beloved of God in Rome, called as saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: To all in Rome who are loved by God and called to be his holy people: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 首先，我靠着耶稣基督，为你们大家感谢我的神，因为你们的信心传遍天下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 首先，我靠着耶稣基督，为你们大家感谢我的神，因为你们的信心传遍天下。
verses.textZhCuv: 第一，我靠着耶稣基督，为你们众人感谢我的神，因你们的信德传遍了天下。
verses.textEnNiv: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, because your faith is being reported all over the world.
verses.textEnEsv: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, because your faith is proclaimed in all the world.
verses.textEnNkjv: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.
verses.textEnNlt: Let me say first that I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, because your faith in him is being talked about all over the world.
verses.textEnNasb: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, because your faith is being proclaimed throughout the world.
verses.textEn: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, because your faith is being reported all over the world.

verses.textZh: 我在传扬他儿子福音的事上，用心灵事奉的神，可以作证我是怎样不断地记念你们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在传扬他儿子福音的事上，用心灵事奉的神，可以作证我是怎样不断地记念你们，
verses.textZhCuv: 我在他儿子福音上，用心灵所事奉的神可以见证，我怎样不住地提到你们；
verses.textEnNiv: God, whom I serve in my spirit in preaching the gospel of his Son, is my witness how constantly I remember you
verses.textEnEsv: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I mention you
verses.textEnNkjv: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of His Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers,
verses.textEnNlt: God knows how often I pray for you. Day and night I bring you and your needs in prayer to God, whom I serve with all my heart by spreading the Good News about his Son.
verses.textEnNasb: For God, whom I serve in my spirit in the preaching of the gospel of His Son, is my witness as to how unceasingly I make mention of you,
verses.textEn: God, whom I serve in my spirit in preaching the gospel of his Son, is my witness how constantly I remember you

verses.textZh: 常常在祷告中恳切祈求，也许我可以照着他的旨意，终于能够顺利地到你们那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 常常在祷告中恳切祈求，也许我可以照着他的旨意，终于能够顺利地到你们那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 在祷告之间常常恳求，或者照神的旨意，终能得平坦的道路往你们那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: in my prayers at all times; and I pray that now at last by God’s will the way may be opened for me to come to you.
verses.textEnEsv: always in my prayers, asking that somehow by God’s will I may now at last succeed in coming to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: making request if, by some means, now at last I may find a way in the will of God to come to you.
verses.textEnNlt: One of the things I always pray for is the opportunity, God willing, to come at last to see you.
verses.textEnNasb: always in my prayers requesting if perhaps now, at last by the will of God, I will succeed in coming to you.
verses.textEn: in my prayers at all times; and I pray that now at last by God’s will the way may be opened for me to come to you.

verses.textZh: 因为我很想见你们，好把一些属灵的恩赐分给你们，使你们可以坚定；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我很想见你们，好把一些属灵的恩赐分给你们，使你们可以坚定；
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我切切地想见你们，要把些属灵的恩赐分给你们，使你们可以坚固；
verses.textEnNiv: I long to see you so that I may impart to you some spiritual gift to make you strong—
verses.textEnEsv: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift to strengthen you—
verses.textEnNkjv: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, so that you may be established—
verses.textEnNlt: For I long to visit you so I can bring you some spiritual gift that will help you grow strong in the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: For I long to see you so that I may impart some spiritual gift to you, that you may be established;
verses.textEn: I long to see you so that I may impart to you some spiritual gift to make you strong—

verses.textZh: 也使我在你们中间，借着你我彼此的信心，大家一同得到安慰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也使我在你们中间，借着你我彼此的信心，大家一同得到安慰。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，我在你们中间，因你与我彼此的信心，就可以同得安慰。
verses.textEnNiv: that is, that you and I may be mutually encouraged by each other’s faith.
verses.textEnEsv: that is, that we may be mutually encouraged by each other’s faith, both yours and mine.
verses.textEnNkjv: that is, that I may be encouraged together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.
verses.textEnNlt: When we get together, I want to encourage you in your faith, but I also want to be encouraged by yours.
verses.textEnNasb: that is, that I may be encouraged together with you while among you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.
verses.textEn: that is, that you and I may be mutually encouraged by each other’s faith.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我不愿意你们不知道，我好几次预先定好了要到你们那里去，为了要在你们中间也得一些果子，像在其他的民族中间一样，可是直到现在还有阻碍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我不愿意你们不知道，我好几次预先定好了要到你们那里去，为了要在你们中间也得一些果子，像在其他的民族中间一样，可是直到现在还有阻碍。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我不愿意你们不知道，我屡次定意往你们那里去，要在你们中间得些果子，如同在其余的外邦人中一样；只是到如今仍有阻隔。
verses.textEnNiv: I do not want you to be unaware, brothers and sisters, that I planned many times to come to you (but have been prevented from doing so until now) in order that I might have a harvest among you, just as I have had among the other Gentiles.
verses.textEnEsv: I do not want you to be unaware, brothers, that I have often intended to come to you (but thus far have been prevented), in order that I may reap some harvest among you as well as among the rest of the Gentiles.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I do not want you to be unaware, brethren, that I often planned to come to you (but was hindered until now), that I might have some fruit among you also, just as among the other Gentiles.
verses.textEnNlt: I want you to know, dear brothers and sisters, that I planned many times to visit you, but I was prevented until now. I want to work among you and see spiritual fruit, just as I have seen among other Gentiles.
verses.textEnNasb: I do not want you to be unaware, brothers and sisters, that often I have planned to come to you (and have been prevented so far) so that I may obtain some fruit among you also just as among the rest of the Gentiles.
verses.textEn: I do not want you to be unaware, brothers and sisters, that I planned many times to come to you (but have been prevented from doing so until now) in order that I might have a harvest among you, just as I have had among the other Gentiles.

verses.textZh: 无论是希腊人或是未开化的人，聪明的人或是愚笨的人，我都欠他们的债。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论是希腊人或是未开化的人，聪明的人或是愚笨的人，我都欠他们的债。
verses.textZhCuv: 无论是希腊人、化外人、聪明人、愚拙人，我都欠他们的债，
verses.textEnNiv: I am obligated both to Greeks and non-Greeks, both to the wise and the foolish.
verses.textEnEsv: I am under obligation both to Greeks and to barbarians, both to the wise and to the foolish.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am a debtor both to Greeks and to barbarians, both to wise and to unwise.
verses.textEnNlt: For I have a great sense of obligation to people in both the civilized world and the rest of the world, to the educated and uneducated alike.
verses.textEnNasb: I am under obligation both to Greeks and to the uncultured, both to the wise and to the foolish.
verses.textEn: I am obligated both to Greeks and non-Greeks, both to the wise and the foolish.

verses.textZh: 所以，对我来说，我随时都愿意把福音也传给你们在罗马的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，对我来说，我随时都愿意把福音也传给你们在罗马的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以情愿尽我的力量，将福音也传给你们在罗马的人。
verses.textEnNiv: That is why I am so eager to preach the gospel also to you who are in Rome.
verses.textEnEsv: So I am eager to preach the gospel to you also who are in Rome.
verses.textEnNkjv: So, as much as is in me, Iam ready to preach the gospel to you who are in Rome also.
verses.textEnNlt: So I am eager to come to you in Rome, too, to preach the Good News.
verses.textEnNasb: So, for my part, I am eager to preach the gospel to you also who are in Rome.
verses.textEn: That is why I am so eager to preach the gospel also to you who are in Rome.

verses.textZh: 我不以福音为耻；这福音是神的大能，要救所有相信的，先是犹太人，后是希腊人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我不以福音为耻；这福音是神的大能，要救所有相信的，先是犹太人，后是希腊人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我不以福音为耻；这福音本是神的大能，要救一切相信的，先是犹太人，后是希腊人。
verses.textEnNiv: For I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God that brings salvation to everyone who believes: first to the Jew, then to the Gentile.
verses.textEnEsv: For I am not ashamed of the gospel, for it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes, to the Jew first and also to the Greek.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ, for it is the power of God to salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first and also for the Greek.
verses.textEnNlt: For I am not ashamed of this Good News about Christ. It is the power of God at work, saving everyone who believes—the Jew first and also the Gentile.
verses.textEnNasb: For I am not ashamed of the gospel, for it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes, to the Jew first and also to the Greek.
verses.textEn: For I am not ashamed of the gospel, because it is the power of God that brings salvation to everyone who believes: first to the Jew, then to the Gentile.

verses.textZh: 神的义就是借着这福音显明出来，本于信而归于信，正如经上所记："义人必因信得生。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的义就是借着这福音显明出来，本于信而归于信，正如经上所记："义人必因信得生。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为神的义正在这福音上显明出来；这义是本于信，以至于信。如经上所记：「义人必因信得生。」
verses.textEnNiv: For in the gospel the righteousness of God is revealed—a righteousness that is by faith from first to last, just as it is written: "The righteous will live by faith."
verses.textEnEsv: For in it the righteousness of God is revealed from faith for faith, as it is written, "The righteous shall live by faith."
verses.textEnNkjv: For in it the righteousness of God is revealed from faith to faith; as it is written, "The just shall live by faith."
verses.textEnNlt: This Good News tells us how God makes us right in his sight. This is accomplished from start to finish by faith. As the Scriptures say, "It is through faith that a righteous person has life."
verses.textEnNasb: For in it the righteousness of God is revealed from faith to faith; as it is written: " But the righteous one will live by faith."
verses.textEn: For in the gospel the righteousness of God is revealed—a righteousness that is by faith from first to last, just as it is written: "The righteous will live by faith."

verses.textZh: 神的震怒，从天上向所有不虔不义的人显露出来，就是向那些以不义压制真理的人显露出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的震怒，从天上向所有不虔不义的人显露出来，就是向那些以不义压制真理的人显露出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来，神的忿怒从天上显明在一切不虔不义的人身上，就是那些行不义阻挡真理的人。
verses.textEnNiv: The wrath of God is being revealed from heaven against all the godlessness and wickedness of people, who suppress the truth by their wickedness,
verses.textEnEsv: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who by their unrighteousness suppress the truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,
verses.textEnNlt: But God shows his anger from heaven against all sinful, wicked people who suppress the truth by their wickedness.
verses.textEnNasb: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of people who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,
verses.textEn: The wrath of God is being revealed from heaven against all the godlessness and wickedness of people, who suppress the truth by their wickedness,

verses.textZh: 神的事情，人所能知道的，在他们里面原是明显的，因为神已经向他们显明了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的事情，人所能知道的，在他们里面原是明显的，因为神已经向他们显明了。
verses.textZhCuv: 神的事情，人所能知道的，原显明在人心里，因为神已经给他们显明。
verses.textEnNiv: since what may be known about God is plain to them, because God has made it plain to them.
verses.textEnEsv: For what can be known about God is plain to them, because God has shown it to them.
verses.textEnNkjv: because what may be known of God is manifest in them, for God has shown it to them.
verses.textEnNlt: They know the truth about God because he has made it obvious to them.
verses.textEnNasb: because that which is known about God is evident within them; for God made it evident to them.
verses.textEn: since what may be known about God is plain to them, because God has made it plain to them.

verses.textZh: 其实自从创世以来，神那看不见的事，就如他永恒的大能和神性，都是看得见的，就是从他所造的万物中可以领悟，叫人没有办法推诿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 其实自从创世以来，神那看不见的事，就如他永恒的大能和神性，都是看得见的，就是从他所造的万物中可以领悟，叫人没有办法推诿。
verses.textZhCuv: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但藉着所造之物就可以晓得，叫人无可推诿。
verses.textEnNiv: For since the creation of the world God’s invisible qualities—his eternal power and divine nature—have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made, so that people are without excuse.
verses.textEnEsv: For his invisible attributes, namely, his eternal power and divine nature, have been clearly perceived, ever since the creation of the world, in the things that have been made. So they are without excuse.
verses.textEnNkjv: For since the creation of the world His invisible attributes are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even His eternal power and Godhead, so that they are without excuse,
verses.textEnNlt: For ever since the world was created, people have seen the earth and sky. Through everything God made, they can clearly see his invisible qualities—his eternal power and divine nature. So they have no excuse for not knowing God.
verses.textEnNasb: For since the creation of the world His invisible attributes, that is, His eternal power and divine nature, have been clearly perceived, being understood by what has been made, so that they are without excuse.
verses.textEn: For since the creation of the world God’s invisible qualities—his eternal power and divine nature—have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made, so that people are without excuse.

verses.textZh: 因为他们虽然知道神，却不尊他为神，也不感谢他，反而心思变为虚妄，愚顽的心就迷糊了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他们虽然知道神，却不尊他为神，也不感谢他，反而心思变为虚妄，愚顽的心就迷糊了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，他们虽然知道神，却不当作神荣耀他，也不感谢他。他们的思念变为虚妄，无知的心就昏暗了。
verses.textEnNiv: For although they knew God, they neither glorified him as God nor gave thanks to him, but their thinking became futile and their foolish hearts were darkened.
verses.textEnEsv: For although they knew God, they did not honor him as God or give thanks to him, but they became futile in their thinking, and their foolish hearts were darkened.
verses.textEnNkjv: because, although they knew God, they did not glorify Him as God, nor were thankful, but became futile in their thoughts, and their foolish hearts were darkened.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, they knew God, but they wouldn’t worship him as God or even give him thanks. And they began to think up foolish ideas of what God was like. As a result, their minds became dark and confused.
verses.textEnNasb: For even though they knew God, they did not honor Him as God or give thanks, but they became futile in their reasonings, and their senseless hearts were darkened.
verses.textEn: For although they knew God, they neither glorified him as God nor gave thanks to him, but their thinking became futile and their foolish hearts were darkened.

verses.textZh: 他们自以为是聪明的，却成了愚蠢的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们自以为是聪明的，却成了愚蠢的。
verses.textZhCuv: 自称为聪明，反成了愚拙，
verses.textEnNiv: Although they claimed to be wise, they became fools
verses.textEnEsv: Claiming to be wise, they became fools,
verses.textEnNkjv: Professing to be wise, they became fools,
verses.textEnNlt: Claiming to be wise, they instead became utter fools.
verses.textEnNasb: Claiming to be wise, they became fools,
verses.textEn: Although they claimed to be wise, they became fools

verses.textZh: 他们用必朽坏的人、飞禽、走兽和昆虫的形象，取代了永不朽坏的神的荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们用必朽坏的人、飞禽、走兽和昆虫的形象，取代了永不朽坏的神的荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 将不能朽坏之神的荣耀变为偶像，仿佛必朽坏的人和飞禽、走兽、昆虫的样式。
verses.textEnNiv: and exchanged the glory of the immortal God for images made to look like a mortal human being and birds and animals and reptiles.
verses.textEnEsv: and exchanged the glory of the immortal God for images resembling mortal man and birds and animals and creeping things.
verses.textEnNkjv: and changed the glory of the incorruptible God into an image made like corruptible man—and birds and four-footed animals and creeping things.
verses.textEnNlt: And instead of worshiping the glorious, ever-living God, they worshiped idols made to look like mere people and birds and animals and reptiles.
verses.textEnNasb: and they exchanged the glory of the incorruptible God for an image in the form of corruptible mankind, of birds, four-footed animals, and crawling creatures.
verses.textEn: and exchanged the glory of the immortal God for images made to look like a mortal human being and birds and animals and reptiles.

verses.textZh: 因此，神就任凭他们顺着心中的私欲去作污秽的事，以致羞辱自己的身体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，神就任凭他们顺着心中的私欲去作污秽的事，以致羞辱自己的身体。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，神任凭他们逞着心里的情欲行污秽的事，以致彼此玷辱自己的身体。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore God gave them over in the sinful desires of their hearts to sexual impurity for the degrading of their bodies with one another.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore God gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to impurity, to the dishonoring of their bodies among themselves,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore God also gave them up to uncleanness, in the lusts of their hearts, to dishonor their bodies among themselves,
verses.textEnNlt: So God abandoned them to do whatever shameful things their hearts desired. As a result, they did vile and degrading things with each other’s bodies.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore God gave them up to vile impurity in the lusts of their hearts, so that their bodies would be dishonored among them.
verses.textEn: Therefore God gave them over in the sinful desires of their hearts to sexual impurity for the degrading of their bodies with one another.

verses.textZh: 他们用虚谎取代了神的真理，敬拜事奉受造之物，却不敬拜事奉造物的主。他是永远可称颂的，阿们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们用虚谎取代了神的真理，敬拜事奉受造之物，却不敬拜事奉造物的主。他是永远可称颂的，阿们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们将神的真实变为虚谎，去敬拜事奉受造之物，不敬奉那造物的主－主乃是可称颂的，直到永远。阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: They exchanged the truth about God for a lie, and worshiped and served created things rather than the Creator—who is forever praised. Amen.
verses.textEnEsv: because they exchanged the truth about God for a lie and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever! Amen.
verses.textEnNkjv: who exchanged the truth of God for the lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: They traded the truth about God for a lie. So they worshiped and served the things God created instead of the Creator himself, who is worthy of eternal praise! Amen.
verses.textEnNasb: For they exchanged the truth of God for falsehood, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.
verses.textEn: They exchanged the truth about God for a lie, and worshiped and served created things rather than the Creator—who is forever praised. Amen.

verses.textZh: 因此，神就任凭他们放纵可耻的情欲：他们的女人把原来的性的功能，变成违反自然的功能；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，神就任凭他们放纵可耻的情欲：他们的女人把原来的性的功能，变成违反自然的功能；
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，神任凭他们放纵可羞耻的情欲。他们的女人把顺性的用处变为逆性的用处；
verses.textEnNiv: Because of this, God gave them over to shameful lusts. Even their women exchanged natural sexual relations for unnatural ones.
verses.textEnEsv: For this reason God gave them up to dishonorable passions. For their women exchanged natural relations for those that are contrary to nature;
verses.textEnNkjv: For this reason God gave them up to vile passions. For even their women exchanged the natural use for what is against nature.
verses.textEnNlt: That is why God abandoned them to their shameful desires. Even the women turned against the natural way to have sex and instead indulged in sex with each other.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason God gave them over to degrading passions; for their women exchanged natural relations for that which is contrary to nature,
verses.textEn: Because of this, God gave them over to shameful lusts. Even their women exchanged natural sexual relations for unnatural ones.

verses.textZh: 同样地，男人也舍弃了女人原来的性功能，彼此欲火攻心，男人与男人作出可耻的事。他们这样妄为，就在自己身上受到应该受的报应。
verses.textZhCnvs: 同样地，男人也舍弃了女人原来的性功能，彼此欲火攻心，男人与男人作出可耻的事。他们这样妄为，就在自己身上受到应该受的报应。
verses.textZhCuv: 男人也是如此，弃了女人顺性的用处，欲火攻心，彼此贪恋，男和男行可羞耻的事，就在自己身上受这妄为当得的报应。
verses.textEnNiv: In the same way the men also abandoned natural relations with women and were inflamed with lust for one another. Men committed shameful acts with other men, and received in themselves the due penalty for their error.
verses.textEnEsv: and the men likewise gave up natural relations with women and were consumed with passion for one another, men committing shameless acts with men and receiving in themselves the due penalty for their error.
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust for one another, men with men committing what is shameful, and receiving in themselves the penalty of their error which was due.
verses.textEnNlt: And the men, instead of having normal sexual relations with women, burned with lust for each other. Men did shameful things with other men, and as a result of this sin, they suffered within themselves the penalty they deserved.
verses.textEnNasb: and likewise the men, too, abandoned natural relations with women and burned in their desire toward one another, males with males committing shameful acts and receiving in their own persons the due penalty of their error.
verses.textEn: In the same way the men also abandoned natural relations with women and were inflamed with lust for one another. Men committed shameful acts with other men, and received in themselves the due penalty for their error.

verses.textZh: 他们既然故意不认识神，神就任凭他们存着败坏的心，去作那些不正当的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们既然故意不认识神，神就任凭他们存着败坏的心，去作那些不正当的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们既然故意不认识神，神就任凭他们存邪僻的心，行那些不合理的事；
verses.textEnNiv: Furthermore, just as they did not think it worthwhile to retain the knowledge of God, so God gave them over to a depraved mind, so that they do what ought not to be done.
verses.textEnEsv: And since they did not see fit to acknowledge God, God gave them up to a debased mind to do what ought not to be done.
verses.textEnNkjv: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a debased mind, to do those things which are not fitting;
verses.textEnNlt: Since they thought it foolish to acknowledge God, he abandoned them to their foolish thinking and let them do things that should never be done.
verses.textEnNasb: And just as they did not see fit to acknowledge God, God gave them up to a depraved mind, to do those things that are not proper,
verses.textEn: Furthermore, just as they did not think it worthwhile to retain the knowledge of God, so God gave them over to a depraved mind, so that they do what ought not to be done.

verses.textZh: 这些人充满了各样的不义、邪恶、贪心、阴险；满怀嫉妒、凶杀、好斗、欺诈、幸灾乐祸；又是好说谗言的、
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些人充满了各样的不义、邪恶、贪心、阴险；满怀嫉妒、凶杀、好斗、欺诈、幸灾乐祸；又是好说谗言的、
verses.textZhCuv: 装满了各样不义、邪恶、贪婪、恶毒 ；满心是嫉妒、凶杀、争竞、诡诈、毒恨；
verses.textEnNiv: They have become filled with every kind of wickedness, evil, greed and depravity. They are full of envy, murder, strife, deceit and malice. They are gossips,
verses.textEnEsv: They were filled with all manner of unrighteousness, evil, covetousness, malice. They are full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, maliciousness. They are gossips,
verses.textEnNkjv: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil-mindedness; theyare whisperers,
verses.textEnNlt: Their lives became full of every kind of wickedness, sin, greed, hate, envy, murder, quarreling, deception, malicious behavior, and gossip.
verses.textEnNasb: people having been filled with all unrighteousness, wickedness, greed, and evil; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, and malice; they are gossips,
verses.textEn: They have become filled with every kind of wickedness, evil, greed and depravity. They are full of envy, murder, strife, deceit and malice. They are gossips,

verses.textZh: 毁谤人的、憎恨神的、凌辱人的、傲慢的、自夸的、制造恶事的、忤逆父母的、
verses.textZhCnvs: 毁谤人的、憎恨神的、凌辱人的、傲慢的、自夸的、制造恶事的、忤逆父母的、
verses.textZhCuv: 又是谗毁的、背后说人的、怨恨神的 、侮慢人的、狂傲的、自夸的、捏造恶事的、违背父母的、
verses.textEnNiv: slanderers, God-haters, insolent, arrogant and boastful; they invent ways of doing evil; they disobey their parents;
verses.textEnEsv: slanderers, haters of God, insolent, haughty, boastful, inventors of evil, disobedient to parents,
verses.textEnNkjv: backbiters, haters of God, violent, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
verses.textEnNlt: They are backstabbers, haters of God, insolent, proud, and boastful. They invent new ways of sinning, and they disobey their parents.
verses.textEnNasb: slanderers, haters of God, insolent, arrogant, boastful, inventors of evil, disobedient to parents,
verses.textEn: slanderers, God-haters, insolent, arrogant and boastful; they invent ways of doing evil; they disobey their parents;

verses.textZh: 冥顽不灵的、不守信用的、冷酷无情的、没有恻隐之心的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 冥顽不灵的、不守信用的、冷酷无情的、没有恻隐之心的。
verses.textZhCuv: 无知的、背约的、无亲情的、不怜悯人的。
verses.textEnNiv: they have no understanding, no fidelity, no love, no mercy.
verses.textEnEsv: foolish, faithless, heartless, ruthless.
verses.textEnNkjv: undiscerning, untrustworthy, unloving, unforgiving, unmerciful;
verses.textEnNlt: They refuse to understand, break their promises, are heartless, and have no mercy.
verses.textEnNasb: without understanding, untrustworthy, unfeeling, and unmerciful;
verses.textEn: they have no understanding, no fidelity, no love, no mercy.

verses.textZh: 他们虽然明明知道行这些事的人，神判定他们是该死的，然而他们不单自己去行，也喜欢别人去行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们虽然明明知道行这些事的人，神判定他们是该死的，然而他们不单自己去行，也喜欢别人去行。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们虽知道神判定行这样事的人是当死的，然而他们不但自己去行，还喜欢别人去行。
verses.textEnNiv: Although they know God’s righteous decree that those who do such things deserve death, they not only continue to do these very things but also approve of those who practice them.
verses.textEnEsv: Though they know God’s righteous decree that those who practice such things deserve to die, they not only do them but give approval to those who practice them.
verses.textEnNkjv: who, knowing the righteous judgment of God, that those who practice such things are deserving of death, not only do the same but also approve of those who practice them.
verses.textEnNlt: They know God’s justice requires that those who do these things deserve to die, yet they do them anyway. Worse yet, they encourage others to do them, too.
verses.textEnNasb: and although they know the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, they not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.
verses.textEn: Although they know God’s righteous decree that those who do such things deserve death, they not only continue to do these very things but also approve of those who practice them.

verses.textZh: 你这判断人的啊！无论你是谁，都没有办法推诿。你在甚么事上判断人，就在甚么事上定自己的罪；因为你所作的，正是你所判断的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这判断人的啊！无论你是谁，都没有办法推诿。你在甚么事上判断人，就在甚么事上定自己的罪；因为你所作的，正是你所判断的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 你这论断人的，无论你是谁，也无可推诿。你在什么事上论断人，就在什么事上定自己的罪；因你这论断人的，自己所行却和别人一样。
verses.textEnNiv: You, therefore, have no excuse, you who pass judgment on someone else, for at whatever point you judge another, you are condemning yourself, because you who pass judgment do the same things.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore you have no excuse, O man, every one of you who judges. For in passing judgment on another you condemn yourself, because you, the judge, practice the very same things.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore you are inexcusable, O man, whoever you are who judge, for in whatever you judge another you condemn yourself; for you who judge practice the same things.
verses.textEnNlt: You may think you can condemn such people, but you are just as bad, and you have no excuse! When you say they are wicked and should be punished, you are condemning yourself, for you who judge others do these very same things.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore you have no excuse, you foolish person, everyone of you who passes judgment; for in that matter in which you judge someone else, you condemn yourself; for you who judge practice the same things.
verses.textEn: You, therefore, have no excuse, you who pass judgment on someone else, for at whatever point you judge another, you are condemning yourself, because you who pass judgment do the same things.

verses.textZh: 我们知道，神必照着真理审判行这些事的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们知道，神必照着真理审判行这些事的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们知道这样行的人，神必照真理审判他。
verses.textEnNiv: Now we know that God’s judgment against those who do such things is based on truth.
verses.textEnEsv: We know that the judgment of God rightly falls on those who practice such things.
verses.textEnNkjv: But we know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.
verses.textEnNlt: And we know that God, in his justice, will punish anyone who does such things.
verses.textEnNasb: And we know that the judgment of God rightly falls upon those who practice such things.
verses.textEn: Now we know that God’s judgment against those who do such things is based on truth.

verses.textZh: 你这个人，你判断行这些事的人，自己所行的却是一样，你以为能逃脱神的审判吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这个人，你判断行这些事的人，自己所行的却是一样，你以为能逃脱神的审判吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你这人哪，你论断行这样事的人，自己所行的却和别人一样，你以为能逃脱神的审判吗？
verses.textEnNiv: So when you, a mere human being, pass judgment on them and yet do the same things, do you think you will escape God’s judgment?
verses.textEnEsv: Do you suppose, O man—you who judge those who practice such things and yet do them yourself—that you will escape the judgment of God?
verses.textEnNkjv: And do you think this, O man, you who judge those practicing such things, and doing the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?
verses.textEnNlt: Since you judge others for doing these things, why do you think you can avoid God’s judgment when you do the same things?
verses.textEnNasb: But do you suppose this, you foolish person who passes judgment on those who practice such things, and yet does them as well, that you will escape the judgment of God?
verses.textEn: So when you, a mere human being, pass judgment on them and yet do the same things, do you think you will escape God’s judgment?

verses.textZh: 还是你藐视神丰富的恩慈、宽容和忍耐，不晓得他的恩慈是要领你悔改的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 还是你藐视神丰富的恩慈、宽容和忍耐，不晓得他的恩慈是要领你悔改的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 还是你藐视他丰富的恩慈、宽容、忍耐，不晓得他的恩慈是领你悔改呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Or do you show contempt for the riches of his kindness, forbearance and patience, not realizing that God’s kindness is intended to lead you to repentance?
verses.textEnEsv: Or do you presume on the riches of his kindness and forbearance and patience, not knowing that God’s kindness is meant to lead you to repentance?
verses.textEnNkjv: Or do you despise the riches of His goodness, forbearance, and longsuffering, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you see how wonderfully kind, tolerant, and patient God is with you? Does this mean nothing to you? Can’t you see that his kindness is intended to turn you from your sin?
verses.textEnNasb: Or do you think lightly of the riches of His kindness and restraint and patience, not knowing that the kindness of God leads you to repentance?
verses.textEn: Or do you show contempt for the riches of his kindness, forbearance and patience, not realizing that God’s kindness is intended to lead you to repentance?

verses.textZh: 可是你一直硬着心肠，不肯悔改，为自己积蓄神的忿怒，就是他彰显公义审判的那天所要发的忿怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是你一直硬着心肠，不肯悔改，为自己积蓄神的忿怒，就是他彰显公义审判的那天所要发的忿怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 你竟任着你刚硬不悔改的心，为自己积蓄忿怒，以致神震怒，显他公义审判的日子来到。
verses.textEnNiv: But because of your stubbornness and your unrepentant heart, you are storing up wrath against yourself for the day of God’s wrath, when his righteous judgment will be revealed.
verses.textEnEsv: But because of your hard and impenitent heart you are storing up wrath for yourself on the day of wrath when God’s righteous judgment will be revealed.
verses.textEnNkjv: But in accordance with your hardness and your impenitent heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God,
verses.textEnNlt: But because you are stubborn and refuse to turn from your sin, you are storing up terrible punishment for yourself. For a day of anger is coming, when God’s righteous judgment will be revealed.
verses.textEnNasb: But because of your stubbornness and unrepentant heart you are storing up wrath for yourself on the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God,
verses.textEn: But because of your stubbornness and your unrepentant heart, you are storing up wrath against yourself for the day of God’s wrath, when his righteous judgment will be revealed.

verses.textZh: 神必照各人所作的报应各人：
verses.textZhCnvs: 神必照各人所作的报应各人：
verses.textZhCuv: 他必照各人的行为报应各人。
verses.textEnNiv: God "will repay each person according to what they have done."
verses.textEnEsv: He will render to each one according to his works:
verses.textEnNkjv: who "will render to each one according to his deeds":
verses.textEnNlt: He will judge everyone according to what they have done.
verses.textEnNasb: who will repay each person according to his deeds:
verses.textEn: God "will repay each person according to what they have done."

verses.textZh: 以永生报答那些耐心行善、寻求荣耀尊贵和不朽的人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 以永生报答那些耐心行善、寻求荣耀尊贵和不朽的人，
verses.textZhCuv: 凡恒心行善、寻求荣耀、尊贵和不能朽坏之福的，就以永生报应他们；
verses.textEnNiv: To those who by persistence in doing good seek glory, honor and immortality, he will give eternal life.
verses.textEnEsv: to those who by patience in well-doing seek for glory and honor and immortality, he will give eternal life;
verses.textEnNkjv: eternal life to those who by patient continuance in doing good seek for glory, honor, and immortality;
verses.textEnNlt: He will give eternal life to those who keep on doing good, seeking after the glory and honor and immortality that God offers.
verses.textEnNasb: to those who by perseverance in doing good seek glory, honor, and immortality, He will give eternal life;
verses.textEn: To those who by persistence in doing good seek glory, honor and immortality, he will give eternal life.

verses.textZh: 却以震怒和愤恨报应那些自私自利、不顺从真理而顺从不义的人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 却以震怒和愤恨报应那些自私自利、不顺从真理而顺从不义的人；
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有结党、不顺从真理、反顺从不义的，就以忿怒、恼恨报应他们；
verses.textEnNiv: But for those who are self-seeking and who reject the truth and follow evil, there will be wrath and anger.
verses.textEnEsv: but for those who are self-seeking and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, there will be wrath and fury.
verses.textEnNkjv: but to those who are self-seeking and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness—indignation and wrath,
verses.textEnNlt: But he will pour out his anger and wrath on those who live for themselves, who refuse to obey the truth and instead live lives of wickedness.
verses.textEnNasb: but to those who are self-serving and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, He will give wrath and indignation.
verses.textEn: But for those who are self-seeking and who reject the truth and follow evil, there will be wrath and anger.

verses.textZh: 把患难和愁苦加给所有作恶的人，先是犹太人，后是希腊人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 把患难和愁苦加给所有作恶的人，先是犹太人，后是希腊人，
verses.textZhCuv: 将患难、困苦加给一切作恶的人，先是犹太人，后是希腊人，
verses.textEnNiv: There will be trouble and distress for every human being who does evil: first for the Jew, then for the Gentile;
verses.textEnEsv: There will be tribulation and distress for every human being who does evil, the Jew first and also the Greek,
verses.textEnNkjv: tribulation and anguish, on every soul of man who does evil, of the Jew first and also of the Greek;
verses.textEnNlt: There will be trouble and calamity for everyone who keeps on doing what is evil—for the Jew first and also for the Gentile.
verses.textEnNasb: There will be tribulation and distress for every soul of mankind who does evil, for the Jew first and also for the Greek,
verses.textEn: There will be trouble and distress for every human being who does evil: first for the Jew, then for the Gentile;

verses.textZh: 却把荣耀、尊贵与平安赐给所有行善的人，先是犹太人，后是希腊人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 却把荣耀、尊贵与平安赐给所有行善的人，先是犹太人，后是希腊人。
verses.textZhCuv: 却将荣耀、尊贵、平安加给一切行善的人，先是犹太人，后是希腊人。
verses.textEnNiv: but glory, honor and peace for everyone who does good: first for the Jew, then for the Gentile.
verses.textEnEsv: but glory and honor and peace for everyone who does good, the Jew first and also the Greek.
verses.textEnNkjv: but glory, honor, and peace to everyone who works what is good, to the Jew first and also to the Greek.
verses.textEnNlt: But there will be glory and honor and peace from God for all who do good—for the Jew first and also for the Gentile.
verses.textEnNasb: but glory, honor, and peace to everyone who does what is good, to the Jew first and also to the Greek.
verses.textEn: but glory, honor and peace for everyone who does good: first for the Jew, then for the Gentile.

verses.textZh: 因为神并不偏待人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神并不偏待人。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为神不偏待人。
verses.textEnNiv: For God does not show favoritism.
verses.textEnEsv: For God shows no partiality.
verses.textEnNkjv: For there is no partiality with God.
verses.textEnNlt: For God does not show favoritism.
verses.textEnNasb: For there is no partiality with God.
verses.textEn: For God does not show favoritism.

verses.textZh: 凡不在律法之下犯了罪的，将不按律法而灭亡；凡在律法之下犯了罪的，将按律法受审判。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡不在律法之下犯了罪的，将不按律法而灭亡；凡在律法之下犯了罪的，将按律法受审判。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡没有律法犯了罪的，也必不按律法灭亡；凡在律法以下犯了罪的，也必按律法受审判。（
verses.textEnNiv: All who sin apart from the law will also perish apart from the law, and all who sin under the law will be judged by the law.
verses.textEnEsv: For all who have sinned without the law will also perish without the law, and all who have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as many as have sinned without law will also perish without law, and as many as have sinned in the law will be judged by the law
verses.textEnNlt: When the Gentiles sin, they will be destroyed, even though they never had God’s written law. And the Jews, who do have God’s law, will be judged by that law when they fail to obey it.
verses.textEnNasb: For all who have sinned without the Law will also perish without the Law, and all who have sinned under the Law will be judged by the Law;
verses.textEn: All who sin apart from the law will also perish apart from the law, and all who sin under the law will be judged by the law.

verses.textZh: 因为在神面前，不是听律法的为义，而是行律法的得称为义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为在神面前，不是听律法的为义，而是行律法的得称为义。
verses.textZhCuv: 原来在神面前，不是听律法的为义，乃是行律法的称义。
verses.textEnNiv: For it is not those who hear the law who are righteous in God’s sight, but it is those who obey the law who will be declared righteous.
verses.textEnEsv: For it is not the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law who will be justified.
verses.textEnNkjv: (for not the hearers of the law are just in the sight of God, but the doers of the law will be justified;
verses.textEnNlt: For merely listening to the law doesn’t make us right with God. It is obeying the law that makes us right in his sight.
verses.textEnNasb: for it is not the hearers of the Law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the Law who will be justified.
verses.textEn: For it is not those who hear the law who are righteous in God’s sight, but it is those who obey the law who will be declared righteous.

verses.textZh: 没有律法的外族人，如果按本性行律法上的事，他们虽然没有律法，自己就是自己的律法；
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有律法的外族人，如果按本性行律法上的事，他们虽然没有律法，自己就是自己的律法；
verses.textZhCuv: 没有律法的外邦人若顺着本性行律法上的事，他们虽然没有律法，自己就是自己的律法。
verses.textEnNiv: (Indeed, when Gentiles, who do not have the law, do by nature things required by the law, they are a law for themselves, even though they do not have the law.
verses.textEnEsv: For when Gentiles, who do not have the law, by nature do what the law requires, they are a law to themselves, even though they do not have the law.
verses.textEnNkjv: for when Gentiles, who do not have the law, by nature do the things in the law, these, although not having the law, are a law to themselves,
verses.textEnNlt: Even Gentiles, who do not have God’s written law, show that they know his law when they instinctively obey it, even without having heard it.
verses.textEnNasb: For when Gentiles who do not have the Law instinctively perform the requirements of the Law, these, though not having the Law, are a law to themselves,
verses.textEn: (Indeed, when Gentiles, who do not have the law, do by nature things required by the law, they are a law for themselves, even though they do not have the law.

verses.textZh: 这就表明律法的作用是刻在他们的心里，有他们的良心一同作证，他们的思想互相较量，或作控告、或作辩护。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就表明律法的作用是刻在他们的心里，有他们的良心一同作证，他们的思想互相较量，或作控告、或作辩护。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是显出律法的功用刻在他们心里，他们是非之心同作见证，并且他们的思念互相较量，或以为是，或以为非。）
verses.textEnNiv: They show that the requirements of the law are written on their hearts, their consciences also bearing witness, and their thoughts sometimes accusing them and at other times even defending them.)
verses.textEnEsv: They show that the work of the law is written on their hearts, while their conscience also bears witness, and their conflicting thoughts accuse or even excuse them
verses.textEnNkjv: who show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and between themselves their thoughts accusing or else excusing them)
verses.textEnNlt: They demonstrate that God’s law is written in their hearts, for their own conscience and thoughts either accuse them or tell them they are doing right.
verses.textEnNasb: in that they show the work of the Law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying and their thoughts alternately accusing or else defending them,
verses.textEn: They show that the requirements of the law are written on their hearts, their consciences also bearing witness, and their thoughts sometimes accusing them and at other times even defending them.)

verses.textZh: 这也要照着我所传的福音，在神借着耶稣基督审判各人隐情的那一天，彰显出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这也要照着我所传的福音，在神借着耶稣基督审判各人隐情的那一天，彰显出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 就在神藉耶稣基督审判人隐秘事的日子，照着我的福音所言。
verses.textEnNiv: This will take place on the day when God judges people’s secrets through Jesus Christ, as my gospel declares.
verses.textEnEsv: on that day when, according to my gospel, God judges the secrets of men by Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ, according to my gospel.
verses.textEnNlt: And this is the message I proclaim—that the day is coming when God, through Christ Jesus, will judge everyone’s secret life.
verses.textEnNasb: on the day when, according to my gospel, God will judge the secrets of mankind through Christ Jesus.
verses.textEn: This will take place on the day when God judges people’s secrets through Jesus Christ, as my gospel declares.

verses.textZh: 你身为犹太人，倚靠律法，仗着神夸口，
verses.textZhCnvs: 你身为犹太人，倚靠律法，仗着神夸口，
verses.textZhCuv: 你称为犹太人，又倚靠律法，且指着神夸口；
verses.textEnNiv: Now you, if you call yourself a Jew; if you rely on the law and boast in God;
verses.textEnEsv: But if you call yourself a Jew and rely on the law and boast in God
verses.textEnNkjv: Indeed you are called a Jew, and rest on the law, and make your boast in God,
verses.textEnNlt: You who call yourselves Jews are relying on God’s law, and you boast about your special relationship with him.
verses.textEnNasb: But if you call yourself a Jew and rely upon the Law and boast in God,
verses.textEn: Now you, if you call yourself a Jew; if you rely on the law and boast in God;

verses.textZh: 而且明白他的旨意，又从律法得了教导，能够辨别甚么是好的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 而且明白他的旨意，又从律法得了教导，能够辨别甚么是好的，
verses.textZhCuv: 既从律法中受了教训，就晓得神的旨意，也能分别是非 ；
verses.textEnNiv: if you know his will and approve of what is superior because you are instructed by the law;
verses.textEnEsv: and know his will and approve what is excellent, because you are instructed from the law;
verses.textEnNkjv: and know His will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,
verses.textEnNlt: You know what he wants; you know what is right because you have been taught his law.
verses.textEnNasb: and know His will and distinguish the things that matter, being instructed from the Law,
verses.textEn: if you know his will and approve of what is superior because you are instructed by the law;

verses.textZh: 自信是瞎子的向导，在黑暗中的人的光，
verses.textZhCnvs: 自信是瞎子的向导，在黑暗中的人的光，
verses.textZhCuv: 又深信自己是给瞎子领路的，是黑暗中人的光，
verses.textEnNiv: if you are convinced that you are a guide for the blind, a light for those who are in the dark,
verses.textEnEsv: and if you are sure that you yourself are a guide to the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,
verses.textEnNkjv: and are confident that you yourself are a guide to the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,
verses.textEnNlt: You are convinced that you are a guide for the blind and a light for people who are lost in darkness.
verses.textEnNasb: and are confident that you yourself are a guide to people who are blind, a light to those in darkness,
verses.textEn: if you are convinced that you are a guide for the blind, a light for those who are in the dark,

verses.textZh: 愚昧人的导师，小孩子的教师，在律法上得了整套的知识和真理；
verses.textZhCnvs: 愚昧人的导师，小孩子的教师，在律法上得了整套的知识和真理；
verses.textZhCuv: 是蠢笨人的师傅，是小孩子的先生，在律法上有知识和真理的模范。
verses.textEnNiv: an instructor of the foolish, a teacher of little children, because you have in the law the embodiment of knowledge and truth—
verses.textEnEsv: an instructor of the foolish, a teacher of children, having in the law the embodiment of knowledge and truth—
verses.textEnNkjv: an instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, having the form of knowledge and truth in the law.
verses.textEnNlt: You think you can instruct the ignorant and teach children the ways of God. For you are certain that God’s law gives you complete knowledge and truth.
verses.textEnNasb: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of the immature, possessing in the Law the embodiment of knowledge and of the truth—
verses.textEn: an instructor of the foolish, a teacher of little children, because you have in the law the embodiment of knowledge and truth—

verses.textZh: 你既然教导别人，难道不教导自己吗？你传讲不可偷窃，自己却偷窃吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你既然教导别人，难道不教导自己吗？你传讲不可偷窃，自己却偷窃吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你既是教导别人，还不教导自己吗？你讲说人不可偷窃，自己还偷窃吗？
verses.textEnNiv: you, then, who teach others, do you not teach yourself? You who preach against stealing, do you steal?
verses.textEnEsv: you then who teach others, do you not teach yourself? While you preach against stealing, do you steal?
verses.textEnNkjv: You, therefore, who teach another, do you not teach yourself? You who preach that a man should not steal, do you steal?
verses.textEnNlt: Well then, if you teach others, why don’t you teach yourself? You tell others not to steal, but do you steal?
verses.textEnNasb: you, therefore, who teach someone else, do you not teach yourself? You who preach that one is not to steal, do you steal?
verses.textEn: you, then, who teach others, do you not teach yourself? You who preach against stealing, do you steal?

verses.textZh: 你说不可奸淫，自己却奸淫吗？你憎恶偶像，自己却劫掠庙宇吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你说不可奸淫，自己却奸淫吗？你憎恶偶像，自己却劫掠庙宇吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你说人不可奸淫，自己还奸淫吗？你厌恶偶像，自己还偷窃庙中之物吗？
verses.textEnNiv: You who say that people should not commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?
verses.textEnEsv: You who say that one must not commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?
verses.textEnNkjv: You who say, "Do not commit adultery," do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?
verses.textEnNlt: You say it is wrong to commit adultery, but do you commit adultery? You condemn idolatry, but do you use items stolen from pagan temples?
verses.textEnNasb: You who say that one is not to commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who loathe idols, do you rob temples?
verses.textEn: You who say that people should not commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?

verses.textZh: 你既然以律法夸口，自己却因犯律法而羞辱神吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你既然以律法夸口，自己却因犯律法而羞辱神吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你指着律法夸口，自己倒犯律法、玷辱神吗？
verses.textEnNiv: You who boast in the law, do you dishonor God by breaking the law?
verses.textEnEsv: You who boast in the law dishonor God by breaking the law.
verses.textEnNkjv: You who make your boast in the law, do you dishonor God through breaking the law?
verses.textEnNlt: You are so proud of knowing the law, but you dishonor God by breaking it.
verses.textEnNasb: You who boast in the Law, through your breaking the Law, do you dishonor God?
verses.textEn: You who boast in the law, do you dishonor God by breaking the law?

verses.textZh: 正如经上所说的："神的名，因你们的缘故在列邦中被亵渎。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 正如经上所说的："神的名，因你们的缘故在列邦中被亵渎。"
verses.textZhCuv: 神的名在外邦人中，因你们受了亵渎，正如经上所记的。
verses.textEnNiv: As it is written: "God’s name is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you."
verses.textEnEsv: For, as it is written, "The name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you."
verses.textEnNkjv: For "the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you," as it is written.
verses.textEnNlt: No wonder the Scriptures say, "The Gentiles blaspheme the name of God because of you."
verses.textEnNasb: For "the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you," just as it is written.
verses.textEn: As it is written: "God’s name is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you."

verses.textZh: 你若遵行律法，割礼固然有益处；但你若是犯律法的，你的割礼就不是割礼了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若遵行律法，割礼固然有益处；但你若是犯律法的，你的割礼就不是割礼了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若是行律法的，割礼固然于你有益；若是犯律法的，你的割礼就算不得割礼。
verses.textEnNiv: Circumcision has value if you observe the law, but if you break the law, you have become as though you had not been circumcised.
verses.textEnEsv: For circumcision indeed is of value if you obey the law, but if you break the law, your circumcision becomes uncircumcision.
verses.textEnNkjv: For circumcision is indeed profitable if you keep the law; but if you are a breaker of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.
verses.textEnNlt: The Jewish ceremony of circumcision has value only if you obey God’s law. But if you don’t obey God’s law, you are no better off than an uncircumcised Gentile.
verses.textEnNasb: For indeed circumcision is of value if you practice the Law; but if you are a violator of the Law, your circumcision has turned into uncircumcision.
verses.textEn: Circumcision has value if you observe the law, but if you break the law, you have become as though you had not been circumcised.

verses.textZh: 这样，没有受割礼的人，如果遵守律法所规定的，他虽然没有受过割礼，不也算是受过割礼的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，没有受割礼的人，如果遵守律法所规定的，他虽然没有受过割礼，不也算是受过割礼的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 所以那未受割礼的，若遵守律法的条例，他虽然未受割礼，岂不算是有割礼吗？
verses.textEnNiv: So then, if those who are not circumcised keep the law’s requirements, will they not be regarded as though they were circumcised?
verses.textEnEsv: So, if a man who is uncircumcised keeps the precepts of the law, will not his uncircumcision be regarded as circumcision?
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, if an uncircumcised man keeps the righteous requirements of the law, will not his uncircumcision be counted as circumcision?
verses.textEnNlt: And if the Gentiles obey God’s law, won’t God declare them to be his own people?
verses.textEnNasb: So if the uncircumcised man keeps the requirements of the Law, will his uncircumcision not be regarded as circumcision?
verses.textEn: So then, if those who are not circumcised keep the law’s requirements, will they not be regarded as though they were circumcised?

verses.textZh: 那本来没有受割礼却遵守律法的人，就要审判你这有仪文和割礼而犯律法的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那本来没有受割礼却遵守律法的人，就要审判你这有仪文和割礼而犯律法的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 而且那本来未受割礼的，若能全守律法，岂不是要审判你这有仪文和割礼竟犯律法的人吗？
verses.textEnNiv: The one who is not circumcised physically and yet obeys the law will condemn you who, even though you have the written code and circumcision, are a lawbreaker.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he who is physically uncircumcised but keeps the law will condemn you who have the written code and circumcision but break the law.
verses.textEnNkjv: And will not the physically uncircumcised, if he fulfills the law, judge you who, even with your written code and circumcision, are a transgressor of the law?
verses.textEnNlt: In fact, uncircumcised Gentiles who keep God’s law will condemn you Jews who are circumcised and possess God’s law but don’t obey it.
verses.textEnNasb: And he who is physically uncircumcised, if he keeps the Law, will he not judge you who though having the letter of the Law and circumcision are a violator of the Law?
verses.textEn: The one who is not circumcised physically and yet obeys the law will condemn you who, even though you have the written code and circumcision, are a lawbreaker.

verses.textZh: 因为表面上作犹太人的并不是犹太人，在肉身上表面的割礼也不是割礼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为表面上作犹太人的并不是犹太人，在肉身上表面的割礼也不是割礼。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为外面作犹太人的，不是真犹太人；外面肉身的割礼，也不是真割礼。
verses.textEnNiv: A person is not a Jew who is one only outwardly, nor is circumcision merely outward and physical.
verses.textEnEsv: For no one is a Jew who is merely one outwardly, nor is circumcision outward and physical.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he is not a Jew who isone outwardly, nor is circumcision that which is outward in the flesh;
verses.textEnNlt: For you are not a true Jew just because you were born of Jewish parents or because you have gone through the ceremony of circumcision.
verses.textEnNasb: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, nor is circumcision that which is outward in the flesh.
verses.textEn: A person is not a Jew who is one only outwardly, nor is circumcision merely outward and physical.

verses.textZh: 唯有在内心作犹太人的才是犹太人；割礼也是心里的，是靠着圣灵而不是靠着仪文。这样的人所受的称赞，不是从人来的，而是从神来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 唯有在内心作犹太人的才是犹太人；割礼也是心里的，是靠着圣灵而不是靠着仪文。这样的人所受的称赞，不是从人来的，而是从神来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有里面作的，才是真犹太人；真割礼也是心里的，在乎灵，不在乎仪文。这人的称赞不是从人来的，乃是从神来的。
verses.textEnNiv: No, a person is a Jew who is one inwardly; and circumcision is circumcision of the heart, by the Spirit, not by the written code. Such a person’s praise is not from other people, but from God.
verses.textEnEsv: But a Jew is one inwardly, and circumcision is a matter of the heart, by the Spirit, not by the letter. His praise is not from man but from God.
verses.textEnNkjv: but heis a Jew who isone inwardly; and circumcision isthat of the heart, in the Spirit, not in the letter; whose praise is not from men but from God.
verses.textEnNlt: No, a true Jew is one whose heart is right with God. And true circumcision is not merely obeying the letter of the law; rather, it is a change of heart produced by the Spirit. And a person with a changed heart seeks praise from God, not from people.
verses.textEnNasb: But he is a Jew who is one inwardly; and circumcision is of the heart, by the Spirit, not by the letter; and his praise is not from people, but from God.
verses.textEn: No, a person is a Jew who is one inwardly; and circumcision is circumcision of the heart, by the Spirit, not by the written code. Such a person’s praise is not from other people, but from God.

verses.textZh: 这样说来，犹太人独特的地方在哪里呢？割礼又有甚么益处呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样说来，犹太人独特的地方在哪里呢？割礼又有甚么益处呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 这样说来，犹太人有什么长处？割礼有什么益处呢？
verses.textEnNiv: What advantage, then, is there in being a Jew, or what value is there in circumcision?
verses.textEnEsv: Then what advantage has the Jew? Or what is the value of circumcision?
verses.textEnNkjv: What advantage then has the Jew, or what is the profit of circumcision?
verses.textEnNlt: Then what’s the advantage of being a Jew? Is there any value in the ceremony of circumcision?
verses.textEnNasb: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the benefit of circumcision?
verses.textEn: What advantage, then, is there in being a Jew, or what value is there in circumcision?

verses.textZh: 从各方面来说，的确很多。最重要的，是神的圣言已经托付了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从各方面来说，的确很多。最重要的，是神的圣言已经托付了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡事大有好处：第一是神的圣言交托他们。
verses.textEnNiv: Much in every way! First of all, the Jews have been entrusted with the very words of God.
verses.textEnEsv: Much in every way. To begin with, the Jews were entrusted with the oracles of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Much in every way! Chiefly because to them were committed the oracles of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, there are great benefits! First of all, the Jews were entrusted with the whole revelation of God.
verses.textEnNasb: Great in every respect. First, that they were entrusted with the actual words of God.
verses.textEn: Much in every way! First of all, the Jews have been entrusted with the very words of God.

verses.textZh: 即使有人不信，又有甚么关系呢？难道他们的不信会使神的信实无效吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 即使有人不信，又有甚么关系呢？难道他们的不信会使神的信实无效吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 即便有不信的，这有何妨呢？难道他们的不信就废掉神的信吗？
verses.textEnNiv: What if some were unfaithful? Will their unfaithfulness nullify God’s faithfulness?
verses.textEnEsv: What if some were unfaithful? Does their faithlessness nullify the faithfulness of God?
verses.textEnNkjv: For what if some did not believe? Will their unbelief make the faithfulness of God without effect?
verses.textEnNlt: True, some of them were unfaithful; but just because they were unfaithful, does that mean God will be unfaithful?
verses.textEnNasb: What then? If some did not believe, their unbelief will not nullify the faithfulness of God, will it?
verses.textEn: What if some were unfaithful? Will their unfaithfulness nullify God’s faithfulness?

verses.textZh: 绝不可能！神总是诚实的，人却是虚谎的，正如经上所记： "你在话语上，显为公义； 你被论断时，必然得胜。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 绝不可能！神总是诚实的，人却是虚谎的，正如经上所记： "你在话语上，显为公义； 你被论断时，必然得胜。"
verses.textZhCuv: 断乎不能！不如说，神是真实的，人都是虚谎的。如经上所记： 你责备人的时候，显为公义； 被人议论的时候，可以得胜。
verses.textEnNiv: Not at all! Let God be true, and every human being a liar. As it is written: "So that you may be proved right when you speak and prevail when you judge."
verses.textEnEsv: By no means! Let God be true though every one were a liar, as it is written, "That you may be justified in your words, and prevail when you are judged."
verses.textEnNkjv: Certainly not! Indeed, let God be true but every man a liar. As it is written: "That You may be justified in Your words, And may overcome when You are judged."
verses.textEnNlt: Of course not! Even if everyone else is a liar, God is true. As the Scriptures say about him, "You will be proved right in what you say, and you will win your case in court."
verses.textEnNasb: Far from it! Rather, God must prove to be true, though every person be found a liar, as it is written: "So that You are justified in Your words, And prevail when You are judged."
verses.textEn: Not at all! Let God be true, and every human being a liar. As it is written: "So that you may be proved right when you speak and prevail when you judge."

verses.textZh: 我且照着人的见解来说，我们的不义若彰显神的义，我们可以说甚么呢？难道降怒的神是不义的吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我且照着人的见解来说，我们的不义若彰显神的义，我们可以说甚么呢？难道降怒的神是不义的吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 我且照着人的常话说，我们的不义若显出神的义来，我们可以怎么说呢？神降怒，是他不义吗？
verses.textEnNiv: But if our unrighteousness brings out God’s righteousness more clearly, what shall we say? That God is unjust in bringing his wrath on us? (I am using a human argument.)
verses.textEnEsv: But if our unrighteousness serves to show the righteousness of God, what shall we say? That God is unrighteous to inflict wrath on us? ( I speak in a human way.)
verses.textEnNkjv: But if our unrighteousness demonstrates the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unjust who inflicts wrath? (I speak as a man.)
verses.textEnNlt: "But," some might say, "our sinfulness serves a good purpose, for it helps people see how righteous God is. Isn’t it unfair, then, for him to punish us?" (This is merely a human point of view.)
verses.textEnNasb: But if our unrighteousness demonstrates the righteousness of God, what shall we say? The God who inflicts wrath is not unrighteous, is He? (I am speaking from a human viewpoint.)
verses.textEn: But if our unrighteousness brings out God’s righteousness more clearly, what shall we say? That God is unjust in bringing his wrath on us? (I am using a human argument.)

verses.textZh: 绝对不是！如果是这样，神怎能审判世界呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 绝对不是！如果是这样，神怎能审判世界呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 断乎不是！若是这样，神怎能审判世界呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Certainly not! If that were so, how could God judge the world?
verses.textEnEsv: By no means! For then how could God judge the world?
verses.textEnNkjv: Certainly not! For then how will God judge the world?
verses.textEnNlt: Of course not! If God were not entirely fair, how would he be qualified to judge the world?
verses.textEnNasb: Far from it! For otherwise, how will God judge the world?
verses.textEn: Certainly not! If that were so, how could God judge the world?

verses.textZh: 但是神的诚实，如果因我的虚谎而更加显出他的荣耀来，为甚么我还要像罪人一样受审判呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是神的诚实，如果因我的虚谎而更加显出他的荣耀来，为甚么我还要像罪人一样受审判呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 若神的真实，因我的虚谎越发显出他的荣耀，为什么我还受审判，好像罪人呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Someone might argue, "If my falsehood enhances God’s truthfulness and so increases his glory, why am I still condemned as a sinner?"
verses.textEnEsv: But if through my lie God’s truth abounds to his glory, why am I still being condemned as a sinner?
verses.textEnNkjv: For if the truth of God has increased through my lie to His glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?
verses.textEnNlt: "But," someone might still argue, "how can God condemn me as a sinner if my dishonesty highlights his truthfulness and brings him more glory?"
verses.textEnNasb: But if through my lie the truth of God abounded to His glory, why am I also still being judged as a sinner?
verses.textEn: Someone might argue, "If my falsehood enhances God’s truthfulness and so increases his glory, why am I still condemned as a sinner?"

verses.textZh: 为甚么不说："我们去作恶以成善吧！" 这种人被定罪是理所当然的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为甚么不说："我们去作恶以成善吧！" 这种人被定罪是理所当然的。
verses.textZhCuv: 为什么不说，我们可以作恶以成善呢？这是毁谤我们的人说我们有这话。这等人定罪是该当的。
verses.textEnNiv: Why not say—as some slanderously claim that we say—"Let us do evil that good may result"? Their condemnation is just!
verses.textEnEsv: And why not do evil that good may come?—as some people slanderously charge us with saying. Their condemnation is just.
verses.textEnNkjv: And why not say, "Let us do evil that good may come"?—as we are slanderously reported and as some affirm that we say. Their condemnation is just.
verses.textEnNlt: And some people even slander us by claiming that we say, "The more we sin, the better it is!" Those who say such things deserve to be condemned.
verses.textEnNasb: And why not say (just as we are slanderously reported and as some claim that we say), "Let’s do evil that good may come of it"? Their condemnation is deserved.
verses.textEn: Why not say—as some slanderously claim that we say—"Let us do evil that good may result"? Their condemnation is just!

verses.textZh: 那又怎么样呢？我们比他们强吗？绝不是的。因为我们已经控诉过，无论是犹太人或是希腊人，都在罪恶之下，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那又怎么样呢？我们比他们强吗？绝不是的。因为我们已经控诉过，无论是犹太人或是希腊人，都在罪恶之下，
verses.textZhCuv: 这却怎么样呢？我们比他们强吗？决不是的！因我们已经证明：犹太人和希腊人都在罪恶之下。
verses.textEnNiv: What shall we conclude then? Do we have any advantage? Not at all! For we have already made the charge that Jews and Gentiles alike are all under the power of sin.
verses.textEnEsv: What then? Are we Jews any better off? No, not at all. For we have already charged that all, both Jews and Greeks, are under sin,
verses.textEnNkjv: What then? Are we better thanthey? Not at all. For we have previously charged both Jews and Greeks that they are all under sin.
verses.textEnNlt: Well then, should we conclude that we Jews are better than others? No, not at all, for we have already shown that all people, whether Jews or Gentiles, are under the power of sin.
verses.textEnNasb: What then? Are we better than they? Not at all; for we have already charged that both Jews and Greeks are all under sin;
verses.textEn: What shall we conclude then? Do we have any advantage? Not at all! For we have already made the charge that Jews and Gentiles alike are all under the power of sin.

verses.textZh: 正如经上所说： "没有义人，连一个也没有，
verses.textZhCnvs: 正如经上所说： "没有义人，连一个也没有，
verses.textZhCuv: 就如经上所记： 没有义人，连一个也没有。
verses.textEnNiv: As it is written: "There is no one righteous, not even one;
verses.textEnEsv: as it is written: "None is righteous, no, not one;
verses.textEnNkjv: As it is written: "There is none righteous, no, not one;
verses.textEnNlt: As the Scriptures say, "No one is righteous— not even one.
verses.textEnNasb: as it is written: "There is no righteous person, not even one;
verses.textEn: As it is written: "There is no one righteous, not even one;

verses.textZh: 没有明白的，没有寻求神的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有明白的，没有寻求神的；
verses.textZhCuv: 没有明白的； 没有寻求神的；
verses.textEnNiv: there is no one who understands; there is no one who seeks God.
verses.textEnEsv: no one understands; no one seeks for God.
verses.textEnNkjv: There is none who understands; There is none who seeks after God.
verses.textEnNlt: No one is truly wise; no one is seeking God.
verses.textEnNasb: There is no one who understands, There is no one who seeks out God;
verses.textEn: there is no one who understands; there is no one who seeks God.

verses.textZh: 人人都偏离了正道，一同变成污秽； 没有行善的，连一个也没有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 人人都偏离了正道，一同变成污秽； 没有行善的，连一个也没有。
verses.textZhCuv: 都是偏离正路， 一同变为无用。 没有行善的，连一个也没有。
verses.textEnNiv: All have turned away, they have together become worthless; there is no one who does good, not even one."
verses.textEnEsv: All have turned aside; together they have become worthless; no one does good, not even one."
verses.textEnNkjv: They have all turned aside; They have together become unprofitable; There is none who does good, no, not one."
verses.textEnNlt: All have turned away; all have become useless. No one does good, not a single one."
verses.textEnNasb: They have all turned aside, together they have become corrupt; There is no one who does good, There is not even one."
verses.textEn: All have turned away, they have together become worthless; there is no one who does good, not even one."

verses.textZh: 他们的喉咙是敞开的坟墓， 他们用舌头弄诡诈， 他们嘴里有虺蛇的毒，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的喉咙是敞开的坟墓， 他们用舌头弄诡诈， 他们嘴里有虺蛇的毒，
verses.textZhCuv: 他们的喉咙是敞开的坟墓； 他们用舌头弄诡诈， 嘴唇里有虺蛇的毒气，
verses.textEnNiv: "Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit." "The poison of vipers is on their lips."
verses.textEnEsv: "Their throat is an open grave; they use their tongues to deceive." "The venom of asps is under their lips."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Their throat is an open tomb; With their tongues they have practiced deceit"; "The poison of asps is under their lips";
verses.textEnNlt: "Their talk is foul, like the stench from an open grave. Their tongues are filled with lies." "Snake venom drips from their lips."
verses.textEnNasb: "Their throat is an open grave, With their tongues they keep deceiving," "The venom of asps is under their lips";
verses.textEn: "Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit." "The poison of vipers is on their lips."

verses.textZh: 满口是咒骂和恶毒；
verses.textZhCnvs: 满口是咒骂和恶毒；
verses.textZhCuv: 满口是咒骂苦毒。
verses.textEnNiv: "Their mouths are full of cursing and bitterness."
verses.textEnEsv: "Their mouth is full of curses and bitterness."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness."
verses.textEnNlt: "Their mouths are full of cursing and bitterness."
verses.textEnNasb: "Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness";
verses.textEn: "Their mouths are full of cursing and bitterness."

verses.textZh: 为了杀人流血，他们的脚步飞快，
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了杀人流血，他们的脚步飞快，
verses.textZhCuv: 杀人流血， 他们的脚飞跑，
verses.textEnNiv: "Their feet are swift to shed blood;
verses.textEnEsv: "Their feet are swift to shed blood;
verses.textEnNkjv: "Their feet are swift to shed blood;
verses.textEnNlt: "They rush to commit murder.
verses.textEnNasb: "Their feet are swift to shed blood,
verses.textEn: "Their feet are swift to shed blood;

verses.textZh: 在经过的路上留下毁灭和悲惨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在经过的路上留下毁灭和悲惨。
verses.textZhCuv: 所经过的路便行残害暴虐的事。
verses.textEnNiv: ruin and misery mark their ways,
verses.textEnEsv: in their paths are ruin and misery,
verses.textEnNkjv: Destruction and misery are in their ways;
verses.textEnNlt: Destruction and misery always follow them.
verses.textEnNasb: Destruction and misery are in their paths,
verses.textEn: ruin and misery mark their ways,

verses.textZh: 和睦之道，他们不晓得，
verses.textZhCnvs: 和睦之道，他们不晓得，
verses.textZhCuv: 平安的路，他们未曾知道；
verses.textEnNiv: and the way of peace they do not know."
verses.textEnEsv: and the way of peace they have not known."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the way of peace they have not known."
verses.textEnNlt: They don’t know where to find peace."
verses.textEnNasb: And they have not known the way of peace."
verses.textEn: and the way of peace they do not know."

verses.textZh: 他们的眼中也不怕神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们的眼中也不怕神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们眼中不怕神。
verses.textEnNiv: "There is no fear of God before their eyes."
verses.textEnEsv: "There is no fear of God before their eyes."
verses.textEnNkjv: "There is no fear of God before their eyes."
verses.textEnNlt: "They have no fear of God at all."
verses.textEnNasb: "There is no fear of God before their eyes."
verses.textEn: "There is no fear of God before their eyes."

verses.textZh: 然而我们晓得，凡律法所说的，都是对在律法之下的人说的，好让每一个人都没有话可讲，使全世界的人都伏在神的审判之下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而我们晓得，凡律法所说的，都是对在律法之下的人说的，好让每一个人都没有话可讲，使全世界的人都伏在神的审判之下。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们晓得律法上的话都是对律法以下之人说的，好塞住各人的口，叫普世的人都伏在神审判之下。
verses.textEnNiv: Now we know that whatever the law says, it says to those who are under the law, so that every mouth may be silenced and the whole world held accountable to God.
verses.textEnEsv: Now we know that whatever the law says it speaks to those who are under the law, so that every mouth may be stopped, and the whole world may be held accountable to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now we know that whatever the law says, it says to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.
verses.textEnNlt: Obviously, the law applies to those to whom it was given, for its purpose is to keep people from having excuses, and to show that the entire world is guilty before God.
verses.textEnNasb: Now we know that whatever the Law says, it speaks to those who are under the Law, so that every mouth may be closed and all the world may become accountable to God;
verses.textEn: Now we know that whatever the law says, it says to those who are under the law, so that every mouth may be silenced and the whole world held accountable to God.

verses.textZh: 没有一个人可以靠行律法，在神面前得称为义，因为借着律法，人对于罪才有充分的认识。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有一个人可以靠行律法，在神面前得称为义，因为借着律法，人对于罪才有充分的认识。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以凡有血气的，没有一个因行律法能在神面前称义，因为律法本是叫人知罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore no one will be declared righteous in God’s sight by the works of the law; rather, through the law we become conscious of our sin.
verses.textEnEsv: For by works of the law no human being will be justified in his sight, since through the law comes knowledge of sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore by the deeds of the law no flesh will be justified in His sight, for by the law is the knowledge of sin.
verses.textEnNlt: For no one can ever be made right with God by doing what the law commands. The law simply shows us how sinful we are.
verses.textEnNasb: because by the works of the Law none of mankind will be justified in His sight; for through the Law comes knowledge of sin.
verses.textEn: Therefore no one will be declared righteous in God’s sight by the works of the law; rather, through the law we become conscious of our sin.

verses.textZh: 现在，有律法和先知的话可以证明：神的义在律法之外已经显明出来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，有律法和先知的话可以证明：神的义在律法之外已经显明出来，
verses.textZhCuv: 但如今，神的义在律法以外已经显明出来，有律法和先知为证：
verses.textEnNiv: But now apart from the law the righteousness of God has been made known, to which the Law and the Prophets testify.
verses.textEnEsv: But now the righteousness of God has been manifested apart from the law, although the Law and the Prophets bear witness to it—
verses.textEnNkjv: But now the righteousness of God apart from the law is revealed, being witnessed by the Law and the Prophets,
verses.textEnNlt: But now God has shown us a way to be made right with him without keeping the requirements of the law, as was promised in the writings of Moses and the prophets long ago.
verses.textEnNasb: But now apart from the Law the righteousness of God has been revealed, being witnessed by the Law and the Prophets,
verses.textEn: But now apart from the law the righteousness of God has been made known, to which the Law and the Prophets testify.

verses.textZh: 就是神的义，因着信耶稣基督，毫无区别地临到所有信的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是神的义，因着信耶稣基督，毫无区别地临到所有信的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是神的义，因信耶稣基督加给一切相信的人，并没有分别。
verses.textEnNiv: This righteousness is given through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe. There is no difference between Jew and Gentile,
verses.textEnEsv: the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ for all who believe. For there is no distinction:
verses.textEnNkjv: even the righteousness of God, through faith in Jesus Christ, to all and on all who believe. For there is no difference;
verses.textEnNlt: We are made right with God by placing our faith in Jesus Christ. And this is true for everyone who believes, no matter who we are.
verses.textEnNasb: but it is the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ for all those who believe; for there is no distinction,
verses.textEn: This righteousness is given through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe. There is no difference between Jew and Gentile,

verses.textZh: 因为人人都犯了罪，亏缺了神的荣耀，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为人人都犯了罪，亏缺了神的荣耀，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为世人都犯了罪，亏缺了神的荣耀；
verses.textEnNiv: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God,
verses.textEnEsv: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God,
verses.textEnNkjv: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God,
verses.textEnNlt: For everyone has sinned; we all fall short of God’s glorious standard.
verses.textEnNasb: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God,
verses.textEn: for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God,

verses.textZh: 但他们却因着神的恩典，借着在基督耶稣里的救赎，就白白地称义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但他们却因着神的恩典，借着在基督耶稣里的救赎，就白白地称义。
verses.textZhCuv: 如今却蒙神的恩典，因基督耶稣的救赎，就白白地称义。
