verses.textEnNiv: and all are justified freely by his grace through the redemption that came by Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: and are justified by his grace as a gift, through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,
verses.textEnNkjv: being justified freely by His grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,
verses.textEnNlt: Yet God, in his grace, freely makes us right in his sight. He did this through Christ Jesus when he freed us from the penalty for our sins.
verses.textEnNasb: being justified as a gift by His grace through the redemption which is in Christ Jesus,
verses.textEn: and all are justified freely by his grace through the redemption that came by Christ Jesus.

verses.textZh: 神设立了耶稣为赎罪祭 ，是凭着他的血，借着人的信，为的是要显明神的义；因为神用忍耐的心宽容了人从前所犯的罪，
verses.textZhCnvs: 神设立了耶稣为赎罪祭 ，是凭着他的血，借着人的信，为的是要显明神的义；因为神用忍耐的心宽容了人从前所犯的罪，
verses.textZhCuv: 神设立耶稣作挽回祭，是凭着耶稣的血，藉着人的信，要显明神的义；因为他用忍耐的心宽容人先时所犯的罪，
verses.textEnNiv: God presented Christ as a sacrifice of atonement, through the shedding of his blood—to be received by faith. He did this to demonstrate his righteousness, because in his forbearance he had left the sins committed beforehand unpunished—
verses.textEnEsv: whom God put forward as a propitiation by his blood, to be received by faith. This was to show God’s righteousness, because in his divine forbearance he had passed over former sins.
verses.textEnNkjv: whom God set forth as a propitiation by His blood, through faith, to demonstrate His righteousness, because in His forbearance God had passed over the sins that were previously committed,
verses.textEnNlt: For God presented Jesus as the sacrifice for sin. People are made right with God when they believe that Jesus sacrificed his life, shedding his blood. This sacrifice shows that God was being fair when he held back and did not punish those who sinned in times past,
verses.textEnNasb: whom God displayed publicly as a propitiation in His blood through faith. This was to demonstrate His righteousness, because in God’s merciful restraint He let the sins previously committed go unpunished;
verses.textEn: God presented Christ as a sacrifice of atonement, through the shedding of his blood—to be received by faith. He did this to demonstrate his righteousness, because in his forbearance he had left the sins committed beforehand unpunished—

verses.textZh: 好在现今显明他的义，使人知道他自己为义，又称信耶稣的人为义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 好在现今显明他的义，使人知道他自己为义，又称信耶稣的人为义。
verses.textZhCuv: 好在今时显明他的义，使人知道他自己为义，也称信耶稣的人为义。
verses.textEnNiv: he did it to demonstrate his righteousness at the present time, so as to be just and the one who justifies those who have faith in Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: It was to show his righteousness at the present time, so that he might be just and the justifier of the one who has faith in Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: to demonstrate at the present time His righteousness, that He might be just and the justifier of the one who has faith in Jesus.
verses.textEnNlt: for he was looking ahead and including them in what he would do in this present time. God did this to demonstrate his righteousness, for he himself is fair and just, and he makes sinners right in his sight when they believe in Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: for the demonstration, that is, of His righteousness at the present time, so that He would be just and the justifier of the one who has faith in Jesus.
verses.textEn: he did it to demonstrate his righteousness at the present time, so as to be just and the one who justifies those who have faith in Jesus.

verses.textZh: 这样，有甚么可夸的呢？没有可夸的了。凭甚么准则说没有的呢？凭行为吗？不是的，而是以信心为准则说的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，有甚么可夸的呢？没有可夸的了。凭甚么准则说没有的呢？凭行为吗？不是的，而是以信心为准则说的。
verses.textZhCuv: 既是这样，哪里能夸口呢？没有可夸的了。用何法没有的呢？是用立功之法吗？不是，乃用信主之法。
verses.textEnNiv: Where, then, is boasting? It is excluded. Because of what law? The law that requires works? No, because of the law that requires faith.
verses.textEnEsv: Then what becomes of our boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? By a law of works? No, but by the law of faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? Of works? No, but by the law of faith.
verses.textEnNlt: Can we boast, then, that we have done anything to be accepted by God? No, because our acquittal is not based on obeying the law. It is based on faith.
verses.textEnNasb: Where then is boasting? It has been excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.
verses.textEn: Where, then, is boasting? It is excluded. Because of what law? The law that requires works? No, because of the law that requires faith.

verses.textZh: 因为我们认定，人称义是由于信，并不是靠行律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我们认定，人称义是由于信，并不是靠行律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以 我们看定了：人称义是因着信，不在乎遵行律法。
verses.textEnNiv: For we maintain that a person is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.
verses.textEnEsv: For we hold that one is justified by faith apart from works of the law.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith apart from the deeds of the law.
verses.textEnNlt: So we are made right with God through faith and not by obeying the law.
verses.textEnNasb: For we maintain that a person is justified by faith apart from works of the Law.
verses.textEn: For we maintain that a person is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.

verses.textZh: 难道神只是犹太人的神吗？不也是外族人的神吗？是的，他也是外族人的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道神只是犹太人的神吗？不也是外族人的神吗？是的，他也是外族人的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 难道神只作犹太人的神吗？不也是作外邦人的神吗？是的，也作外邦人的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Or is God the God of Jews only? Is he not the God of Gentiles too? Yes, of Gentiles too,
verses.textEnEsv: Or is God the God of Jews only? Is he not the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,
verses.textEnNkjv: Or isHe the God of the Jews only? IsHe not also the God of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also,
verses.textEnNlt: After all, is God the God of the Jews only? Isn’t he also the God of the Gentiles? Of course he is.
verses.textEnNasb: Or is God the God of Jews only? Is He not the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,
verses.textEn: Or is God the God of Jews only? Is he not the God of Gentiles too? Yes, of Gentiles too,

verses.textZh: 神既然只有一位，他就以信为准则称受割礼的为义，也要以信为准则称没有受割礼的为义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神既然只有一位，他就以信为准则称受割礼的为义，也要以信为准则称没有受割礼的为义。
verses.textZhCuv: 神既是一位，他就要因信称那受割礼的为义，也要因信称那未受割礼的为义。
verses.textEnNiv: since there is only one God, who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through that same faith.
verses.textEnEsv: since God is one—who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: since thereis one God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith.
verses.textEnNlt: There is only one God, and he makes people right with himself only by faith, whether they are Jews or Gentiles.
verses.textEnNasb: since indeed God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith is one.
verses.textEn: since there is only one God, who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through that same faith.

verses.textZh: 这样说来，我们以信废掉了律法吗？绝对不是，倒是巩固了律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样说来，我们以信废掉了律法吗？绝对不是，倒是巩固了律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，我们因信废了律法吗？断乎不是！更是坚固律法。
verses.textEnNiv: Do we, then, nullify the law by this faith? Not at all! Rather, we uphold the law.
verses.textEnEsv: Do we then overthrow the law by this faith? By no means! On the contrary, we uphold the law.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do we then make void the law through faith? Certainly not! On the contrary, we establish the law.
verses.textEnNlt: Well then, if we emphasize faith, does this mean that we can forget about the law? Of course not! In fact, only when we have faith do we truly fulfill the law.
verses.textEnNasb: Do we then nullify the Law through faith? Far from it! On the contrary, we establish the Law.
verses.textEn: Do we, then, nullify the law by this faith? Not at all! Rather, we uphold the law.

verses.textZh: 那么，论到在血统 上作我们祖先的亚伯拉罕所经验的，我们可以说甚么呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么，论到在血统 上作我们祖先的亚伯拉罕所经验的，我们可以说甚么呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 如此说来，我们的祖宗亚伯拉罕凭着肉体得了什么呢？
verses.textEnNiv: What then shall we say that Abraham, our forefather according to the flesh, discovered in this matter?
verses.textEnEsv: What then shall we say was gained by Abraham, our forefather according to the flesh?
verses.textEnNkjv: What then shall we say that Abraham our father has found according to the flesh?
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham was, humanly speaking, the founder of our Jewish nation. What did he discover about being made right with God?
verses.textEnNasb: What then shall we say that Abraham, our forefather according to the flesh, has found?
verses.textEn: What then shall we say that Abraham, our forefather according to the flesh, discovered in this matter?

verses.textZh: 亚伯拉罕若是因行为称义，就有可夸的，只是不能在神面前夸口。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚伯拉罕若是因行为称义，就有可夸的，只是不能在神面前夸口。
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若亚伯拉罕是因行为称义，就有可夸的；只是在神面前并无可夸。
verses.textEnNiv: If, in fact, Abraham was justified by works, he had something to boast about—but not before God.
verses.textEnEsv: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not before God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not before God.
verses.textEnNlt: If his good deeds had made him acceptable to God, he would have had something to boast about. But that was not God’s way.
verses.textEnNasb: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about; but not before God.
verses.textEn: If, in fact, Abraham was justified by works, he had something to boast about—but not before God.

verses.textZh: 经上怎么样说呢？"亚伯拉罕信神，这就算为他的义。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 经上怎么样说呢？"亚伯拉罕信神，这就算为他的义。"
verses.textZhCuv: 经上说什么呢？说：「亚伯拉罕信神，这就算为他的义。」
verses.textEnNiv: What does Scripture say? "Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness."
verses.textEnEsv: For what does the Scripture say? "Abraham believed God, and it was counted to him as righteousness."
verses.textEnNkjv: For what does the Scripture say? "Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness."
verses.textEnNlt: For the Scriptures tell us, "Abraham believed God, and God counted him as righteous because of his faith."
verses.textEnNasb: For what does the Scripture say? "Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness."
verses.textEn: What does Scripture say? "Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness."

verses.textZh: 作工的得工资，不算是恩典，是他应得的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 作工的得工资，不算是恩典，是他应得的。
verses.textZhCuv: 做工的得工价，不算恩典，乃是该得的；
verses.textEnNiv: Now to the one who works, wages are not credited as a gift but as an obligation.
verses.textEnEsv: Now to the one who works, his wages are not counted as a gift but as his due.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now to him who works, the wages are not counted as grace but as debt.
verses.textEnNlt: When people work, their wages are not a gift, but something they have earned.
verses.textEnNasb: Now to the one who works, the wages are not credited as a favor, but as what is due.
verses.textEn: Now to the one who works, wages are not credited as a gift but as an obligation.

verses.textZh: 可是，那不作工而只信那称不敬虔的人为义的神的，他的信就算为义了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是，那不作工而只信那称不敬虔的人为义的神的，他的信就算为义了。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有不做工的，只信称罪人为义的神，他的信就算为义。
verses.textEnNiv: However, to the one who does not work but trusts God who justifies the ungodly, their faith is credited as righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: And to the one who does not work but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is counted as righteousness,
verses.textEnNkjv: But to him who does not work but believes on Him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness,
verses.textEnNlt: But people are counted as righteous, not because of their work, but because of their faith in God who forgives sinners.
verses.textEnNasb: But to the one who does not work, but believes in Him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is credited as righteousness,
verses.textEn: However, to the one who does not work but trusts God who justifies the ungodly, their faith is credited as righteousness.

verses.textZh: 大卫也是这样说，那不靠行为而蒙神算为义的人是有福的！
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫也是这样说，那不靠行为而蒙神算为义的人是有福的！
verses.textZhCuv: 正如大卫称那在行为以外蒙神算为义的人是有福的。
verses.textEnNiv: David says the same thing when he speaks of the blessedness of the one to whom God credits righteousness apart from works:
verses.textEnEsv: just as David also speaks of the blessing of the one to whom God counts righteousness apart from works:
verses.textEnNkjv: just as David also describes the blessedness of the man to whom God imputes righteousness apart from works:
verses.textEnNlt: David also spoke of this when he described the happiness of those who are declared righteous without working for it:
verses.textEnNasb: just as David also speaks of the blessing of the person to whom God credits righteousness apart from works:
verses.textEn: David says the same thing when he speaks of the blessedness of the one to whom God credits righteousness apart from works:

verses.textZh: "过犯得蒙赦免，罪恶得到遮盖的人，是有福的；
verses.textZhCnvs: "过犯得蒙赦免，罪恶得到遮盖的人，是有福的；
verses.textZhCuv: 他说： 得赦免其过、遮盖其罪的， 这人是有福的。
verses.textEnNiv: "Blessed are those whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
verses.textEnEsv: "Blessed are those whose lawless deeds are forgiven, and whose sins are covered;
verses.textEnNkjv: "Blessed arethose whose lawless deeds are forgiven, And whose sins are covered;
verses.textEnNlt: "Oh, what joy for those whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sins are put out of sight.
verses.textEnNasb: "Blessed are those whose lawless deeds have been forgiven, And whose sins have been covered.
verses.textEn: "Blessed are those whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

verses.textZh: 主不算为有罪的，这人是有福的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 主不算为有罪的，这人是有福的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 主不算为有罪的， 这人是有福的。
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed is the one whose sin the Lord will never count against them."
verses.textEnEsv: blessed is the man against whom the Lord will not count his sin."
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed isthe man to whom the Lord shall not impute sin."
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, what joy for those whose record the Lord has cleared of sin."
verses.textEnNasb: "Blessed is the man whose sin the Lord will not take into account."
verses.textEn: Blessed is the one whose sin the Lord will never count against them."

verses.textZh: 这样看来，那有福的人，是指受割礼的呢，还是也指没有受割礼的呢？因为我们说："亚伯拉罕的信算为他的义。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样看来，那有福的人，是指受割礼的呢，还是也指没有受割礼的呢？因为我们说："亚伯拉罕的信算为他的义。"
verses.textZhCuv: 如此看来，这福是单加给那受割礼的人吗？不也是加给那未受割礼的人吗？因我们所说，亚伯拉罕的信，就算为他的义，
verses.textEnNiv: Is this blessedness only for the circumcised, or also for the uncircumcised? We have been saying that Abraham’s faith was credited to him as righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: Is this blessing then only for the circumcised, or also for the uncircumcised? For we say that faith was counted to Abraham as righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: Does this blessedness then come upon the circumcised only, or upon the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: Now, is this blessing only for the Jews, or is it also for uncircumcised Gentiles? Well, we have been saying that Abraham was counted as righteous by God because of his faith.
verses.textEnNasb: Is this blessing then on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say, "Faith was credited to Abraham as righteousness."
verses.textEn: Is this blessedness only for the circumcised, or also for the uncircumcised? We have been saying that Abraham’s faith was credited to him as righteousness.

verses.textZh: 那么，是怎样算的呢？是在他受割礼以后呢，还是在他受割礼之前呢？不是在他受割礼以后，而是在他受了割礼以前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么，是怎样算的呢？是在他受割礼以后呢，还是在他受割礼之前呢？不是在他受割礼以后，而是在他受了割礼以前。
verses.textZhCuv: 是怎么算的呢？是在他受割礼的时候呢？是在他未受割礼的时候呢？不是在受割礼的时候，乃是在未受割礼的时候。
verses.textEnNiv: Under what circumstances was it credited? Was it after he was circumcised, or before? It was not after, but before!
verses.textEnEsv: How then was it counted to him? Was it before or after he had been circumcised? It was not after, but before he was circumcised.
verses.textEnNkjv: How then was it accounted? While he was circumcised, or uncircumcised? Not while circumcised, but while uncircumcised.
verses.textEnNlt: But how did this happen? Was he counted as righteous only after he was circumcised, or was it before he was circumcised? Clearly, God accepted Abraham before he was circumcised!
verses.textEnNasb: How then was it credited? While he was circumcised, or uncircumcised? Not while circumcised, but while uncircumcised;
verses.textEn: Under what circumstances was it credited? Was it after he was circumcised, or before? It was not after, but before!

verses.textZh: 他领受了割礼为记号，作他受割礼之前因信称义的印证，使他作所有没有受割礼而信之人的父，使他们也被算为义；
verses.textZhCnvs: 他领受了割礼为记号，作他受割礼之前因信称义的印证，使他作所有没有受割礼而信之人的父，使他们也被算为义；
verses.textZhCuv: 并且他受了割礼的记号，作他未受割礼的时候因信称义的印证，叫他作一切未受割礼而信之人的父，使他们也算为义；
verses.textEnNiv: And he received circumcision as a sign, a seal of the righteousness that he had by faith while he was still uncircumcised. So then, he is the father of all who believe but have not been circumcised, in order that righteousness might be credited to them.
verses.textEnEsv: He received the sign of circumcision as a seal of the righteousness that he had by faith while he was still uncircumcised. The purpose was to make him the father of all who believe without being circumcised, so that righteousness would be counted to them as well,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which hehadwhilestill uncircumcised, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they are uncircumcised, that righteousness might be imputed to them also,
verses.textEnNlt: Circumcision was a sign that Abraham already had faith and that God had already accepted him and declared him to be righteous—even before he was circumcised. So Abraham is the spiritual father of those who have faith but have not been circumcised. They are counted as righteous because of their faith.
verses.textEnNasb: and he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while uncircumcised, so that he might be the father of all who believe without being circumcised, that righteousness might be credited to them,
verses.textEn: And he received circumcision as a sign, a seal of the righteousness that he had by faith while he was still uncircumcised. So then, he is the father of all who believe but have not been circumcised, in order that righteousness might be credited to them.

verses.textZh: 又作受割礼之人的父，就是作那些不仅受割礼，并且照着我们祖宗亚伯拉罕未受割礼时就信的那脚踪而行之人的父。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又作受割礼之人的父，就是作那些不仅受割礼，并且照着我们祖宗亚伯拉罕未受割礼时就信的那脚踪而行之人的父。
verses.textZhCuv: 又作受割礼之人的父，就是那些不但受割礼，并且按我们的祖宗亚伯拉罕未受割礼而信之踪迹去行的人。
verses.textEnNiv: And he is then also the father of the circumcised who not only are circumcised but who also follow in the footsteps of the faith that our father Abraham had before he was circumcised.
verses.textEnEsv: and to make him the father of the circumcised who are not merely circumcised but who also walk in the footsteps of the faith that our father Abraham had before he was circumcised.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of the faith which our father Abraham hadwhilestill uncircumcised.
verses.textEnNlt: And Abraham is also the spiritual father of those who have been circumcised, but only if they have the same kind of faith Abraham had before he was circumcised.
verses.textEnNasb: and the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also follow in the steps of the faith of our father Abraham which he had while uncircumcised.
verses.textEn: And he is then also the father of the circumcised who not only are circumcised but who also follow in the footsteps of the faith that our father Abraham had before he was circumcised.

verses.textZh: 原来神给亚伯拉罕和他后裔承受世界的应许，并不是因着律法，而是借着因信而来的义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 原来神给亚伯拉罕和他后裔承受世界的应许，并不是因着律法，而是借着因信而来的义。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为神应许亚伯拉罕和他后裔，必得承受世界，不是因律法，乃是因信而得的义。
verses.textEnNiv: It was not through the law that Abraham and his offspring received the promise that he would be heir of the world, but through the righteousness that comes by faith.
verses.textEnEsv: For the promise to Abraham and his offspring that he would be heir of the world did not come through the law but through the righteousness of faith.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the promise that he would be the heir of the world was not to Abraham or to his seed through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
verses.textEnNlt: Clearly, God’s promise to give the whole earth to Abraham and his descendants was based not on his obedience to God’s law, but on a right relationship with God that comes by faith.
verses.textEnNasb: For the promise to Abraham or to his descendants that he would be heir of the world was not through the Law, but through the righteousness of faith.
verses.textEn: It was not through the law that Abraham and his offspring received the promise that he would be heir of the world, but through the righteousness that comes by faith.

verses.textZh: 如果属于律法的人才能成为后嗣，信就没有作用，应许也就落空了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果属于律法的人才能成为后嗣，信就没有作用，应许也就落空了。
verses.textZhCuv: 若是属乎律法的人才得为后嗣，信就归于虚空，应许也就废弃了。
verses.textEnNiv: For if those who depend on the law are heirs, faith means nothing and the promise is worthless,
verses.textEnEsv: For if it is the adherents of the law who are to be the heirs, faith is null and the promise is void.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void and the promise made of no effect,
verses.textEnNlt: If God’s promise is only for those who obey the law, then faith is not necessary and the promise is pointless.
verses.textEnNasb: For if those who are of the Law are heirs, then faith is made void and the promise is nullified;
verses.textEn: For if those who depend on the law are heirs, faith means nothing and the promise is worthless,

verses.textZh: 因为律法带来刑罚，没有律法，就没有违背律法的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为律法带来刑罚，没有律法，就没有违背律法的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为律法是惹动忿怒的 ；哪里没有律法，那里就没有过犯。
verses.textEnNiv: because the law brings wrath. And where there is no law there is no transgression.
verses.textEnEsv: For the law brings wrath, but where there is no law there is no transgression.
verses.textEnNkjv: because the law brings about wrath; for where there is no law thereis no transgression.
verses.textEnNlt: For the law always brings punishment on those who try to obey it. (The only way to avoid breaking the law is to have no law to break!)
verses.textEnNasb: for the Law brings about wrath, but where there is no law, there also is no violation.
verses.textEn: because the law brings wrath. And where there is no law there is no transgression.

verses.textZh: 所以，成为后嗣是因着信，为的是要按着神的恩典，使给所有后裔的应许坚定不移，不但临到那属于律法的人，也临到那效法亚伯拉罕而信的人。亚伯拉罕在神面前作我们众人的父，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，成为后嗣是因着信，为的是要按着神的恩典，使给所有后裔的应许坚定不移，不但临到那属于律法的人，也临到那效法亚伯拉罕而信的人。亚伯拉罕在神面前作我们众人的父，
verses.textZhCuv: 所以人得为后嗣是本乎信，因此就属乎恩，叫应许定然归给一切后裔；不但归给那属乎律法的，也归给那效法亚伯拉罕之信的。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, the promise comes by faith, so that it may be by grace and may be guaranteed to all Abraham’s offspring—not only to those who are of the law but also to those who have the faith of Abraham. He is the father of us all.
verses.textEnEsv: That is why it depends on faith, in order that the promise may rest on grace and be guaranteed to all his offspring—not only to the adherent of the law but also to the one who shares the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all,
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore itis of faith that itmightbe according to grace, so that the promise might be sure to all the seed, not only to those who are of the law, but also to those who are of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all
verses.textEnNlt: So the promise is received by faith. It is given as a free gift. And we are all certain to receive it, whether or not we live according to the law of Moses, if we have faith like Abraham’s. For Abraham is the father of all who believe.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason it is by faith, in order that it may be in accordance with grace, so that the promise will be guaranteed to all the descendants, not only to those who are of the Law, but also to those who are of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all,
verses.textEn: Therefore, the promise comes by faith, so that it may be by grace and may be guaranteed to all Abraham’s offspring—not only to those who are of the law but also to those who have the faith of Abraham. He is the father of us all.

verses.textZh: 如经上所记："我已经立了你作万国的父。"他所信的，是叫死人得生命、使无变为有的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如经上所记："我已经立了你作万国的父。"他所信的，是叫死人得生命、使无变为有的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 亚伯拉罕所信的，是那叫死人复活、使无变为有的神，他在主面前作我们世人的父。如经上所记：「我已经立你作多国的父。」
verses.textEnNiv: As it is written: "I have made you a father of many nations." He is our father in the sight of God, in whom he believed—the God who gives life to the dead and calls into being things that were not.
verses.textEnEsv: as it is written, "I have made you the father of many nations"—in the presence of the God in whom he believed, who gives life to the dead and calls into existence the things that do not exist.
verses.textEnNkjv: (as it is written, "I have made you a father of many nations") in the presence of Him whom he believed—God, who gives life to the dead and calls those things which do not exist as though they did;
verses.textEnNlt: That is what the Scriptures mean when God told him, "I have made you the father of many nations." This happened because Abraham believed in the God who brings the dead back to life and who creates new things out of nothing.
verses.textEnNasb: (as it is written: "I have made you a father of many nations") in the presence of Him whom he believed, that is, God, who gives life to the dead and calls into being things that do not exist.
verses.textEn: As it is written: "I have made you a father of many nations." He is our father in the sight of God, in whom he believed—the God who gives life to the dead and calls into being things that were not.

verses.textZh: 在他没有盼望的时候，仍然怀着盼望去信，因此就成了万国的父，正如神所说："你的后裔将要这样众多。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 在他没有盼望的时候，仍然怀着盼望去信，因此就成了万国的父，正如神所说："你的后裔将要这样众多。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他在无可指望的时候，因信仍有指望，就得以作多国的父，正如先前所说：「你的后裔将要如此。」
verses.textEnNiv: Against all hope, Abraham in hope believed and so became the father of many nations, just as it had been said to him, "So shall your offspring be."
verses.textEnEsv: In hope he believed against hope, that he should become the father of many nations, as he had been told, "So shall your offspring be."
verses.textEnNkjv: who, contrary to hope, in hope believed, so that he became the father of many nations, according to what was spoken, "So shall your descendants be."
verses.textEnNlt: Even when there was no reason for hope, Abraham kept hoping—believing that he would become the father of many nations. For God had said to him, "That’s how many descendants you will have!"
verses.textEnNasb: In hope against hope he believed, so that he might become a father of many nations according to that which had been spoken, "So shall your descendants be."
verses.textEn: Against all hope, Abraham in hope believed and so became the father of many nations, just as it had been said to him, "So shall your offspring be."

verses.textZh: 他快到一百岁的时候，想到自己的身体好象已经死了，撒拉也不能生育，他的信心还是不软弱，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他快到一百岁的时候，想到自己的身体好象已经死了，撒拉也不能生育，他的信心还是不软弱，
verses.textZhCuv: 他将近百岁的时候，虽然想到自己的身体如同已死，撒拉的生育已经断绝，他的信心还是不软弱；
verses.textEnNiv: Without weakening in his faith, he faced the fact that his body was as good as dead—since he was about a hundred years old—and that Sarah’s womb was also dead.
verses.textEnEsv: He did not weaken in faith when he considered his own body, which was as good as dead ( since he was about a hundred years old), or when he considered the barrenness of Sarah’s womb.
verses.textEnNkjv: And not being weak in faith, he did not consider his own body, already dead (since he was about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.
verses.textEnNlt: And Abraham’s faith did not weaken, even though, at about 100 years of age, he figured his body was as good as dead—and so was Sarah’s womb.
verses.textEnNasb: Without becoming weak in faith he contemplated his own body, now as good as dead since he was about a hundred years old, and the deadness of Sarah’s womb;
verses.textEn: Without weakening in his faith, he faced the fact that his body was as good as dead—since he was about a hundred years old—and that Sarah’s womb was also dead.

verses.textZh: 也没有因着不信而疑惑神的应许，反倒坚信不移，把荣耀归给神，
verses.textZhCnvs: 也没有因着不信而疑惑神的应许，反倒坚信不移，把荣耀归给神，
verses.textZhCuv: 并且仰望神的应许，总没有因不信心里起疑惑，反倒因信心里得坚固，将荣耀归给神，
verses.textEnNiv: Yet he did not waver through unbelief regarding the promise of God, but was strengthened in his faith and gave glory to God,
verses.textEnEsv: No unbelief made him waver concerning the promise of God, but he grew strong in his faith as he gave glory to God,
verses.textEnNkjv: He did not waver at the promise of God through unbelief, but was strengthened in faith, giving glory to God,
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham never wavered in believing God’s promise. In fact, his faith grew stronger, and in this he brought glory to God.
verses.textEnNasb: yet, with respect to the promise of God, he did not waver in unbelief but grew strong in faith, giving glory to God,
verses.textEn: Yet he did not waver through unbelief regarding the promise of God, but was strengthened in his faith and gave glory to God,

verses.textZh: 满心相信神所应许的，神必能成就。
verses.textZhCnvs: 满心相信神所应许的，神必能成就。
verses.textZhCuv: 且满心相信神所应许的必能做成。
verses.textEnNiv: being fully persuaded that God had power to do what he had promised.
verses.textEnEsv: fully convinced that God was able to do what he had promised.
verses.textEnNkjv: and being fully convinced that what He had promised He was also able to perform.
verses.textEnNlt: He was fully convinced that God is able to do whatever he promises.
verses.textEnNasb: and being fully assured that what God had promised, He was able also to perform.
verses.textEn: being fully persuaded that God had power to do what he had promised.

verses.textZh: 因此，这就算为他的义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，这就算为他的义。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，这就算为他的义。
verses.textEnNiv: This is why "it was credited to him as righteousness."
verses.textEnEsv: That is why his faith was "counted to him as righteousness."
verses.textEnNkjv: And therefore "it was accounted to him for righteousness."
verses.textEnNlt: And because of Abraham’s faith, God counted him as righteous.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore it was also credited to him as righteousness.
verses.textEn: This is why "it was credited to him as righteousness."

verses.textZh: "算为他的义"这一句话，不是单为他写的，
verses.textZhCnvs: "算为他的义"这一句话，不是单为他写的，
verses.textZhCuv: 「算为他义」的这句话不是单为他写的，
verses.textEnNiv: The words "it was credited to him" were written not for him alone,
verses.textEnEsv: But the words "it was counted to him" were not written for his sake alone,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now it was not written for his sake alone that it was imputed to him,
verses.textEnNlt: And when God counted him as righteous, it wasn’t just for Abraham’s benefit. It was recorded
verses.textEnNasb: Now not for his sake only was it written that it was credited to him,
verses.textEn: The words "it was credited to him" were written not for him alone,

verses.textZh: 也是为我们这将来得算为义的人写的，就是为我们这信神使我们的主耶稣从死人中复活的人写的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也是为我们这将来得算为义的人写的，就是为我们这信神使我们的主耶稣从死人中复活的人写的。
verses.textZhCuv: 也是为我们将来得算为义之人写的，就是我们这信神使我们的主耶稣从死里复活的人。
verses.textEnNiv: but also for us, to whom God will credit righteousness—for us who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead.
verses.textEnEsv: but for ours also. It will be counted to us who believe in him who raised from the dead Jesus our Lord,
verses.textEnNkjv: but also for us. It shall be imputed to us who believe in Him who raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead,
verses.textEnNlt: for our benefit, too, assuring us that God will also count us as righteous if we believe in him, the one who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: but for our sake also, to whom it will be credited, to us who believe in Him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,
verses.textEn: but also for us, to whom God will credit righteousness—for us who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead.

verses.textZh: 耶稣为我们的过犯被交去处死，为我们的称义而复活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶稣为我们的过犯被交去处死，为我们的称义而复活。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶稣被交给人，是为我们的过犯；复活，是为叫我们称义 。
verses.textEnNiv: He was delivered over to death for our sins and was raised to life for our justification.
verses.textEnEsv: who was delivered up for our trespasses and raised for our justification.
verses.textEnNkjv: who was delivered up because of our offenses, and was raised because of our justification.
verses.textEnNlt: He was handed over to die because of our sins, and he was raised to life to make us right with God.
verses.textEnNasb: He who was delivered over because of our wrongdoings, and was raised because of our justification.
verses.textEn: He was delivered over to death for our sins and was raised to life for our justification.

verses.textZh: 所以，我们既然因信称义，就借着我们的主耶稣基督与神和好；
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我们既然因信称义，就借着我们的主耶稣基督与神和好；
verses.textZhCuv: 我们既因信称义，就藉着我们的主耶稣基督得与神相和。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, since we have been justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, having been justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, since we have been made right in God’s sight by faith, we have peace with God because of what Jesus Christ our Lord has done for us.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, having been justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.textEn: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.textZh: 我们也凭着信，借着他可以进入现在所站的这恩典中，并且以盼望得享神的荣耀为荣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们也凭着信，借着他可以进入现在所站的这恩典中，并且以盼望得享神的荣耀为荣。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们又藉着他，因信得进入现在所站的这恩典中，并且欢欢喜喜盼望神的荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we now stand. And we boast in the hope of the glory of God.
verses.textEnEsv: Through him we have also obtained access by faith into this grace in which we stand, and we rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: through whom also we have access by faith into this grace in which we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Because of our faith, Christ has brought us into this place of undeserved privilege where we now stand, and we confidently and joyfully look forward to sharing God’s glory.
verses.textEnNasb: through whom we also have obtained our introduction by faith into this grace in which we stand; and we celebrate in hope of the glory of God.
verses.textEn: through whom we have gained access by faith into this grace in which we now stand. And we boast in the hope of the glory of God.

verses.textZh: 不但这样，我们更以患难为荣；知道患难产生忍耐，
verses.textZhCnvs: 不但这样，我们更以患难为荣；知道患难产生忍耐，
verses.textZhCuv: 不但如此，就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，
verses.textEnNiv: Not only so, but we also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance;
verses.textEnEsv: Not only that, but we rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces endurance,
verses.textEnNkjv: And not only that, but we also glory in tribulations, knowing that tribulation produces perseverance;
verses.textEnNlt: We can rejoice, too, when we run into problems and trials, for we know that they help us develop endurance.
verses.textEnNasb: And not only this, but we also celebrate in our tribulations, knowing that tribulation brings about perseverance;
verses.textEn: Not only so, but we also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance;

verses.textZh: 忍耐产生毅力，毅力产生盼望；
verses.textZhCnvs: 忍耐产生毅力，毅力产生盼望；
verses.textZhCuv: 忍耐生老练，老练生盼望；
verses.textEnNiv: perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verses.textEnEsv: and endurance produces character, and character produces hope,
verses.textEnNkjv: and perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verses.textEnNlt: And endurance develops strength of character, and character strengthens our confident hope of salvation.
verses.textEnNasb: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;
verses.textEn: perseverance, character; and character, hope.

verses.textZh: 盼望是不会令人蒙羞的，因为神借着所赐给我们的圣灵，把他的爱浇灌在我们的心里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 盼望是不会令人蒙羞的，因为神借着所赐给我们的圣灵，把他的爱浇灌在我们的心里。
verses.textZhCuv: 盼望不至于羞耻，因为所赐给我们的圣灵将神的爱浇灌在我们心里。
verses.textEnNiv: And hope does not put us to shame, because God’s love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit, who has been given to us.
verses.textEnEsv: and hope does not put us to shame, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who has been given to us.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now hope does not disappoint, because the love of God has been poured out in our hearts by the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
verses.textEnNlt: And this hope will not lead to disappointment. For we know how dearly God loves us, because he has given us the Holy Spirit to fill our hearts with his love.
verses.textEnNasb: and hope does not disappoint, because the love of God has been poured out within our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
verses.textEn: And hope does not put us to shame, because God’s love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit, who has been given to us.

verses.textZh: 当我们还软弱的时候，基督就照所定的日期，为不敬虔的人死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当我们还软弱的时候，基督就照所定的日期，为不敬虔的人死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因我们还软弱的时候，基督就按所定的日期为罪人死。
verses.textEnNiv: You see, at just the right time, when we were still powerless, Christ died for the ungodly.
verses.textEnEsv: For while we were still weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.
verses.textEnNkjv: For when we were still without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.
verses.textEnNlt: When we were utterly helpless, Christ came at just the right time and died for us sinners.
verses.textEnNasb: For while we were still helpless, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.
verses.textEn: You see, at just the right time, when we were still powerless, Christ died for the ungodly.

verses.textZh: 为义人死，是少有的；为好人死，或有敢作的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 为义人死，是少有的；为好人死，或有敢作的；
verses.textZhCuv: 为义人死，是少有的；为仁人死，或者有敢做的。
verses.textEnNiv: Very rarely will anyone die for a righteous person, though for a good person someone might possibly dare to die.
verses.textEnEsv: For one will scarcely die for a righteous person—though perhaps for a good person one would dare even to die—
verses.textEnNkjv: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die; yet perhaps for a good man someone would even dare to die.
verses.textEnNlt: Now, most people would not be willing to die for an upright person, though someone might perhaps be willing to die for a person who is especially good.
verses.textEnNasb: For one will hardly die for a righteous person; though perhaps for the good person someone would even dare to die.
verses.textEn: Very rarely will anyone die for a righteous person, though for a good person someone might possibly dare to die.

verses.textZh: 唯有基督在我们还作罪人的时候为我们死，神对我们的爱就在此显明了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 唯有基督在我们还作罪人的时候为我们死，神对我们的爱就在此显明了。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有基督在我们还作罪人的时候为我们死，神的爱就在此向我们显明了。
verses.textEnNiv: But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
verses.textEnEsv: but God shows his love for us in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
verses.textEnNkjv: But God demonstrates His own love toward us, in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
verses.textEnNlt: But God showed his great love for us by sending Christ to die for us while we were still sinners.
verses.textEnNasb: But God demonstrates His own love toward us, in that while we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
verses.textEn: But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.

verses.textZh: 所以，我们现在既然因他的血称义，就更要借着他免受神的忿怒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我们现在既然因他的血称义，就更要借着他免受神的忿怒。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我们既靠着他的血称义，就更要藉着他免去神的忿怒。
verses.textEnNiv: Since we have now been justified by his blood, how much more shall we be saved from God’s wrath through him!
verses.textEnEsv: Since, therefore, we have now been justified by his blood, much more shall we be saved by him from the wrath of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Much more then, having now been justified by His blood, we shall be saved from wrath through Him.
verses.textEnNlt: And since we have been made right in God’s sight by the blood of Christ, he will certainly save us from God’s condemnation.
verses.textEnNasb: Much more then, having now been justified by His blood, we shall be saved from the wrath of God through Him.
verses.textEn: Since we have now been justified by his blood, how much more shall we be saved from God’s wrath through him!

verses.textZh: 我们作仇敌的时候，尚且借着神儿子的死与他复和，既然复和了，就更要因他的生得救了！
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们作仇敌的时候，尚且借着神儿子的死与他复和，既然复和了，就更要因他的生得救了！
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我们作仇敌的时候，且藉着神儿子的死，得与神和好；既已和好，就更要因他的生得救了。
verses.textEnNiv: For if, while we were God’s enemies, we were reconciled to him through the death of his Son, how much more, having been reconciled, shall we be saved through his life!
verses.textEnEsv: For if while we were enemies we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, now that we are reconciled, shall we be saved by his life.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if when we were enemies we were reconciled to God through the death of His Son, much more, having been reconciled, we shall be saved by His life.
verses.textEnNlt: For since our friendship with God was restored by the death of his Son while we were still his enemies, we will certainly be saved through the life of his Son.
verses.textEnNasb: For if while we were enemies we were reconciled to God through the death of His Son, much more, having been reconciled, we shall be saved by His life.
verses.textEn: For if, while we were God’s enemies, we were reconciled to him through the death of his Son, how much more, having been reconciled, shall we be saved through his life!

verses.textZh: 不但这样，我们现在已经借着我们的主耶稣基督与神复和，也借着他以神为荣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不但这样，我们现在已经借着我们的主耶稣基督与神复和，也借着他以神为荣。
verses.textZhCuv: 不但如此，我们既藉着我主耶稣基督得与神和好，也就藉着他以神为乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Not only is this so, but we also boast in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received reconciliation.
verses.textEnEsv: More than that, we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received reconciliation.
verses.textEnNkjv: And not only that, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.
verses.textEnNlt: So now we can rejoice in our wonderful new relationship with God because our Lord Jesus Christ has made us friends of God.
verses.textEnNasb: And not only this, but we also celebrate in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.
verses.textEn: Not only is this so, but we also boast in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received reconciliation.

verses.textZh: 正好象罪借着一个人入了世界，死又是从罪来的，所以死就临到所有人，因为所有人都犯了罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正好象罪借着一个人入了世界，死又是从罪来的，所以死就临到所有人，因为所有人都犯了罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 这就如罪是从一人入了世界，死又是从罪来的，于是死就临到众人，因为众人都犯了罪。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, just as sin entered the world through one man, and death through sin, and in this way death came to all people, because all sinned—
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, just as sin came into the world through one man, and death through sin, and so death spread to all men because all sinned—
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, just as through one man sin entered the world, and death through sin, and thus death spread to all men, because all sinned—
verses.textEnNlt: When Adam sinned, sin entered the world. Adam’s sin brought death, so death spread to everyone, for everyone sinned.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, just as through one man sin entered into the world, and death through sin, and so death spread to all mankind, because all sinned—
verses.textEn: Therefore, just as sin entered the world through one man, and death through sin, and in this way death came to all people, because all sinned—

verses.textZh: 没有律法以前，罪已经在世界上了；不过，没有律法的时候，罪也不算罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有律法以前，罪已经在世界上了；不过，没有律法的时候，罪也不算罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 没有律法之先，罪已经在世上；但没有律法，罪也不算罪。
verses.textEnNiv: To be sure, sin was in the world before the law was given, but sin is not charged against anyone’s account where there is no law.
verses.textEnEsv: for sin indeed was in the world before the law was given, but sin is not counted where there is no law.
verses.textEnNkjv: (For until the law sin was in the world, but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, people sinned even before the law was given. But it was not counted as sin because there was not yet any law to break.
verses.textEnNasb: for until the Law sin was in the world, but sin is not counted against anyone when there is no law.
verses.textEn: To be sure, sin was in the world before the law was given, but sin is not charged against anyone’s account where there is no law.

verses.textZh: 可是，从亚当到摩西，死就掌权了，甚至那些不像亚当那样犯罪的人，也在死的权下；亚当正是要来的那一位的预表。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是，从亚当到摩西，死就掌权了，甚至那些不像亚当那样犯罪的人，也在死的权下；亚当正是要来的那一位的预表。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而从亚当到摩西，死就作了王，连那些不与亚当犯一样罪过的，也在他的权下。亚当乃是那以后要来之人的预像。
verses.textEnNiv: Nevertheless, death reigned from the time of Adam to the time of Moses, even over those who did not sin by breaking a command, as did Adam, who is a pattern of the one to come.
verses.textEnEsv: Yet death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over those whose sinning was not like the transgression of Adam, who was a type of the one who was to come.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over those who had not sinned according to the likeness of the transgression of Adam, who is a type of Him who was to come.
verses.textEnNlt: Still, everyone died—from the time of Adam to the time of Moses—even those who did not disobey an explicit commandment of God, as Adam did. Now Adam is a symbol, a representation of Christ, who was yet to come.
verses.textEnNasb: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those who had not sinned in the likeness of the violation committed by Adam, who is a type of Him who was to come.
verses.textEn: Nevertheless, death reigned from the time of Adam to the time of Moses, even over those who did not sin by breaking a command, as did Adam, who is a pattern of the one to come.

verses.textZh: 但恩赏和过犯是截然不同的；如果因着那一人的过犯，众人都死了，神的恩典和这一人耶稣基督在恩典里的赏赐，对众人就更加丰盛了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但恩赏和过犯是截然不同的；如果因着那一人的过犯，众人都死了，神的恩典和这一人耶稣基督在恩典里的赏赐，对众人就更加丰盛了。
verses.textZhCuv: 只是过犯不如恩赐，若因一人的过犯，众人都死了，何况神的恩典，与那因耶稣基督一人恩典中的赏赐，岂不更加倍地临到众人吗？
verses.textEnNiv: But the gift is not like the trespass. For if the many died by the trespass of the one man, how much more did God’s grace and the gift that came by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, overflow to the many!
verses.textEnEsv: But the free gift is not like the trespass. For if many died through one man’s trespass, much more have the grace of God and the free gift by the grace of that one man Jesus Christ abounded for many.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the free gift is not like the offense. For if by the one man’s offense many died, much more the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one Man, Jesus Christ, abounded to many.
verses.textEnNlt: But there is a great difference between Adam’s sin and God’s gracious gift. For the sin of this one man, Adam, brought death to many. But even greater is God’s wonderful grace and his gift of forgiveness to many through this other man, Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: But the gracious gift is not like the offense. For if by the offense of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one Man, Jesus Christ, overflow to the many.
verses.textEn: But the gift is not like the trespass. For if the many died by the trespass of the one man, how much more did God’s grace and the gift that came by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, overflow to the many!

verses.textZh: 这赏赐和那一人犯罪的后果也是不同的；因为审判是由一人而来，以致定罪，恩赏却由许多过犯而来，以致称义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这赏赐和那一人犯罪的后果也是不同的；因为审判是由一人而来，以致定罪，恩赏却由许多过犯而来，以致称义。
verses.textZhCuv: 因一人犯罪就定罪，也不如恩赐，原来审判是由一人而定罪，恩赐乃是由许多过犯而称义。
verses.textEnNiv: Nor can the gift of God be compared with the result of one man’s sin: The judgment followed one sin and brought condemnation, but the gift followed many trespasses and brought justification.
verses.textEnEsv: And the free gift is not like the result of that one man’s sin. For the judgment following one trespass brought condemnation, but the free gift following many trespasses brought justification.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the gift is not like thatwhichcame through the one who sinned. For the judgment whichcame from one offenseresulted in condemnation, but the free gift whichcame from many offenses resulted in justification.
verses.textEnNlt: And the result of God’s gracious gift is very different from the result of that one man’s sin. For Adam’s sin led to condemnation, but God’s free gift leads to our being made right with God, even though we are guilty of many sins.
verses.textEnNasb: The gift is not like that which came through the one who sinned; for on the one hand the judgment arose from one offense, resulting in condemnation, but on the other hand the gracious gift arose from many offenses, resulting in justification.
verses.textEn: Nor can the gift of God be compared with the result of one man’s sin: The judgment followed one sin and brought condemnation, but the gift followed many trespasses and brought justification.

verses.textZh: 如果因着那一人的过犯，死就因那一人而掌权，那些蒙丰富的恩典并且得公义为赏赐的，就更要因这一位耶稣基督在生命中掌权了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果因着那一人的过犯，死就因那一人而掌权，那些蒙丰富的恩典并且得公义为赏赐的，就更要因这一位耶稣基督在生命中掌权了。
verses.textZhCuv: 若因一人的过犯，死就因这一人作了王，何况那些受洪恩又蒙所赐之义的，岂不更要因耶稣基督一人在生命中作王吗？
verses.textEnNiv: For if, by the trespass of the one man, death reigned through that one man, how much more will those who receive God’s abundant provision of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one man, Jesus Christ!
verses.textEnEsv: For if, because of one man’s trespass, death reigned through that one man, much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and the free gift of righteousness reign in life through the one man Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if by the one man’s offense death reigned through the one, much more those who receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness will reign in life through the One, Jesus Christ.)
verses.textEnNlt: For the sin of this one man, Adam, caused death to rule over many. But even greater is God’s wonderful grace and his gift of righteousness, for all who receive it will live in triumph over sin and death through this one man, Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: For if by the offense of the one, death reigned through the one, much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the One, Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: For if, by the trespass of the one man, death reigned through that one man, how much more will those who receive God’s abundant provision of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one man, Jesus Christ!

verses.textZh: 这样看来，因一次的过犯，所有人都被定罪；照样，因一次的义行，所有人都被称义得生命了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样看来，因一次的过犯，所有人都被定罪；照样，因一次的义行，所有人都被称义得生命了。
verses.textZhCuv: 如此说来，因一次的过犯，众人都被定罪；照样，因一次的义行，众人也就被称义得生命了。
verses.textEnNiv: Consequently, just as one trespass resulted in condemnation for all people, so also one righteous act resulted in justification and life for all people.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, as one trespass led to condemnation for all men, so one act of righteousness leads to justification and life for all men.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, as through one man’s offense judgmentcame to all men, resulting in condemnation, even so through one Man’s righteous act thefreegiftcame to all men, resulting in justification of life.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, Adam’s one sin brings condemnation for everyone, but Christ’s one act of righteousness brings a right relationship with God and new life for everyone.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, as through one offense the result was condemnation to all mankind, so also through one act of righteousness the result was justification of life to all mankind.
verses.textEn: Consequently, just as one trespass resulted in condemnation for all people, so also one righteous act resulted in justification and life for all people.

verses.textZh: 因着那一人的悖逆，众人就被列为罪人；照样，因着这一人的顺服，众人也被列为义人了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因着那一人的悖逆，众人就被列为罪人；照样，因着这一人的顺服，众人也被列为义人了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因一人的悖逆，众人成为罪人；照样，因一人的顺从，众人也成为义了。
verses.textEnNiv: For just as through the disobedience of the one man the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the one man the many will be made righteous.
verses.textEnEsv: For as by the one man’s disobedience the many were made sinners, so by the one man’s obedience the many will be made righteous.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as by one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, so also by one Man’s obedience many will be made righteous.
verses.textEnNlt: Because one person disobeyed God, many became sinners. But because one other person obeyed God, many will be made righteous.
verses.textEnNasb: For as through the one man’s disobedience the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the One the many will be made righteous.
verses.textEn: For just as through the disobedience of the one man the many were made sinners, so also through the obedience of the one man the many will be made righteous.

verses.textZh: 律法的出现，是要叫过犯增多；然而罪在哪里增多，恩典就更加增多了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 律法的出现，是要叫过犯增多；然而罪在哪里增多，恩典就更加增多了。
verses.textZhCuv: 律法本是外添的，叫过犯显多；只是罪在哪里显多，恩典就更显多了。
verses.textEnNiv: The law was brought in so that the trespass might increase. But where sin increased, grace increased all the more,
verses.textEnEsv: Now the law came in to increase the trespass, but where sin increased, grace abounded all the more,
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover the law entered that the offense might abound. But where sin abounded, grace abounded much more,
verses.textEnNlt: God’s law was given so that all people could see how sinful they were. But as people sinned more and more, God’s wonderful grace became more abundant.
verses.textEnNasb: The Law came in so that the offense would increase; but where sin increased, grace abounded all the more,
verses.textEn: The law was brought in so that the trespass might increase. But where sin increased, grace increased all the more,

verses.textZh: 罪借着死掌权；照样，恩典也借着义掌权，使人借着我们的主耶稣基督进入永生。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罪借着死掌权；照样，恩典也借着义掌权，使人借着我们的主耶稣基督进入永生。
verses.textZhCuv: 就如罪作王叫人死；照样，恩典也藉着义作王，叫人因我们的主耶稣基督得永生。
verses.textEnNiv: so that, just as sin reigned in death, so also grace might reign through righteousness to bring eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: so that, as sin reigned in death, grace also might reign through righteousness leading to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: so that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So just as sin ruled over all people and brought them to death, now God’s wonderful grace rules instead, giving us right standing with God and resulting in eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: so that, as sin reigned in death, so also grace would reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.textEn: so that, just as sin reigned in death, so also grace might reign through righteousness to bring eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.textZh: 这样，我们可以说甚么呢？我们可以常在罪中，叫恩典增多吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，我们可以说甚么呢？我们可以常在罪中，叫恩典增多吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，怎么说呢？我们可以仍在罪中、叫恩典显多吗？
verses.textEnNiv: What shall we say, then? Shall we go on sinning so that grace may increase?
verses.textEnEsv: What shall we say then? Are we to continue in sin that grace may abound?
verses.textEnNkjv: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin that grace may abound?
verses.textEnNlt: Well then, should we keep on sinning so that God can show us more and more of his wonderful grace?
verses.textEnNasb: What shall we say then? Are we to continue in sin so that grace may increase?
verses.textEn: What shall we say, then? Shall we go on sinning so that grace may increase?

verses.textZh: 绝对不可！我们向罪死了的人，怎么可以仍然活在罪中呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 绝对不可！我们向罪死了的人，怎么可以仍然活在罪中呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 断乎不可！我们在罪上死了的人岂可仍在罪中活着呢？
verses.textEnNiv: By no means! We are those who have died to sin; how can we live in it any longer?
verses.textEnEsv: By no means! How can we who died to sin still live in it?
verses.textEnNkjv: Certainly not! How shall we who died to sin live any longer in it?
verses.textEnNlt: Of course not! Since we have died to sin, how can we continue to live in it?
verses.textEnNasb: Far from it! How shall we who died to sin still live in it?
verses.textEn: By no means! We are those who have died to sin; how can we live in it any longer?

verses.textZh: 难道你们不晓得我们这受洗归入基督耶稣的人，是受洗归入他的死吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道你们不晓得我们这受洗归入基督耶稣的人，是受洗归入他的死吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 岂不知我们这受洗归入基督耶稣的人是受洗归入他的死吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?
verses.textEnEsv: Do you not know that all of us who have been baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?
verses.textEnNkjv: Or do you not know that as many of us as were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into His death?
verses.textEnNlt: Or have you forgotten that when we were joined with Christ Jesus in baptism, we joined him in his death?
verses.textEnNasb: Or do you not know that all of us who have been baptized into Christ Jesus have been baptized into His death?
verses.textEn: Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

verses.textZh: 所以我们借着洗礼归入死，与他同葬，为的是要我们过新生命的生活，像基督借着父的荣耀从死人中复活一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我们借着洗礼归入死，与他同葬，为的是要我们过新生命的生活，像基督借着父的荣耀从死人中复活一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我们藉着洗礼归入死，和他一同埋葬，原是叫我们一举一动有新生的样式，像基督藉着父的荣耀从死里复活一样。
verses.textEnNiv: We were therefore buried with him through baptism into death in order that, just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, we too may live a new life.
verses.textEnEsv: We were buried therefore with him by baptism into death, in order that, just as Christ was raised from the dead by the glory of the Father, we too might walk in newness of life.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore we were buried with Him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
verses.textEnNlt: For we died and were buried with Christ by baptism. And just as Christ was raised from the dead by the glorious power of the Father, now we also may live new lives.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore we have been buried with Him through baptism into death, so that, just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we too may walk in newness of life.
verses.textEn: We were therefore buried with him through baptism into death in order that, just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, we too may live a new life.

verses.textZh: 我们若在他死的样式上与他联合，也要在他复活的样式上与他联合。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们若在他死的样式上与他联合，也要在他复活的样式上与他联合。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若在他死的形状上与他联合，也要在他复活的形状上与他联合；
verses.textEnNiv: For if we have been united with him in a death like his, we will certainly also be united with him in a resurrection like his.
verses.textEnEsv: For if we have been united with him in a death like his, we shall certainly be united with him in a resurrection like his.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if we have been united together in the likeness of His death, certainly we also shall be inthelikeness of His resurrection,
verses.textEnNlt: Since we have been united with him in his death, we will also be raised to life as he was.
verses.textEnNasb: For if we have become united with Him in the likeness of His death, certainly we shall also be in the likeness of His resurrection,
verses.textEn: For if we have been united with him in a death like his, we will certainly also be united with him in a resurrection like his.

verses.textZh: 我们知道，我们的旧人已经与基督同钉十字架，使罪身丧失机能，使我们不再作罪的奴仆，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们知道，我们的旧人已经与基督同钉十字架，使罪身丧失机能，使我们不再作罪的奴仆，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为知道我们的旧人和他同钉十字架，使罪身灭绝，叫我们不再作罪的奴仆；
verses.textEnNiv: For we know that our old self was crucified with him so that the body ruled by sin might be done away with, that we should no longer be slaves to sin—
verses.textEnEsv: We know that our old self was crucified with him in order that the body of sin might be brought to nothing, so that we would no longer be enslaved to sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with Him, that the body of sin might be done away with, that we should no longer be slaves of sin.
verses.textEnNlt: We know that our old sinful selves were crucified with Christ so that sin might lose its power in our lives. We are no longer slaves to sin.
verses.textEnNasb: knowing this, that our old self was crucified with Him, in order that our body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be slaves to sin;
verses.textEn: For we know that our old self was crucified with him so that the body ruled by sin might be done away with, that we should no longer be slaves to sin—

verses.textZh: 因为死了的人已经脱离罪了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为死了的人已经脱离罪了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为已死的人是脱离了罪。
verses.textEnNiv: because anyone who has died has been set free from sin.
verses.textEnEsv: For one who has died has been set free from sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he who has died has been freed from sin.
verses.textEnNlt: For when we died with Christ we were set free from the power of sin.
verses.textEnNasb: for the one who has died is freed from sin.
verses.textEn: because anyone who has died has been set free from sin.

verses.textZh: 我们既然与基督同死，就信也必与他同活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们既然与基督同死，就信也必与他同活。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若是与基督同死，就信必与他同活。
verses.textEnNiv: Now if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him.
verses.textEnEsv: Now if we have died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now if we died with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with Him,
verses.textEnNlt: And since we died with Christ, we know we will also live with him.
verses.textEnNasb: Now if we have died with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with Him,
verses.textEn: Now if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him.

verses.textZh: 我们知道，基督既然从死人中复活，就不再死，死也不再辖制他了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们知道，基督既然从死人中复活，就不再死，死也不再辖制他了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为知道基督既从死里复活，就不再死，死也不再作他的主了。
verses.textEnNiv: For we know that since Christ was raised from the dead, he cannot die again; death no longer has mastery over him.
verses.textEnEsv: We know that Christ, being raised from the dead, will never die again; death no longer has dominion over him.
verses.textEnNkjv: knowing that Christ, having been raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over Him.
verses.textEnNlt: We are sure of this because Christ was raised from the dead, and he will never die again. Death no longer has any power over him.
verses.textEnNasb: knowing that Christ, having been raised from the dead, is never to die again; death no longer is master over Him.
verses.textEn: For we know that since Christ was raised from the dead, he cannot die again; death no longer has mastery over him.

verses.textZh: 他死，是向罪死了，只有这一次；他活，是向神活着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他死，是向罪死了，只有这一次；他活，是向神活着。
verses.textZhCuv: 他死是向罪死了，只有一次；他活是向神活着。
verses.textEnNiv: The death he died, he died to sin once for all; but the life he lives, he lives to God.
verses.textEnEsv: For the death he died he died to sin, once for all, but the life he lives he lives to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For thedeath that He died, He died to sin once for all; but thelife that He lives, He lives to God.
verses.textEnNlt: When he died, he died once to break the power of sin. But now that he lives, he lives for the glory of God.
verses.textEnNasb: For the death that He died, He died to sin once for all time; but the life that He lives, He lives to God.
verses.textEn: The death he died, he died to sin once for all; but the life he lives, he lives to God.

verses.textZh: 你们也应当这样，向罪算自己是死的，在基督耶稣里，向神却是活的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们也应当这样，向罪算自己是死的，在基督耶稣里，向神却是活的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，你们向罪也当看自己是死的；向神在基督耶稣里，却当看自己是活的。
verses.textEnNiv: In the same way, count yourselves dead to sin but alive to God in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: So you also must consider yourselves dead to sin and alive to God in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise you also, reckon yourselves to be dead indeed to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: So you also should consider yourselves to be dead to the power of sin and alive to God through Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: So you too, consider yourselves to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEn: In the same way, count yourselves dead to sin but alive to God in Christ Jesus.

verses.textZh: 所以，不要容罪在你们必死的肉身上掌权，使你们顺从肉身的私欲，
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，不要容罪在你们必死的肉身上掌权，使你们顺从肉身的私欲，
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，不要容罪在你们必死的身上作王，使你们顺从身子的私欲。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore do not let sin reign in your mortal body so that you obey its evil desires.
verses.textEnEsv: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, to make you obey its passions.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore do not let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not let sin control the way you live; do not give in to sinful desires.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore sin is not to reign in your mortal body so that you obey its lusts,
verses.textEn: Therefore do not let sin reign in your mortal body so that you obey its evil desires.

verses.textZh: 也不要把你们的肢体献给罪，作不义的用具；倒要像出死得生的人，把自己献给神，并且把你们的肢体献给神作义的用具。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也不要把你们的肢体献给罪，作不义的用具；倒要像出死得生的人，把自己献给神，并且把你们的肢体献给神作义的用具。
verses.textZhCuv: 也不要将你们的肢体献给罪作不义的器具；倒要像从死里复活的人，将自己献给神，并将肢体作义的器具献给神。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not offer any part of yourself to sin as an instrument of wickedness, but rather offer yourselves to God as those who have been brought from death to life; and offer every part of yourself to him as an instrument of righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not present your members to sin as instruments for unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as those who have been brought from death to life, and your members to God as instruments for righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: And do not present your members as instruments of unrighteousness to sin, but present yourselves to God as being alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.
verses.textEnNlt: Do not let any part of your body become an instrument of evil to serve sin. Instead, give yourselves completely to God, for you were dead, but now you have new life. So use your whole body as an instrument to do what is right for the glory of God.
verses.textEnNasb: and do not go on presenting the parts of your body to sin as instruments of unrighteousness; but present yourselves to God as those who are alive from the dead, and your body’s parts as instruments of righteousness for God.
verses.textEn: Do not offer any part of yourself to sin as an instrument of wickedness, but rather offer yourselves to God as those who have been brought from death to life; and offer every part of yourself to him as an instrument of righteousness.

verses.textZh: 罪必不能辖制你们，因为你们不是在律法之下，而是在恩典之下。
verses.textZhCnvs: 罪必不能辖制你们，因为你们不是在律法之下，而是在恩典之下。
verses.textZhCuv: 罪必不能作你们的主；因你们不在律法之下，乃在恩典之下。
verses.textEnNiv: For sin shall no longer be your master, because you are not under the law, but under grace.
verses.textEnEsv: For sin will have no dominion over you, since you are not under law but under grace.
verses.textEnNkjv: For sin shall not have dominion over you, for you are not under law but under grace.
verses.textEnNlt: Sin is no longer your master, for you no longer live under the requirements of the law. Instead, you live under the freedom of God’s grace.
verses.textEnNasb: For sin shall not be master over you, for you are not under the Law but under grace.
verses.textEn: For sin shall no longer be your master, because you are not under the law, but under grace.

verses.textZh: 那却怎么样呢？我们不在律法之下，而在恩典之下，就可以犯罪吗？绝对不可！
verses.textZhCnvs: 那却怎么样呢？我们不在律法之下，而在恩典之下，就可以犯罪吗？绝对不可！
verses.textZhCuv: 这却怎么样呢？我们在恩典之下，不在律法之下，就可以犯罪吗？断乎不可！
verses.textEnNiv: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under the law but under grace? By no means!
verses.textEnEsv: What then? Are we to sin because we are not under law but under grace? By no means!
verses.textEnNkjv: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? Certainly not!
verses.textEnNlt: Well then, since God’s grace has set us free from the law, does that mean we can go on sinning? Of course not!
verses.textEnNasb: What then? Are we to sin because we are not under the Law but under grace? Far from it!
verses.textEn: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under the law but under grace? By no means!

verses.textZh: 难道你们不知道你们自愿作奴仆去顺从人，顺从谁就作谁的奴仆，或作罪的奴仆以致于死，或作顺从的奴仆以致于义吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 难道你们不知道你们自愿作奴仆去顺从人，顺从谁就作谁的奴仆，或作罪的奴仆以致于死，或作顺从的奴仆以致于义吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 岂不晓得你们献上自己作奴仆，顺从谁，就作谁的奴仆吗？或作罪的奴仆，以至于死；或作顺命的奴仆，以至成义。
verses.textEnNiv: Don’t you know that when you offer yourselves to someone as obedient slaves, you are slaves of the one you obey—whether you are slaves to sin, which leads to death, or to obedience, which leads to righteousness?
verses.textEnEsv: Do you not know that if you present yourselves to anyone as obedient slaves, you are slaves of the one whom you obey, either of sin, which leads to death, or of obedience, which leads to righteousness?
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you not know that to whom you present yourselves slaves to obey, you are that one’s slaves whom you obey, whether of sin leading to death, or of obedience leading to righteousness?
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t you realize that you become the slave of whatever you choose to obey? You can be a slave to sin, which leads to death, or you can choose to obey God, which leads to righteous living.
verses.textEnNasb: Do you not know that the one to whom you present yourselves as slaves for obedience, you are slaves of that same one whom you obey, either of sin resulting in death, or of obedience resulting in righteousness?
verses.textEn: Don’t you know that when you offer yourselves to someone as obedient slaves, you are slaves of the one you obey—whether you are slaves to sin, which leads to death, or to obedience, which leads to righteousness?

verses.textZh: 感谢神，你们虽然作过罪的奴仆，现在却从心里顺从了传授给你们的教义的规范。
verses.textZhCnvs: 感谢神，你们虽然作过罪的奴仆，现在却从心里顺从了传授给你们的教义的规范。
verses.textZhCuv: 感谢神！因为你们从前虽然作罪的奴仆，现今却从心里顺服了所传给你们道理的模范。
verses.textEnNiv: But thanks be to God that, though you used to be slaves to sin, you have come to obey from your heart the pattern of teaching that has now claimed your allegiance.
verses.textEnEsv: But thanks be to God, that you who were once slaves of sin have become obedient from the heart to the standard of teaching to which you were committed,
verses.textEnNkjv: But God be thanked that though you were slaves of sin, yet you obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine to which you were delivered.
verses.textEnNlt: Thank God! Once you were slaves of sin, but now you wholeheartedly obey this teaching we have given you.
verses.textEnNasb: But thanks be to God that though you were slaves of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were entrusted,
verses.textEn: But thanks be to God that, though you used to be slaves to sin, you have come to obey from your heart the pattern of teaching that has now claimed your allegiance.

verses.textZh: 你们既然从罪里得了释放，就作了义的奴仆。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们既然从罪里得了释放，就作了义的奴仆。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们既从罪里得了释放，就作了义的奴仆。
verses.textEnNiv: You have been set free from sin and have become slaves to righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: and, having been set free from sin, have become slaves of righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: And having been set free from sin, you became slaves of righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: Now you are free from your slavery to sin, and you have become slaves to righteous living.
verses.textEnNasb: and after being freed from sin, you became slaves to righteousness.
verses.textEn: You have been set free from sin and have become slaves to righteousness.

verses.textZh: 因为你们肉体的弱点，我就按一般人的话来说，你们从前怎样把你们的肢体献给不洁和不法作奴仆，以致于不法，现在也要照样把你们的肢体献给义作奴仆，以致于成圣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为你们肉体的弱点，我就按一般人的话来说，你们从前怎样把你们的肢体献给不洁和不法作奴仆，以致于不法，现在也要照样把你们的肢体献给义作奴仆，以致于成圣。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因你们肉体的软弱，就照人的常话对你们说。你们从前怎样将肢体献给不洁不法作奴仆，以至于不法；现今也要照样将肢体献给义作奴仆，以至于成圣。
verses.textEnNiv: I am using an example from everyday life because of your human limitations. Just as you used to offer yourselves as slaves to impurity and to ever-increasing wickedness, so now offer yourselves as slaves to righteousness leading to holiness.
verses.textEnEsv: I am speaking in human terms, because of your natural limitations. For just as you once presented your members as slaves to impurity and to lawlessness leading to more lawlessness, so now present your members as slaves to righteousness leading to sanctification.
verses.textEnNkjv: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh. For just as you presented your members as slaves of uncleanness, and of lawlessness leading to more lawlessness, so now present your members as slaves of righteousness for holiness.
verses.textEnNlt: Because of the weakness of your human nature, I am using the illustration of slavery to help you understand all this. Previously, you let yourselves be slaves to impurity and lawlessness, which led ever deeper into sin. Now you must give yourselves to be slaves to righteous living so that you will become holy.
verses.textEnNasb: I am speaking in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh. For just as you presented the parts of your body as slaves to impurity and to lawlessness, resulting in further lawlessness, so now present your body’s parts as slaves to righteousness, resulting in sanctification.
verses.textEn: I am using an example from everyday life because of your human limitations. Just as you used to offer yourselves as slaves to impurity and to ever-increasing wickedness, so now offer yourselves as slaves to righteousness leading to holiness.

verses.textZh: 你们作罪的奴仆的时候，就不受义的约束。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们作罪的奴仆的时候，就不受义的约束。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为你们作罪之奴仆的时候，就不被义约束了。
verses.textEnNiv: When you were slaves to sin, you were free from the control of righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: For when you were slaves of sin, you were free in regard to righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: For when you were slaves of sin, you were free in regard to righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: When you were slaves to sin, you were free from the obligation to do right.
verses.textEnNasb: For when you were slaves of sin, you were free in relation to righteousness.
verses.textEn: When you were slaves to sin, you were free from the control of righteousness.

verses.textZh: 那么，你们在现今以为羞耻的事上，当时得了甚么呢？那些事的结局就是死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么，你们在现今以为羞耻的事上，当时得了甚么呢？那些事的结局就是死。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们现今所看为羞耻的事，当日有什么果子呢？那些事的结局就是死。
verses.textEnNiv: What benefit did you reap at that time from the things you are now ashamed of? Those things result in death!
verses.textEnEsv: But what fruit were you getting at that time from the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.
verses.textEnNkjv: What fruit did you have then in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.
verses.textEnNlt: And what was the result? You are now ashamed of the things you used to do, things that end in eternal doom.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore what benefit were you then deriving from the things of which you are now ashamed? For the outcome of those things is death.
verses.textEn: What benefit did you reap at that time from the things you are now ashamed of? Those things result in death!

verses.textZh: 现在你们既然从罪里得了释放，作了神的奴仆，就有成圣的果子，那结局就是永生。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在你们既然从罪里得了释放，作了神的奴仆，就有成圣的果子，那结局就是永生。
verses.textZhCuv: 但现今，你们既从罪里得了释放，作了神的奴仆，就有成圣的果子，那结局就是永生。
verses.textEnNiv: But now that you have been set free from sin and have become slaves of God, the benefit you reap leads to holiness, and the result is eternal life.
verses.textEnEsv: But now that you have been set free from sin and have become slaves of God, the fruit you get leads to sanctification and its end, eternal life.
verses.textEnNkjv: But now having been set free from sin, and having become slaves of God, you have your fruit to holiness, and the end, everlasting life.
verses.textEnNlt: But now you are free from the power of sin and have become slaves of God. Now you do those things that lead to holiness and result in eternal life.
verses.textEnNasb: But now having been freed from sin and enslaved to God, you derive your benefit, resulting in sanctification, and the outcome, eternal life.
verses.textEn: But now that you have been set free from sin and have become slaves of God, the benefit you reap leads to holiness, and the result is eternal life.

verses.textZh: 因为罪的工价就是死，但神的恩赏，在我们的主基督耶稣里，却是永生。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为罪的工价就是死，但神的恩赏，在我们的主基督耶稣里，却是永生。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为罪的工价乃是死；惟有神的恩赐，在我们的主基督耶稣里，乃是永生。
verses.textEnNiv: For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life through Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: For the wages of sin is death, but the gracious gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.textEn: For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我对懂得律法的人说，你们不晓得律法管辖人，是在他活着的期间吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我对懂得律法的人说，你们不晓得律法管辖人，是在他活着的期间吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我现在对明白律法的人说，你们岂不晓得律法管人是在活着的时候吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Do you not know, brothers and sisters—for I am speaking to those who know the law—that the law has authority over someone only as long as that person lives?
verses.textEnEsv: Or do you not know, brothers —for I am speaking to those who know the law—that the law is binding on a person only as long as he lives?
verses.textEnNkjv: Or do you not know, brethren (for I speak to those who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man as long as he lives?
verses.textEnNlt: Now, dear brothers and sisters —you who are familiar with the law—don’t you know that the law applies only while a person is living?
verses.textEnNasb: Or do you not know, brothers and sisters (for I am speaking to those who know the Law), that the Law has jurisdiction over a person as long as he lives?
verses.textEn: Do you not know, brothers and sisters—for I am speaking to those who know the law—that the law has authority over someone only as long as that person lives?

verses.textZh: 一个已婚的妇人，在丈夫活着的时候，她是受律法约束归属丈夫；丈夫若死了，她就脱离丈夫在律法上的约束。
verses.textZhCnvs: 一个已婚的妇人，在丈夫活着的时候，她是受律法约束归属丈夫；丈夫若死了，她就脱离丈夫在律法上的约束。
verses.textZhCuv: 就如女人有了丈夫，丈夫还活着，就被律法约束；丈夫若死了，就脱离了丈夫的律法。
