verses.textEnNiv: For example, by law a married woman is bound to her husband as long as he is alive, but if her husband dies, she is released from the law that binds her to him.
verses.textEnEsv: For a married woman is bound by law to her husband while he lives, but if her husband dies she is released from the law of marriage.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the woman who has a husband is bound by the law to her husband as long as he lives. But if the husband dies, she is released from the law of her husband.
verses.textEnNlt: For example, when a woman marries, the law binds her to her husband as long as he is alive. But if he dies, the laws of marriage no longer apply to her.
verses.textEnNasb: For the married woman is bound by law to her husband as long as he is alive; but if her husband dies, she is released from the law concerning the husband.
verses.textEn: For example, by law a married woman is bound to her husband as long as he is alive, but if her husband dies, she is released from the law that binds her to him.

verses.textZh: 所以，当丈夫还活着的时候，如果她归属别的男人，就称为淫妇；丈夫若死了，她就脱离了律法的约束，如果她归属别的男人，也不是淫妇。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，当丈夫还活着的时候，如果她归属别的男人，就称为淫妇；丈夫若死了，她就脱离了律法的约束，如果她归属别的男人，也不是淫妇。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以丈夫活着，她若归于别人，便叫淫妇；丈夫若死了，她就脱离了丈夫的律法，虽然归于别人，也不是淫妇。
verses.textEnNiv: So then, if she has sexual relations with another man while her husband is still alive, she is called an adulteress. But if her husband dies, she is released from that law and is not an adulteress if she marries another man.
verses.textEnEsv: Accordingly, she will be called an adulteress if she lives with another man while her husband is alive. But if her husband dies, she is free from that law, and if she marries another man she is not an adulteress.
verses.textEnNkjv: So then if, while her husband lives, she marries another man, she will be called an adulteress; but if her husband dies, she is free from that law, so that she is no adulteress, though she has married another man.
verses.textEnNlt: So while her husband is alive, she would be committing adultery if she married another man. But if her husband dies, she is free from that law and does not commit adultery when she remarries.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, if while her husband is alive she gives herself to another man, she will be called an adulteress; but if her husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is not an adulteress if she gives herself to another man.
verses.textEn: So then, if she has sexual relations with another man while her husband is still alive, she is called an adulteress. But if her husband dies, she is released from that law and is not an adulteress if she marries another man.

verses.textZh: 这样，我的弟兄们，你们借着基督的身体，对律法来说也已经死了，使你们归属另一位，就是那从死人中复活的，为的是要我们结果子给神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，我的弟兄们，你们借着基督的身体，对律法来说也已经死了，使你们归属另一位，就是那从死人中复活的，为的是要我们结果子给神。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的弟兄们，这样说来，你们藉着基督的身体，在律法上也是死了，叫你们归于别人，就是归于那从死里复活的，叫我们结果子给神。
verses.textEnNiv: So, my brothers and sisters, you also died to the law through the body of Christ, that you might belong to another, to him who was raised from the dead, in order that we might bear fruit for God.
verses.textEnEsv: Likewise, my brothers, you also have died to the law through the body of Christ, so that you may belong to another, to him who has been raised from the dead, in order that we may bear fruit for God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, my brethren, you also have become dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you may be married to another—to Him who was raised from the dead, that we should bear fruit to God.
verses.textEnNlt: So, my dear brothers and sisters, this is the point: You died to the power of the law when you died with Christ. And now you are united with the one who was raised from the dead. As a result, we can produce a harvest of good deeds for God.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, my brothers and sisters, you also were put to death in regard to the Law through the body of Christ, so that you might belong to another, to Him who was raised from the dead, in order that we might bear fruit for God.
verses.textEn: So, my brothers and sisters, you also died to the law through the body of Christ, that you might belong to another, to him who was raised from the dead, in order that we might bear fruit for God.

verses.textZh: 我们从前属肉体的时候，罪恶的情欲借着律法在我们的肢体里发动，就结出死亡的果子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们从前属肉体的时候，罪恶的情欲借着律法在我们的肢体里发动，就结出死亡的果子。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我们属肉体的时候，那因律法而生的恶欲就在我们肢体中发动，以致结成死亡的果子。
verses.textEnNiv: For when we were in the realm of the flesh, the sinful passions aroused by the law were at work in us, so that we bore fruit for death.
verses.textEnEsv: For while we were living in the flesh, our sinful passions, aroused by the law, were at work in our members to bear fruit for death.
verses.textEnNkjv: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were aroused by the law were at work in our members to bear fruit to death.
verses.textEnNlt: When we were controlled by our old nature, sinful desires were at work within us, and the law aroused these evil desires that produced a harvest of sinful deeds, resulting in death.
verses.textEnNasb: For while we were in the flesh, the sinful passions, which were brought to light by the Law, were at work in the parts of our body to bear fruit for death.
verses.textEn: For when we were in the realm of the flesh, the sinful passions aroused by the law were at work in us, so that we bore fruit for death.

verses.textZh: 但现在，我们既然向那捆绑我们的律法死了，就脱离了律法的约束，好让我们用心灵的新样子，而不用仪文的旧方式来服事主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但现在，我们既然向那捆绑我们的律法死了，就脱离了律法的约束，好让我们用心灵的新样子，而不用仪文的旧方式来服事主。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我们既然在捆我们的律法上死了，现今就脱离了律法，叫我们服事主，要按着心灵 的新样，不按着仪文的旧样。
verses.textEnNiv: But now, by dying to what once bound us, we have been released from the law so that we serve in the new way of the Spirit, and not in the old way of the written code.
verses.textEnEsv: But now we are released from the law, having died to that which held us captive, so that we serve in the new way of the Spirit and not in the old way of the written code.
verses.textEnNkjv: But now we have been delivered from the law, having died to what we were held by, so that we should serve in the newness of the Spirit and not in the oldness of the letter.
verses.textEnNlt: But now we have been released from the law, for we died to it and are no longer captive to its power. Now we can serve God, not in the old way of obeying the letter of the law, but in the new way of living in the Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: But now we have been released from the Law, having died to that by which we were bound, so that we serve in newness of the Spirit and not in oldness of the letter.
verses.textEn: But now, by dying to what once bound us, we have been released from the law so that we serve in the new way of the Spirit, and not in the old way of the written code.

verses.textZh: 这样，我们可以说甚么呢？难道律法是罪吗？绝对不是。不过，如果不是借着律法，我就不知道甚么是罪；如果不是律法说"不可贪心"，我就不知道甚么是贪心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，我们可以说甚么呢？难道律法是罪吗？绝对不是。不过，如果不是借着律法，我就不知道甚么是罪；如果不是律法说"不可贪心"，我就不知道甚么是贪心。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，我们可说什么呢？律法是罪吗？断乎不是！只是非因律法，我就不知何为罪。非律法说「不可起贪心」，我就不知何为贪心。
verses.textEnNiv: What shall we say, then? Is the law sinful? Certainly not! Nevertheless, I would not have known what sin was had it not been for the law. For I would not have known what coveting really was if the law had not said, "You shall not covet."
verses.textEnEsv: What then shall we say? That the law is sin? By no means! Yet if it had not been for the law, I would not have known sin. For I would not have known what it is to covet if the law had not said, "You shall not covet."
verses.textEnNkjv: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? Certainly not! On the contrary, I would not have known sin except through the law. For I would not have known covetousness unless the law had said, "You shall not covet."
verses.textEnNlt: Well then, am I suggesting that the law of God is sinful? Of course not! In fact, it was the law that showed me my sin. I would never have known that coveting is wrong if the law had not said, "You must not covet."
verses.textEnNasb: What shall we say then? Is the Law sin? Far from it! On the contrary, I would not have come to know sin except through the Law; for I would not have known about coveting if the Law had not said, "You shall not covet."
verses.textEn: What shall we say, then? Is the law sinful? Certainly not! Nevertheless, I would not have known what sin was had it not been for the law. For I would not have known what coveting really was if the law had not said, "You shall not covet."

verses.textZh: 但罪趁着机会，借着诫命在我里面发动各样的贪心，因为没有律法，罪是死的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但罪趁着机会，借着诫命在我里面发动各样的贪心，因为没有律法，罪是死的。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，罪趁着机会，就藉着诫命叫诸般的贪心在我里头发动；因为没有律法，罪是死的。
verses.textEnNiv: But sin, seizing the opportunity afforded by the commandment, produced in me every kind of coveting. For apart from the law, sin was dead.
verses.textEnEsv: But sin, seizing an opportunity through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of covetousness. For apart from the law, sin lies dead.
verses.textEnNkjv: But sin, taking opportunity by the commandment, produced in me all mannerofevil desire. For apart from the law sin was dead.
verses.textEnNlt: But sin used this command to arouse all kinds of covetous desires within me! If there were no law, sin would not have that power.
verses.textEnNasb: But sin, taking an opportunity through the commandment, produced in me coveting of every kind; for apart from the Law sin is dead.
verses.textEn: But sin, seizing the opportunity afforded by the commandment, produced in me every kind of coveting. For apart from the law, sin was dead.

verses.textZh: 在没有律法的时候，我是活的；但诫命一来，罪就活了，我就死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在没有律法的时候，我是活的；但诫命一来，罪就活了，我就死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我以前没有律法是活着的；但是诫命来到，罪又活了，我就死了。
verses.textEnNiv: Once I was alive apart from the law; but when the commandment came, sin sprang to life and I died.
verses.textEnEsv: I was once alive apart from the law, but when the commandment came, sin came alive and I died.
verses.textEnNkjv: I was alive once without the law, but when the commandment came, sin revived and I died.
verses.textEnNlt: At one time I lived without understanding the law. But when I learned the command not to covet, for instance, the power of sin came to life,
verses.textEnNasb: I was once alive apart from the Law; but when the commandment came, sin came to life, and I died;
verses.textEn: Once I was alive apart from the law; but when the commandment came, sin sprang to life and I died.

verses.textZh: 那本来使人活的诫命，反而使我死了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 那本来使人活的诫命，反而使我死了；
verses.textZhCuv: 那本来叫人活的诫命，反倒叫我死；
verses.textEnNiv: I found that the very commandment that was intended to bring life actually brought death.
verses.textEnEsv: The very commandment that promised life proved to be death to me.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the commandment, which was to bring life, I found to bring death.
verses.textEnNlt: and I died. So I discovered that the law’s commands, which were supposed to bring life, brought spiritual death instead.
verses.textEnNasb: and this commandment, which was to result in life, proved to result in death for me;
verses.textEn: I found that the very commandment that was intended to bring life actually brought death.

verses.textZh: 因为罪借着诫命把握着机会来欺骗我，并且杀了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为罪借着诫命把握着机会来欺骗我，并且杀了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为罪趁着机会，就藉着诫命引诱我，并且杀了我。
verses.textEnNiv: For sin, seizing the opportunity afforded by the commandment, deceived me, and through the commandment put me to death.
verses.textEnEsv: For sin, seizing an opportunity through the commandment, deceived me and through it killed me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it killed me.
verses.textEnNlt: Sin took advantage of those commands and deceived me; it used the commands to kill me.
verses.textEnNasb: for sin, taking an opportunity through the commandment, deceived me, and through it, killed me.
verses.textEn: For sin, seizing the opportunity afforded by the commandment, deceived me, and through the commandment put me to death.

verses.textZh: 这样，律法是圣洁的，诫命也是圣洁、公义和良善的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，律法是圣洁的，诫命也是圣洁、公义和良善的。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样看来，律法是圣洁的，诫命也是圣洁、公义、良善的。
verses.textEnNiv: So then, the law is holy, and the commandment is holy, righteous and good.
verses.textEnEsv: So the law is holy, and the commandment is holy and righteous and good.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy and just and good.
verses.textEnNlt: But still, the law itself is holy, and its commands are holy and right and good.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, the Law is holy, and the commandment is holy and righteous and good.
verses.textEn: So then, the law is holy, and the commandment is holy, righteous and good.

verses.textZh: 既是这样，那良善的反而使我死吗？绝对不是！但罪借着那良善的使我死，就显出真是罪，为了要使罪借着诫命变成更加邪恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 既是这样，那良善的反而使我死吗？绝对不是！但罪借着那良善的使我死，就显出真是罪，为了要使罪借着诫命变成更加邪恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 既然如此，那良善的是叫我死吗？断乎不是！叫我死的乃是罪。但罪藉着那良善的叫我死，就显出真是罪，叫罪因着诫命更显出是恶极了。
verses.textEnNiv: Did that which is good, then, become death to me? By no means! Nevertheless, in order that sin might be recognized as sin, it used what is good to bring about my death, so that through the commandment sin might become utterly sinful.
verses.textEnEsv: Did that which is good, then, bring death to me? By no means! It was sin, producing death in me through what is good, in order that sin might be shown to be sin, and through the commandment might become sinful beyond measure.
verses.textEnNkjv: Has then what is good become death to me? Certainly not! But sin, that it might appear sin, was producing death in me through what is good, so that sin through the commandment might become exceedingly sinful.
verses.textEnNlt: But how can that be? Did the law, which is good, cause my death? Of course not! Sin used what was good to bring about my condemnation to death. So we can see how terrible sin really is. It uses God’s good commands for its own evil purposes.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore did that which is good become a cause of death for me? Far from it! Rather it was sin, in order that it might be shown to be sin by bringing about my death through that which is good, so that through the commandment sin would become utterly sinful.
verses.textEn: Did that which is good, then, become death to me? By no means! Nevertheless, in order that sin might be recognized as sin, it used what is good to bring about my death, so that through the commandment sin might become utterly sinful.

verses.textZh: 我们知道律法是属灵的，我却是属肉体的，已经卖给罪了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们知道律法是属灵的，我却是属肉体的，已经卖给罪了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们原晓得律法是属乎灵的，但我是属乎肉体的，是已经卖给罪了。
verses.textEnNiv: We know that the law is spiritual; but I am unspiritual, sold as a slave to sin.
verses.textEnEsv: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am of the flesh, sold under sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am carnal, sold under sin.
verses.textEnNlt: So the trouble is not with the law, for it is spiritual and good. The trouble is with me, for I am all too human, a slave to sin.
verses.textEnNasb: For we know that the Law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold into bondage to sin.
verses.textEn: We know that the law is spiritual; but I am unspiritual, sold as a slave to sin.

verses.textZh: 因为我所作的，我不明白；我所愿意的，我没有去作，我所恨恶的，我倒去作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我所作的，我不明白；我所愿意的，我没有去作，我所恨恶的，我倒去作。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我所做的，我自己不明白；我所愿意的，我并不做；我所恨恶的，我倒去做。
verses.textEnNiv: I do not understand what I do. For what I want to do I do not do, but what I hate I do.
verses.textEnEsv: For I do not understand my own actions. For I do not do what I want, but I do the very thing I hate.
verses.textEnNkjv: For what I am doing, I do not understand. For what I will to do, that I do not practice; but what I hate, that I do.
verses.textEnNlt: I don’t really understand myself, for I want to do what is right, but I don’t do it. Instead, I do what I hate.
verses.textEnNasb: For I do not understand what I am doing; for I am not practicing what I want to do, but I do the very thing I hate.
verses.textEn: I do not understand what I do. For what I want to do I do not do, but what I hate I do.

verses.textZh: 如果我所不愿意的，我倒去作，我就不得不承认律法是好的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我所不愿意的，我倒去作，我就不得不承认律法是好的。
verses.textZhCuv: 若我所做的，是我所不愿意的，我就应承律法是善的。
verses.textEnNiv: And if I do what I do not want to do, I agree that the law is good.
verses.textEnEsv: Now if I do what I do not want, I agree with the law, that it is good.
verses.textEnNkjv: If, then, I do what I will not to do, I agree with the law that itis good.
verses.textEnNlt: But if I know that what I am doing is wrong, this shows that I agree that the law is good.
verses.textEnNasb: However, if I do the very thing I do not want to do, I agree with the Law, that the Law is good.
verses.textEn: And if I do what I do not want to do, I agree that the law is good.

verses.textZh: 既是这样，那就不是我作的，而是住在我里面的罪作的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 既是这样，那就不是我作的，而是住在我里面的罪作的。
verses.textZhCuv: 既是这样，就不是我做的，乃是住在我里头的罪做的。
verses.textEnNiv: As it is, it is no longer I myself who do it, but it is sin living in me.
verses.textEnEsv: So now it is no longer I who do it, but sin that dwells within me.
verses.textEnNkjv: But now, itis no longer I who do it, but sin that dwells in me.
verses.textEnNlt: So I am not the one doing wrong; it is sin living in me that does it.
verses.textEnNasb: But now, no longer am I the one doing it, but sin that dwells in me.
verses.textEn: As it is, it is no longer I myself who do it, but it is sin living in me.

verses.textZh: 我知道在我里面，就是在我肉体之中，没有良善，因为立志行善由得我，行出来却由不得我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我知道在我里面，就是在我肉体之中，没有良善，因为立志行善由得我，行出来却由不得我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我也知道，在我里头，就是我肉体之中，没有良善。因为，立志为善由得我，只是行出来由不得我。
verses.textEnNiv: For I know that good itself does not dwell in me, that is, in my sinful nature. For I have the desire to do what is good, but I cannot carry it out.
verses.textEnEsv: For I know that nothing good dwells in me, that is, in my flesh. For I have the desire to do what is right, but not the ability to carry it out.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh) nothing good dwells; for to will is present with me, but how to perform what is good I do not find.
verses.textEnNlt: And I know that nothing good lives in me, that is, in my sinful nature. I want to do what is right, but I can’t.
verses.textEnNasb: For I know that good does not dwell in me, that is, in my flesh; for the willing is present in me, but the doing of the good is not.
verses.textEn: For I know that good itself does not dwell in me, that is, in my sinful nature. For I have the desire to do what is good, but I cannot carry it out.

verses.textZh: 所以我愿意行的善，我没有去行；我不愿意作的恶，我倒去作了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以我愿意行的善，我没有去行；我不愿意作的恶，我倒去作了。
verses.textZhCuv: 故此，我所愿意的善，我反不做；我所不愿意的恶，我倒去做。
verses.textEnNiv: For I do not do the good I want to do, but the evil I do not want to do—this I keep on doing.
verses.textEnEsv: For I do not do the good I want, but the evil I do not want is what I keep on doing.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the good that I will todo, I do not do; but the evil I will not todo, that I practice.
verses.textEnNlt: I want to do what is good, but I don’t. I don’t want to do what is wrong, but I do it anyway.
verses.textEnNasb: For the good that I want, I do not do, but I practice the very evil that I do not want.
verses.textEn: For I do not do the good I want to do, but the evil I do not want to do—this I keep on doing.

verses.textZh: 我若作自己不愿意作的事，那就不是我作的，而是住在我里面的罪作的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我若作自己不愿意作的事，那就不是我作的，而是住在我里面的罪作的。
verses.textZhCuv: 若我去做所不愿意做的，就不是我做的，乃是住在我里头的罪做的。
verses.textEnNiv: Now if I do what I do not want to do, it is no longer I who do it, but it is sin living in me that does it.
verses.textEnEsv: Now if I do what I do not want, it is no longer I who do it, but sin that dwells within me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now if I do what I will not todo, it is no longer I who do it, but sin that dwells in me.
verses.textEnNlt: But if I do what I don’t want to do, I am not really the one doing wrong; it is sin living in me that does it.
verses.textEnNasb: But if I do the very thing I do not want, I am no longer the one doing it, but sin that dwells in me.
verses.textEn: Now if I do what I do not want to do, it is no longer I who do it, but it is sin living in me that does it.

verses.textZh: 因此，我发现了一个律，就是我想向善的时候，恶就在我里面出现。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我发现了一个律，就是我想向善的时候，恶就在我里面出现。
verses.textZhCuv: 我觉得有个律，就是我愿意为善的时候，便有恶与我同在。
verses.textEnNiv: So I find this law at work: Although I want to do good, evil is right there with me.
verses.textEnEsv: So I find it to be a law that when I want to do right, evil lies close at hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: I find then a law, that evil is present with me, the one who wills to do good.
verses.textEnNlt: I have discovered this principle of life—that when I want to do what is right, I inevitably do what is wrong.
verses.textEnNasb: I find then the principle that evil is present in me, the one who wants to do good.
verses.textEn: So I find this law at work: Although I want to do good, evil is right there with me.

verses.textZh: 按着我里面的人来说，我是喜欢神的律，
verses.textZhCnvs: 按着我里面的人来说，我是喜欢神的律，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为按着我里面的意思 ，我是喜欢神的律；
verses.textEnNiv: For in my inner being I delight in God’s law;
verses.textEnEsv: For I delight in the law of God, in my inner being,
verses.textEnNkjv: For I delight in the law of God according to the inward man.
verses.textEnNlt: I love God’s law with all my heart.
verses.textEnNasb: For I joyfully agree with the law of God in the inner person,
verses.textEn: For in my inner being I delight in God’s law;

verses.textZh: 但我发觉肢体中另有一个律，和我心中的律争战，把我掳去附从肢体中的罪律。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但我发觉肢体中另有一个律，和我心中的律争战，把我掳去附从肢体中的罪律。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我觉得肢体中另有个律和我心中的律交战，把我掳去，叫我附从那肢体中犯罪的律。
verses.textEnNiv: but I see another law at work in me, waging war against the law of my mind and making me a prisoner of the law of sin at work within me.
verses.textEnEsv: but I see in my members another law waging war against the law of my mind and making me captive to the law of sin that dwells in my members.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.
verses.textEnNlt: But there is another power within me that is at war with my mind. This power makes me a slave to the sin that is still within me.
verses.textEnNasb: but I see a different law in the parts of my body waging war against the law of my mind, and making me a prisoner of the law of sin, the law which is in my body’s parts.
verses.textEn: but I see another law at work in me, waging war against the law of my mind and making me a prisoner of the law of sin at work within me.

verses.textZh: 我这个人真是苦啊！谁能救我脱离这使我死亡的身体呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我这个人真是苦啊！谁能救我脱离这使我死亡的身体呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我真是苦啊！谁能救我脱离这取死的身体呢？
verses.textEnNiv: What a wretched man I am! Who will rescue me from this body that is subject to death?
verses.textEnEsv: Wretched man that I am! Who will deliver me from this body of death?
verses.textEnNkjv: O wretched man that I am! Who will deliver me from this body of death?
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, what a miserable person I am! Who will free me from this life that is dominated by sin and death?
verses.textEnNasb: Wretched man that I am! Who will set me free from the body of this death?
verses.textEn: What a wretched man I am! Who will rescue me from this body that is subject to death?

verses.textZh: 感谢神，借着我们的主耶稣基督就能脱离了。可见，一方面我自己心里服事神的律，另一方面我的肉体却服事罪的律。
verses.textZhCnvs: 感谢神，借着我们的主耶稣基督就能脱离了。可见，一方面我自己心里服事神的律，另一方面我的肉体却服事罪的律。
verses.textZhCuv: 感谢神，靠着我们的主耶稣基督就能脱离了。这样看来，我以内心顺服神的律，我肉体却顺服罪的律了。
verses.textEnNiv: Thanks be to God, who delivers me through Jesus Christ our Lord! So then, I myself in my mind am a slave to God’s law, but in my sinful nature a slave to the law of sin.
verses.textEnEsv: Thanks be to God through Jesus Christ our Lord! So then, I myself serve the law of God with my mind, but with my flesh I serve the law of sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: I thank God—through Jesus Christ our Lord! So then, with the mind I myself serve the law of God, but with the flesh the law of sin.
verses.textEnNlt: Thank God! The answer is in Jesus Christ our Lord. So you see how it is: In my mind I really want to obey God’s law, but because of my sinful nature I am a slave to sin.
verses.textEnNasb: Thanks be to God through Jesus Christ our Lord! So then, on the one hand I myself with my mind am serving the law of God, but on the other, with my flesh the law of sin.
verses.textEn: Thanks be to God, who delivers me through Jesus Christ our Lord! So then, I myself in my mind am a slave to God’s law, but in my sinful nature a slave to the law of sin.

verses.textZh: 所以现在，那些在耶稣基督里的人就不被定罪了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以现在，那些在耶稣基督里的人就不被定罪了；
verses.textZhCuv: 如今，那些在基督耶稣里的就不定罪了。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus,
verses.textEnEsv: There is therefore now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thereis therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who do not walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: So now there is no condemnation for those who belong to Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore there is now no condemnation at all for those who are in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEn: Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus,

verses.textZh: 因为生命之灵的律在基督耶稣里使我自由，脱离了罪和死的律。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为生命之灵的律在基督耶稣里使我自由，脱离了罪和死的律。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为赐生命圣灵的律，在基督耶稣里释放了我，使我脱离罪和死的律了。
verses.textEnNiv: because through Christ Jesus the law of the Spirit who gives life has set you free from the law of sin and death.
verses.textEnEsv: For the law of the Spirit of life has set you free in Christ Jesus from the law of sin and death.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus has made me free from the law of sin and death.
verses.textEnNlt: And because you belong to him, the power of the life-giving Spirit has freed you from the power of sin that leads to death.
verses.textEnNasb: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus has set you free from the law of sin and of death.
verses.textEn: because through Christ Jesus the law of the Spirit who gives life has set you free from the law of sin and death.

verses.textZh: 律法是因肉体而软弱无力，所作不到的，神作到了：他差遣自己的儿子成为罪身的样式，为了除掉罪，就在肉体中把罪判决了，
verses.textZhCnvs: 律法是因肉体而软弱无力，所作不到的，神作到了：他差遣自己的儿子成为罪身的样式，为了除掉罪，就在肉体中把罪判决了，
verses.textZhCuv: 律法既因肉体软弱，有所不能行的，神就差遣自己的儿子，成为罪身的形状，作了赎罪祭，在肉体中定了罪案，
verses.textEnNiv: For what the law was powerless to do because it was weakened by the flesh, God did by sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh to be a sin offering. And so he condemned sin in the flesh,
verses.textEnEsv: For God has done what the law, weakened by the flesh, could not do. By sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh,
verses.textEnNkjv: For what the law could not do in that it was weak through the flesh, God did by sending His own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, on account of sin: He condemned sin in the flesh,
verses.textEnNlt: The law of Moses was unable to save us because of the weakness of our sinful nature. So God did what the law could not do. He sent his own Son in a body like the bodies we sinners have. And in that body God declared an end to sin’s control over us by giving his Son as a sacrifice for our sins.
verses.textEnNasb: For what the Law could not do, weak as it was through the flesh, God did: sending His own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and as an offering for sin, He condemned sin in the flesh,
verses.textEn: For what the law was powerless to do because it was weakened by the flesh, God did by sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh to be a sin offering. And so he condemned sin in the flesh,

verses.textZh: 使律法所要求的义，可以在我们这些不随从肉体而随从圣灵去行的人身上实现出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使律法所要求的义，可以在我们这些不随从肉体而随从圣灵去行的人身上实现出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 使律法的义成就在我们这不随从肉体、只随从圣灵的人身上。
verses.textEnNiv: in order that the righteous requirement of the law might be fully met in us, who do not live according to the flesh but according to the Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: in order that the righteous requirement of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not according to the flesh but according to the Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: that the righteous requirement of the law might be fulfilled in us who do not walk according to the flesh but according to the Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: He did this so that the just requirement of the law would be fully satisfied for us, who no longer follow our sinful nature but instead follow the Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: so that the requirement of the Law might be fulfilled in us who do not walk according to the flesh but according to the Spirit.
verses.textEn: in order that the righteous requirement of the law might be fully met in us, who do not live according to the flesh but according to the Spirit.

verses.textZh: 随从肉体的人，以肉体的事为念；随从圣灵的人，以圣灵的事为念。
verses.textZhCnvs: 随从肉体的人，以肉体的事为念；随从圣灵的人，以圣灵的事为念。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，随从肉体的人体贴肉体的事；随从圣灵的人体贴圣灵的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who live according to the flesh have their minds set on what the flesh desires; but those who live in accordance with the Spirit have their minds set on what the Spirit desires.
verses.textEnEsv: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit set their minds on the things of the Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those wholive according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who are dominated by the sinful nature think about sinful things, but those who are controlled by the Holy Spirit think about things that please the Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: For those who are in accord with the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who are in accord with the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.
verses.textEn: Those who live according to the flesh have their minds set on what the flesh desires; but those who live in accordance with the Spirit have their minds set on what the Spirit desires.

verses.textZh: 以肉体为念就是死，以圣灵为念就是生命、平安；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以肉体为念就是死，以圣灵为念就是生命、平安；
verses.textZhCuv: 体贴肉体的，就是死；体贴圣灵的，乃是生命、平安。
verses.textEnNiv: The mind governed by the flesh is death, but the mind governed by the Spirit is life and peace.
verses.textEnEsv: For to set the mind on the flesh is death, but to set the mind on the Spirit is life and peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: For to be carnally minded is death, but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.
verses.textEnNlt: So letting your sinful nature control your mind leads to death. But letting the Spirit control your mind leads to life and peace.
verses.textEnNasb: For the mind set on the flesh is death, but the mind set on the Spirit is life and peace,
verses.textEn: The mind governed by the flesh is death, but the mind governed by the Spirit is life and peace.

verses.textZh: 因为以肉体为念就是与神为仇，既不服从神的律法，也的确不能够服从；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为以肉体为念就是与神为仇，既不服从神的律法，也的确不能够服从；
verses.textZhCuv: 原来体贴肉体的，就是与神为仇；因为不服神的律法，也是不能服，
verses.textEnNiv: The mind governed by the flesh is hostile to God; it does not submit to God’s law, nor can it do so.
verses.textEnEsv: For the mind that is set on the flesh is hostile to God, for it does not submit to God’s law; indeed, it cannot.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God; for it is not subject to the law of God, nor indeed can be.
verses.textEnNlt: For the sinful nature is always hostile to God. It never did obey God’s laws, and it never will.
verses.textEnNasb: because the mind set on the flesh is hostile toward God; for it does not subject itself to the law of God, for it is not even able to do so,
verses.textEn: The mind governed by the flesh is hostile to God; it does not submit to God’s law, nor can it do so.

verses.textZh: 属肉体的人不能得神的喜悦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 属肉体的人不能得神的喜悦。
verses.textZhCuv: 而且属肉体的人不能得神的喜欢。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who are in the realm of the flesh cannot please God.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who are in the flesh cannot please God.
verses.textEnNkjv: So then, those who are in the flesh cannot please God.
verses.textEnNlt: That’s why those who are still under the control of their sinful nature can never please God.
verses.textEnNasb: and those who are in the flesh cannot please God.
verses.textEn: Those who are in the realm of the flesh cannot please God.

verses.textZh: 神的灵既然住在你们里面，你们就不是属于肉体，而是属于圣灵的了。如果人没有基督的灵，就不是属于基督的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的灵既然住在你们里面，你们就不是属于肉体，而是属于圣灵的了。如果人没有基督的灵，就不是属于基督的。
verses.textZhCuv: 如果神的灵住在你们心里，你们就不属肉体，乃属圣灵了。人若没有基督的灵，就不是属基督的。
verses.textEnNiv: You, however, are not in the realm of the flesh but are in the realm of the Spirit, if indeed the Spirit of God lives in you. And if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, they do not belong to Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: You, however, are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if in fact the Spirit of God dwells in you. Anyone who does not have the Spirit of Christ does not belong to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if indeed the Spirit of God dwells in you. Now if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, he is not His.
verses.textEnNlt: But you are not controlled by your sinful nature. You are controlled by the Spirit if you have the Spirit of God living in you. (And remember that those who do not have the Spirit of Christ living in them do not belong to him at all.)
verses.textEnNasb: However, you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if indeed the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, he does not belong to Him.
verses.textEn: You, however, are not in the realm of the flesh but are in the realm of the Spirit, if indeed the Spirit of God lives in you. And if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, they do not belong to Christ.

verses.textZh: 基督若在你们里面，你们的身体因着罪的缘故是死的，而圣灵却因着义的缘故赐给你们生命。
verses.textZhCnvs: 基督若在你们里面，你们的身体因着罪的缘故是死的，而圣灵却因着义的缘故赐给你们生命。
verses.textZhCuv: 基督若在你们心里，身体就因罪而死，心灵却因义而活。
verses.textEnNiv: But if Christ is in you, then even though your body is subject to death because of sin, the Spirit gives life because of righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: But if Christ is in you, although the body is dead because of sin, the Spirit is life because of righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: And Christ lives within you, so even though your body will die because of sin, the Spirit gives you life because you have been made right with God.
verses.textEnNasb: If Christ is in you, though the body is dead because of sin, yet the spirit is alive because of righteousness.
verses.textEn: But if Christ is in you, then even though your body is subject to death because of sin, the Spirit gives life because of righteousness.

verses.textZh: 如果那使耶稣从死人中复活者的灵住在你们里面，那使基督从死人中复活的，也必借着住在你们里面的圣灵，使你们必死的身体活过来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果那使耶稣从死人中复活者的灵住在你们里面，那使基督从死人中复活的，也必借着住在你们里面的圣灵，使你们必死的身体活过来。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，叫耶稣从死里复活者的灵若住在你们心里，那叫基督耶稣从死里复活的，也必藉着住在你们心里的圣灵，使你们必死的身体又活过来。
verses.textEnNiv: And if the Spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, he who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies because of his Spirit who lives in you.
verses.textEnEsv: If the Spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if the Spirit of Him who raised Jesus from the dead dwells in you, He who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through His Spirit who dwells in you.
verses.textEnNlt: The Spirit of God, who raised Jesus from the dead, lives in you. And just as God raised Christ Jesus from the dead, he will give life to your mortal bodies by this same Spirit living within you.
verses.textEnNasb: But if the Spirit of Him who raised Jesus from the dead dwells in you, He who raised Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through His Spirit who dwells in you.
verses.textEn: And if the Spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, he who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies because of his Spirit who lives in you.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，可见我们并不是欠肉体的债，随着肉体而活。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，可见我们并不是欠肉体的债，随着肉体而活。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，这样看来，我们并不是欠肉体的债去顺从肉体活着。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, brothers and sisters, we have an obligation—but it is not to the flesh, to live according to it.
verses.textEnEsv: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live according to the flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors—not to the flesh, to live according to the flesh.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, dear brothers and sisters, you have no obligation to do what your sinful nature urges you to do.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, brothers and sisters, we are under obligation, not to the flesh, to live according to the flesh—
verses.textEn: Therefore, brothers and sisters, we have an obligation—but it is not to the flesh, to live according to it.

verses.textZh: 如果随着肉体而活，你们必定死；如果靠着圣灵治死身体的恶行，你们就必活着。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果随着肉体而活，你们必定死；如果靠着圣灵治死身体的恶行，你们就必活着。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若顺从肉体活着，必要死；若靠着圣灵治死身体的恶行，必要活着。
verses.textEnNiv: For if you live according to the flesh, you will die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the misdeeds of the body, you will live.
verses.textEnEsv: For if you live according to the flesh you will die, but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if you live according to the flesh you will die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
verses.textEnNlt: For if you live by its dictates, you will die. But if through the power of the Spirit you put to death the deeds of your sinful nature, you will live.
verses.textEnNasb: for if you are living in accord with the flesh, you are going to die; but if by the Spirit you are putting to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
verses.textEn: For if you live according to the flesh, you will die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the misdeeds of the body, you will live.

verses.textZh: 因为蒙神的灵引导的，都是神的儿子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为蒙神的灵引导的，都是神的儿子。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为凡被神的灵引导的，都是神的儿子。
verses.textEnNiv: For those who are led by the Spirit of God are the children of God.
verses.textEnEsv: For all who are led by the Spirit of God are sons of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are sons of God.
verses.textEnNlt: For all who are led by the Spirit of God are children of God.
verses.textEnNasb: For all who are being led by the Spirit of God, these are sons and daughters of God.
verses.textEn: For those who are led by the Spirit of God are the children of God.

verses.textZh: 你们接受的，不是奴仆的灵，使你们仍旧惧怕；你们接受的，是使人成为嗣子的灵，使我们呼叫"阿爸、父"。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们接受的，不是奴仆的灵，使你们仍旧惧怕；你们接受的，是使人成为嗣子的灵，使我们呼叫"阿爸、父"。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们所受的，不是奴仆的心，仍旧害怕；所受的，乃是儿子的心，因此我们呼叫：「阿爸！父！」
verses.textEnNiv: The Spirit you received does not make you slaves, so that you live in fear again; rather, the Spirit you received brought about your adoption to sonship. And by him we cry, "Abba, Father."
verses.textEnEsv: For you did not receive the spirit of slavery to fall back into fear, but you have received the Spirit of adoption as sons, by whom we cry, "Abba! Father!"
verses.textEnNkjv: For you did not receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption by whom we cry out, "Abba, Father."
verses.textEnNlt: So you have not received a spirit that makes you fearful slaves. Instead, you received God’s Spirit when he adopted you as his own children. Now we call him, "Abba, Father."
verses.textEnNasb: For you have not received a spirit of slavery leading to fear again, but you have received a spirit of adoption as sons and daughters by which we cry out, "Abba! Father!"
verses.textEn: The Spirit you received does not make you slaves, so that you live in fear again; rather, the Spirit you received brought about your adoption to sonship. And by him we cry, "Abba, Father."

verses.textZh: 圣灵亲自和我们的灵一同证明我们是神的儿女。
verses.textZhCnvs: 圣灵亲自和我们的灵一同证明我们是神的儿女。
verses.textZhCuv: 圣灵与我们的心同证我们是神的儿女；
verses.textEnNiv: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are God’s children.
verses.textEnEsv: The Spirit himself bears witness with our spirit that we are children of God,
verses.textEnNkjv: The Spirit Himself bears witness with our spirit that we are children of God,
verses.textEnNlt: For his Spirit joins with our spirit to affirm that we are God’s children.
verses.textEnNasb: The Spirit Himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God,
verses.textEn: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are God’s children.

verses.textZh: 既然是儿女，就是后嗣；是神的后嗣，也和基督一同作后嗣。我们既然和他一同受苦，就必和他一同得荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 既然是儿女，就是后嗣；是神的后嗣，也和基督一同作后嗣。我们既然和他一同受苦，就必和他一同得荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 既是儿女，便是后嗣，就是神的后嗣，和基督同作后嗣。如果我们和他一同受苦，也必和他一同得荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: Now if we are children, then we are heirs—heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ, if indeed we share in his sufferings in order that we may also share in his glory.
verses.textEnEsv: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and fellow heirs with Christ, provided we suffer with him in order that we may also be glorified with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with Him, that we may also be glorified together.
verses.textEnNlt: And since we are his children, we are his heirs. In fact, together with Christ we are heirs of God’s glory. But if we are to share his glory, we must also share his suffering.
verses.textEnNasb: and if children, heirs also, heirs of God and fellow heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with Him so that we may also be glorified with Him.
verses.textEn: Now if we are children, then we are heirs—heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ, if indeed we share in his sufferings in order that we may also share in his glory.

verses.textZh: 我看现在的苦难，与将要向我们显出的荣耀，是无法相比的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看现在的苦难，与将要向我们显出的荣耀，是无法相比的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我想，现在的苦楚若比起将来要显于我们的荣耀就不足介意了。
verses.textEnNiv: I consider that our present sufferings are not worth comparing with the glory that will be revealed in us.
verses.textEnEsv: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worth comparing with the glory that is to be revealed to us.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy tobecompared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
verses.textEnNlt: Yet what we suffer now is nothing compared to the glory he will reveal to us later.
verses.textEnNasb: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory that is to be revealed to us.
verses.textEn: I consider that our present sufferings are not worth comparing with the glory that will be revealed in us.

verses.textZh: 被造的万物都热切渴望神的众子显现出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 被造的万物都热切渴望神的众子显现出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 受造之物切望等候神的众子显出来。
verses.textEnNiv: For the creation waits in eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.
verses.textEnEsv: For the creation waits with eager longing for the revealing of the sons of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the earnest expectation of the creation eagerly waits for the revealing of the sons of God.
verses.textEnNlt: For all creation is waiting eagerly for that future day when God will reveal who his children really are.
verses.textEnNasb: For the eagerly awaiting creation waits for the revealing of the sons and daughters of God.
verses.textEn: For the creation waits in eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.

verses.textZh: 因为被造的万物服在虚空之下，不是自己愿意这样，而是由于使它屈服的那一位；
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为被造的万物服在虚空之下，不是自己愿意这样，而是由于使它屈服的那一位；
verses.textZhCuv: 因为受造之物服在虚空之下，不是自己愿意，乃是因那叫他如此的。
verses.textEnNiv: For the creation was subjected to frustration, not by its own choice, but by the will of the one who subjected it, in hope
verses.textEnEsv: For the creation was subjected to futility, not willingly, but because of him who subjected it, in hope
verses.textEnNkjv: For the creation was subjected to futility, not willingly, but because of Him who subjected it in hope;
verses.textEnNlt: Against its will, all creation was subjected to God’s curse. But with eager hope,
verses.textEnNasb: For the creation was subjected to futility, not willingly, but because of Him who subjected it, in hope
verses.textEn: For the creation was subjected to frustration, not by its own choice, but by the will of the one who subjected it, in hope

verses.textZh: 被造的万物盼望自己得着释放，脱离败坏的奴役，得着神儿女荣耀的自由。
verses.textZhCnvs: 被造的万物盼望自己得着释放，脱离败坏的奴役，得着神儿女荣耀的自由。
verses.textZhCuv: 但受造之物仍然指望脱离败坏的辖制，得享神儿女自由的荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: that the creation itself will be liberated from its bondage to decay and brought into the freedom and glory of the children of God.
verses.textEnEsv: that the creation itself will be set free from its bondage to corruption and obtain the freedom of the glory of the children of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: because the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.
verses.textEnNlt: the creation looks forward to the day when it will join God’s children in glorious freedom from death and decay.
verses.textEnNasb: that the creation itself also will be set free from its slavery to corruption into the freedom of the glory of the children of God.
verses.textEn: that the creation itself will be liberated from its bondage to decay and brought into the freedom and glory of the children of God.

verses.textZh: 我们知道被造的万物直到现在都一同在痛苦呻吟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们知道被造的万物直到现在都一同在痛苦呻吟。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息，劳苦，直到如今。
verses.textEnNiv: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verses.textEnEsv: For we know that the whole creation has been groaning together in the pains of childbirth until now.
verses.textEnNkjv: For we know that the whole creation groans and labors with birth pangs together until now.
verses.textEnNlt: For we know that all creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verses.textEnNasb: For we know that the whole creation groans and suffers the pains of childbirth together until now.
verses.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.

verses.textZh: 不但这样，连我们这些有圣灵作为初熟果子的人，自己也在内心叹息，热切期待成为嗣子，就是我们的身体得赎。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不但这样，连我们这些有圣灵作为初熟果子的人，自己也在内心叹息，热切期待成为嗣子，就是我们的身体得赎。
verses.textZhCuv: 不但如此，就是我们这有圣灵初结果子的，也是自己心里叹息，等候得着儿子的名分，乃是我们的身体得赎。
verses.textEnNiv: Not only so, but we ourselves, who have the firstfruits of the Spirit, groan inwardly as we wait eagerly for our adoption to sonship, the redemption of our bodies.
verses.textEnEsv: And not only the creation, but we ourselves, who have the firstfruits of the Spirit, groan inwardly as we wait eagerly for adoption as sons, the redemption of our bodies.
verses.textEnNkjv: Not only that, but we also who have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, eagerly waiting for the adoption, the redemption of our body.
verses.textEnNlt: And we believers also groan, even though we have the Holy Spirit within us as a foretaste of future glory, for we long for our bodies to be released from sin and suffering. We, too, wait with eager hope for the day when God will give us our full rights as his adopted children, including the new bodies he has promised us.
verses.textEnNasb: And not only that, but also we ourselves, having the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting eagerly for our adoption as sons and daughters, the redemption of our body.
verses.textEn: Not only so, but we ourselves, who have the firstfruits of the Spirit, groan inwardly as we wait eagerly for our adoption to sonship, the redemption of our bodies.

verses.textZh: 我们得救时就存着这盼望；但是看得见的盼望不是盼望，因为谁会盼望自己看见了的呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们得救时就存着这盼望；但是看得见的盼望不是盼望，因为谁会盼望自己看见了的呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我们得救是在乎盼望；只是所见的盼望不是盼望，谁还盼望他所见的呢 ？
verses.textEnNiv: For in this hope we were saved. But hope that is seen is no hope at all. Who hopes for what they already have?
verses.textEnEsv: For in this hope we were saved. Now hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for what he sees?
verses.textEnNkjv: For we were saved in this hope, but hope that is seen is not hope; for why does one still hope for what he sees?
verses.textEnNlt: We were given this hope when we were saved. (If we already have something, we don’t need to hope for it.
verses.textEnNasb: For in hope we have been saved, but hope that is seen is not hope; for who hopes for what he already sees?
verses.textEn: For in this hope we were saved. But hope that is seen is no hope at all. Who hopes for what they already have?

verses.textZh: 但如果我们盼望没有看见的，就会耐心地热切期待。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但如果我们盼望没有看见的，就会耐心地热切期待。
verses.textZhCuv: 但我们若盼望那所不见的，就必忍耐等候。
verses.textEnNiv: But if we hope for what we do not yet have, we wait for it patiently.
verses.textEnEsv: But if we hope for what we do not see, we wait for it with patience.
verses.textEnNkjv: But if we hope for what we do not see, we eagerly wait for it with perseverance.
verses.textEnNlt: But if we look forward to something we don’t yet have, we must wait patiently and confidently.)
verses.textEnNasb: But if we hope for what we do not see, through perseverance we wait eagerly for it.
verses.textEn: But if we hope for what we do not yet have, we wait for it patiently.

verses.textZh: 照样，圣灵也在我们的软弱上帮助我们。原来我们不晓得应当怎样祷告，但圣灵亲自用不可言喻的叹息，替我们祈求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，圣灵也在我们的软弱上帮助我们。原来我们不晓得应当怎样祷告，但圣灵亲自用不可言喻的叹息，替我们祈求。
verses.textZhCuv: 况且，我们的软弱有圣灵帮助；我们本不晓得当怎样祷告，只是圣灵亲自用说不出来的叹息替我们祷告。
verses.textEnNiv: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. We do not know what we ought to pray for, but the Spirit himself intercedes for us through wordless groans.
verses.textEnEsv: Likewise the Spirit helps us in our weakness. For we do not know what to pray for as we ought, but the Spirit himself intercedes for us with groanings too deep for words.
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise the Spirit also helps in our weaknesses. For we do not know what we should pray for as we ought, but the Spirit Himself makes intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Holy Spirit helps us in our weakness. For example, we don’t know what God wants us to pray for. But the Holy Spirit prays for us with groanings that cannot be expressed in words.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the same way the Spirit also helps our weakness; for we do not know what to pray for as we should, but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us with groanings too deep for words;
verses.textEn: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. We do not know what we ought to pray for, but the Spirit himself intercedes for us through wordless groans.

verses.textZh: 那鉴察人心的，晓得圣灵的心意，因为圣灵照着神的旨意替圣徒祈求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那鉴察人心的，晓得圣灵的心意，因为圣灵照着神的旨意替圣徒祈求。
verses.textZhCuv: 鉴察人心的，晓得圣灵的意思，因为圣灵照着神的旨意替圣徒祈求。
verses.textEnNiv: And he who searches our hearts knows the mind of the Spirit, because the Spirit intercedes for God’s people in accordance with the will of God.
verses.textEnEsv: And he who searches hearts knows what is the mind of the Spirit, because the Spirit intercedes for the saints according to the will of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now He who searches the hearts knows what the mind of the Spirit is, because He makes intercession for the saints according to thewillof God.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Father who knows all hearts knows what the Spirit is saying, for the Spirit pleads for us believers in harmony with God’s own will.
verses.textEnNasb: and He who searches the hearts knows what the mind of the Spirit is, because He intercedes for the saints according to the will of God.
verses.textEn: And he who searches our hearts knows the mind of the Spirit, because the Spirit intercedes for God’s people in accordance with the will of God.

verses.textZh: 我们知道，为了爱神的人，就是按他旨意蒙召的人的益处，万事都一同效力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们知道，为了爱神的人，就是按他旨意蒙召的人的益处，万事都一同效力。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们晓得万事都互相效力，叫爱神的人得益处，就是按他旨意被召的人。
verses.textEnNiv: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.
verses.textEnEsv: And we know that for those who love God all things work together for good, for those who are called according to his purpose.
verses.textEnNkjv: And we know that all things work together for good to those who love God, to those who are the called according to His purpose.
verses.textEnNlt: And we know that God causes everything to work together for the good of those who love God and are called according to his purpose for them.
verses.textEnNasb: And we know that God causes all things to work together for good to those who love God, to those who are called according to His purpose.
verses.textEn: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.

verses.textZh: 因为神预先知道的人，他就预先命定他们和他儿子的形象一模一样，使他的儿子在许多弟兄中作长子，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神预先知道的人，他就预先命定他们和他儿子的形象一模一样，使他的儿子在许多弟兄中作长子，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他预先所知道的人，就预先定下效法他儿子的模样，使他儿子在许多弟兄中作长子。
verses.textEnNiv: For those God foreknew he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers and sisters.
verses.textEnEsv: For those whom he foreknew he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, in order that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.
verses.textEnNkjv: For whom He foreknew, He also predestined tobe conformed to the image of His Son, that He might be the firstborn among many brethren.
verses.textEnNlt: For God knew his people in advance, and he chose them to become like his Son, so that his Son would be the firstborn among many brothers and sisters.
verses.textEnNasb: For those whom He foreknew, He also predestined to become conformed to the image of His Son, so that He would be the firstborn among many brothers and sisters;
verses.textEn: For those God foreknew he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers and sisters.

verses.textZh: 他预先命定的人，又呼召他们；所召来的人，又称他们为义；所称为义的人，又使他们得荣耀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他预先命定的人，又呼召他们；所召来的人，又称他们为义；所称为义的人，又使他们得荣耀。
verses.textZhCuv: 预先所定下的人又召他们来；所召来的人又称他们为义；所称为义的人又叫他们得荣耀。
verses.textEnNiv: And those he predestined, he also called; those he called, he also justified; those he justified, he also glorified.
verses.textEnEsv: And those whom he predestined he also called, and those whom he called he also justified, and those whom he justified he also glorified.
verses.textEnNkjv: Moreover whom He predestined, these He also called; whom He called, these He also justified; and whom He justified, these He also glorified.
verses.textEnNlt: And having chosen them, he called them to come to him. And having called them, he gave them right standing with himself. And having given them right standing, he gave them his glory.
verses.textEnNasb: and these whom He predestined, He also called; and these whom He called, He also justified; and these whom He justified, He also glorified.
verses.textEn: And those he predestined, he also called; those he called, he also justified; those he justified, he also glorified.

verses.textZh: 既是这样，我们对这一切还有甚么话说呢？神若这样为我们，谁能敌对我们呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 既是这样，我们对这一切还有甚么话说呢？神若这样为我们，谁能敌对我们呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 既是这样，还有什么说的呢？神若帮助我们，谁能敌挡我们呢？
verses.textEnNiv: What, then, shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
verses.textEnEsv: What then shall we say to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
verses.textEnNkjv: What then shall we say to these things? If God is for us, who canbe against us?
verses.textEnNlt: What shall we say about such wonderful things as these? If God is for us, who can ever be against us?
verses.textEnNasb: What then shall we say to these things? If God is for us, who is against us?
verses.textEn: What, then, shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

verses.textZh: 他连自己的儿子都舍得，为我们众人把他交出来，难道不也把万有和他一同白白地赐给我们吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他连自己的儿子都舍得，为我们众人把他交出来，难道不也把万有和他一同白白地赐给我们吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 神既不爱惜自己的儿子，为我们众人舍了，岂不也把万物和他一同白白地赐给我们吗？
verses.textEnNiv: He who did not spare his own Son, but gave him up for us all—how will he not also, along with him, graciously give us all things?
verses.textEnEsv: He who did not spare his own Son but gave him up for us all, how will he not also with him graciously give us all things?
verses.textEnNkjv: He who did not spare His own Son, but delivered Him up for us all, how shall He not with Him also freely give us all things?
verses.textEnNlt: Since he did not spare even his own Son but gave him up for us all, won’t he also give us everything else?
verses.textEnNasb: He who did not spare His own Son, but delivered Him over for us all, how will He not also with Him freely give us all things?
verses.textEn: He who did not spare his own Son, but gave him up for us all—how will he not also, along with him, graciously give us all things?

verses.textZh: 谁能控告神拣选的人呢？有神称我们为义了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁能控告神拣选的人呢？有神称我们为义了。
verses.textZhCuv: 谁能控告神所拣选的人呢？有神称他们为义了 。
verses.textEnNiv: Who will bring any charge against those whom God has chosen? It is God who justifies.
verses.textEnEsv: Who shall bring any charge against God’s elect? It is God who justifies.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who shall bring a charge against God’s elect? Itis God who justifies.
verses.textEnNlt: Who dares accuse us whom God has chosen for his own? No one—for God himself has given us right standing with himself.
verses.textEnNasb: Who will bring charges against God’s elect? God is the one who justifies;
verses.textEn: Who will bring any charge against those whom God has chosen? It is God who justifies.

verses.textZh: 谁能定我们的罪呢？有基督耶稣死了，而且复活了，现今在神的右边，也替我们祈求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁能定我们的罪呢？有基督耶稣死了，而且复活了，现今在神的右边，也替我们祈求。
verses.textZhCuv: 谁能定他们的罪呢？有基督耶稣已经死了，而且从死里复活，现今在神的右边，也替我们祈求 。
verses.textEnNiv: Who then is the one who condemns? No one. Christ Jesus who died—more than that, who was raised to life—is at the right hand of God and is also interceding for us.
verses.textEnEsv: Who is to condemn? Christ Jesus is the one who died—more than that, who was raised— who is at the right hand of God, who indeed is interceding for us.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who is he who condemns? Itis Christ who died, and furthermore is also risen, who is even at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.
verses.textEnNlt: Who then will condemn us? No one—for Christ Jesus died for us and was raised to life for us, and he is sitting in the place of honor at God’s right hand, pleading for us.
verses.textEnNasb: who is the one who condemns? Christ Jesus is He who died, but rather, was raised, who is at the right hand of God, who also intercedes for us.
verses.textEn: Who then is the one who condemns? No one. Christ Jesus who died—more than that, who was raised to life—is at the right hand of God and is also interceding for us.

verses.textZh: 谁能使我们与基督的爱隔绝呢？是患难吗？是困苦吗？是迫害吗？是饥饿吗？是赤身露体吗？是危险吗？是刀剑吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 谁能使我们与基督的爱隔绝呢？是患难吗？是困苦吗？是迫害吗？是饥饿吗？是赤身露体吗？是危险吗？是刀剑吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 谁能使我们与基督的爱隔绝呢？难道是患难吗？是困苦吗？是逼迫吗？是饥饿吗？是赤身露体吗？是危险吗？是刀剑吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall trouble or hardship or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?
verses.textEnEsv: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or danger, or sword?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
verses.textEnNlt: Can anything ever separate us from Christ’s love? Does it mean he no longer loves us if we have trouble or calamity, or are persecuted, or hungry, or destitute, or in danger, or threatened with death?
verses.textEnNasb: Who will separate us from the love of Christ? Will tribulation, or trouble, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or danger, or sword?
verses.textEn: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Shall trouble or hardship or persecution or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?

verses.textZh: 正如经上所记： "为你的缘故，我们终日面对死亡， 人看我们像待宰的羊。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 正如经上所记： "为你的缘故，我们终日面对死亡， 人看我们像待宰的羊。"
verses.textZhCuv: 如经上所记： 我们为你的缘故终日被杀； 人看我们如将宰的羊。
verses.textEnNiv: As it is written: "For your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered."
verses.textEnEsv: As it is written, "For your sake we are being killed all the day long; we are regarded as sheep to be slaughtered."
verses.textEnNkjv: As it is written: "For Your sake we are killed all day long; We are accounted as sheep for the slaughter."
verses.textEnNlt: (As the Scriptures say, "For your sake we are killed every day; we are being slaughtered like sheep." )
verses.textEnNasb: Just as it is written: "For Your sake we are killed all day long; We were regarded as sheep to be slaughtered."
verses.textEn: As it is written: "For your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered."

verses.textZh: 但靠着爱我们的那一位，我们在这一切事上就得胜有余了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但靠着爱我们的那一位，我们在这一切事上就得胜有余了。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，靠着爱我们的主，在这一切的事上已经得胜有余了。
verses.textEnNiv: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
verses.textEnEsv: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet in all these things we are more than conquerors through Him who loved us.
verses.textEnNlt: No, despite all these things, overwhelming victory is ours through Christ, who loved us.
verses.textEnNasb: But in all these things we overwhelmingly conquer through Him who loved us.
verses.textEn: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

verses.textZh: 因为我深信：无论是死、是生，是天使、是掌权的，是现在的事，是将来的事，是有能力的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为我深信：无论是死、是生，是天使、是掌权的，是现在的事，是将来的事，是有能力的，
verses.textZhCuv: 因为我深信无论是死，是生，是天使，是掌权的，是有能的，是现在的事，是将来的事，
verses.textEnNiv: For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor demons, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers,
verses.textEnEsv: For I am sure that neither death nor life, nor angels nor rulers, nor things present nor things to come, nor powers,
verses.textEnNkjv: For I am persuaded that neither death nor life, nor angels nor principalities nor powers, nor things present nor things to come,
verses.textEnNlt: And I am convinced that nothing can ever separate us from God’s love. Neither death nor life, neither angels nor demons, neither our fears for today nor our worries about tomorrow—not even the powers of hell can separate us from God’s love.
verses.textEnNasb: For I am convinced that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,
verses.textEn: For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor demons, neither the present nor the future, nor any powers,

verses.textZh: 是高天的、是深渊的，或是任何别的被造之物，都不能叫我们与神的爱隔绝，这爱是在我们的主耶稣基督里的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 是高天的、是深渊的，或是任何别的被造之物，都不能叫我们与神的爱隔绝，这爱是在我们的主耶稣基督里的。
verses.textZhCuv: 是高处的，是低处的，是别的受造之物，都不能叫我们与神的爱隔绝；这爱是在我们的主基督耶稣里的。
verses.textEnNiv: neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: nor height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: nor height nor depth, nor any other created thing, shall be able to separate us from the love of God which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: No power in the sky above or in the earth below—indeed, nothing in all creation will ever be able to separate us from the love of God that is revealed in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.textEn: neither height nor depth, nor anything else in all creation, will be able to separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.textZh: 我在基督里说的是实话，并没有撒谎，因为我的良心在圣灵里一同为我作证；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在基督里说的是实话，并没有撒谎，因为我的良心在圣灵里一同为我作证；
verses.textZhCuv: 我在基督里说真话，并不谎言，有我良心被圣灵感动，给我作见证：
verses.textEnNiv: I speak the truth in Christ—I am not lying, my conscience confirms it through the Holy Spirit—
verses.textEnEsv: I am speaking the truth in Christ—I am not lying; my conscience bears me witness in the Holy Spirit—
verses.textEnNkjv: I tell the truth in Christ, I am not lying, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEnNlt: With Christ as my witness, I speak with utter truthfulness. My conscience and the Holy Spirit confirm it.
verses.textEnNasb: I am telling the truth in Christ, I am not lying; my conscience testifies with me in the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEn: I speak the truth in Christ—I am not lying, my conscience confirms it through the Holy Spirit—

verses.textZh: 我大大忧愁，心里常常伤痛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我大大忧愁，心里常常伤痛。
verses.textZhCuv: 我是大有忧愁，心里时常伤痛；
verses.textEnNiv: I have great sorrow and unceasing anguish in my heart.
verses.textEnEsv: that I have great sorrow and unceasing anguish in my heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: that I have great sorrow and continual grief in my heart.
verses.textEnNlt: My heart is filled with bitter sorrow and unending grief
verses.textEnNasb: that I have great sorrow and unceasing grief in my heart.
verses.textEn: I have great sorrow and unceasing anguish in my heart.

verses.textZh: 为我的同胞，就是我骨肉之亲，就算自己受咒诅，与基督隔绝，我也甘心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为我的同胞，就是我骨肉之亲，就算自己受咒诅，与基督隔绝，我也甘心。
verses.textZhCuv: 为我弟兄，我骨肉之亲，就是自己被咒诅，与基督分离，我也愿意。
verses.textEnNiv: For I could wish that I myself were cursed and cut off from Christ for the sake of my people, those of my own race,
verses.textEnEsv: For I could wish that I myself were accursed and cut off from Christ for the sake of my brothers, my kinsmen according to the flesh.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my countrymen according to the flesh,
verses.textEnNlt: for my people, my Jewish brothers and sisters. I would be willing to be forever cursed—cut off from Christ!—if that would save them.
verses.textEnNasb: For I could wish that I myself were accursed, separated from Christ for the sake of my countrymen, my kinsmen according to the flesh,
verses.textEn: For I could wish that I myself were cursed and cut off from Christ for the sake of my people, those of my own race,

verses.textZh: 他们是以色列人：嗣子的名分、荣耀、众约、律法、敬拜的礼仪和各样的应许，都是他们的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们是以色列人：嗣子的名分、荣耀、众约、律法、敬拜的礼仪和各样的应许，都是他们的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们是以色列人；那儿子的名分、荣耀、诸约、律法、礼仪、应许都是他们的。
verses.textEnNiv: the people of Israel. Theirs is the adoption to sonship; theirs the divine glory, the covenants, the receiving of the law, the temple worship and the promises.
verses.textEnEsv: They are Israelites, and to them belong the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the worship, and the promises.
verses.textEnNkjv: who are Israelites, to whom pertain the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service ofGod, and the promises;
verses.textEnNlt: They are the people of Israel, chosen to be God’s adopted children. God revealed his glory to them. He made covenants with them and gave them his law. He gave them the privilege of worshiping him and receiving his wonderful promises.
verses.textEnNasb: who are Israelites, to whom belongs the adoption as sons and daughters, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the Law, the temple service, and the promises;
verses.textEn: the people of Israel. Theirs is the adoption to sonship; theirs the divine glory, the covenants, the receiving of the law, the temple worship and the promises.

verses.textZh: 蒙拣选的列祖也是他们的祖宗；按肉身来说，基督也是出自他们这一族。其实，他是在万有之上，永远受称颂的神。阿们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 蒙拣选的列祖也是他们的祖宗；按肉身来说，基督也是出自他们这一族。其实，他是在万有之上，永远受称颂的神。阿们。
verses.textZhCuv: 列祖就是他们的祖宗；按肉体说，基督也是从他们出来的。他是在万有之上，永远可称颂的神。阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: Theirs are the patriarchs, and from them is traced the human ancestry of the Messiah, who is God over all, forever praised! Amen.
verses.textEnEsv: To them belong the patriarchs, and from their race, according to the flesh, is the Christ, who is God over all, blessed forever. Amen.
verses.textEnNkjv: of whom are the fathers and from whom, according to the flesh, Christ came, who is over all, the eternally blessed God. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob are their ancestors, and Christ himself was an Israelite as far as his human nature is concerned. And he is God, the one who rules over everything and is worthy of eternal praise! Amen.
verses.textEnNasb: whose are the fathers, and from whom is the Christ according to the flesh, who is over all, God blessed forever. Amen.
verses.textEn: Theirs are the patriarchs, and from them is traced the human ancestry of the Messiah, who is God over all, forever praised! Amen.

verses.textZh: 当然，这不是说神的话落了空，因为出自以色列的，不都是以色列人；
verses.textZhCnvs: 当然，这不是说神的话落了空，因为出自以色列的，不都是以色列人；
verses.textZhCuv: 这不是说神的话落了空。因为从以色列生的不都是以色列人，
verses.textEnNiv: It is not as though God’s word had failed. For not all who are descended from Israel are Israel.
verses.textEnEsv: But it is not as though the word of God has failed. For not all who are descended from Israel belong to Israel,
verses.textEnNkjv: But it is not that the word of God has taken no effect. For they are not all Israel who are of Israel,
verses.textEnNlt: Well then, has God failed to fulfill his promise to Israel? No, for not all who are born into the nation of Israel are truly members of God’s people!
verses.textEnNasb: But it is not as though the word of God has failed. For they are not all Israel who are descended from Israel;
verses.textEn: It is not as though God’s word had failed. For not all who are descended from Israel are Israel.

verses.textZh: 也不因为他们是亚伯拉罕的后裔，就都成为他的儿女，只有"以撒生的，才可以称为你的后裔"，
verses.textZhCnvs: 也不因为他们是亚伯拉罕的后裔，就都成为他的儿女，只有"以撒生的，才可以称为你的后裔"，
verses.textZhCuv: 也不因为是亚伯拉罕的后裔就都作他的儿女；惟独「从以撒生的才要称为你的后裔。」
verses.textEnNiv: Nor because they are his descendants are they all Abraham’s children. On the contrary, "It is through Isaac that your offspring will be reckoned."
verses.textEnEsv: and not all are children of Abraham because they are his offspring, but "Through Isaac shall your offspring be named."
verses.textEnNkjv: nor arethey all children because they are the seed of Abraham; but, "In Isaac your seed shall be called."
verses.textEnNlt: Being descendants of Abraham doesn’t make them truly Abraham’s children. For the Scriptures say, "Isaac is the son through whom your descendants will be counted," though Abraham had other children, too.
verses.textEnNasb: nor are they all children because they are Abraham’s descendants, but: " through Isaac your descendants shall be named."
verses.textEn: Nor because they are his descendants are they all Abraham’s children. On the contrary, "It is through Isaac that your offspring will be reckoned."

verses.textZh: 这就是说，肉身生的儿女并不是神的儿女，只有凭着应许生的儿女才算是后裔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这就是说，肉身生的儿女并不是神的儿女，只有凭着应许生的儿女才算是后裔。
verses.textZhCuv: 这就是说，肉身所生的儿女不是神的儿女，惟独那应许的儿女才算是后裔。
verses.textEnNiv: In other words, it is not the children by physical descent who are God’s children, but it is the children of the promise who are regarded as Abraham’s offspring.
verses.textEnEsv: This means that it is not the children of the flesh who are the children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as offspring.
verses.textEnNkjv: That is, those who are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God; but the children of the promise are counted as the seed.
verses.textEnNlt: This means that Abraham’s physical descendants are not necessarily children of God. Only the children of the promise are considered to be Abraham’s children.
verses.textEnNasb: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are regarded as descendants.
verses.textEn: In other words, it is not the children by physical descent who are God’s children, but it is the children of the promise who are regarded as Abraham’s offspring.

verses.textZh: 因为所应许的话是这样："明年这个时候我要来，撒拉必定生一个儿子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为所应许的话是这样："明年这个时候我要来，撒拉必定生一个儿子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为所应许的话是这样说：「到明年这时候我要来，撒拉必生一个儿子。」
verses.textEnNiv: For this was how the promise was stated: "At the appointed time I will return, and Sarah will have a son."
verses.textEnEsv: For this is what the promise said: "About this time next year I will return, and Sarah shall have a son."
verses.textEnNkjv: For this is the word of promise: "At this time I will come and Sarah shall have a son."
verses.textEnNlt: For God had promised, "I will return about this time next year, and Sarah will have a son."
verses.textEnNasb: For this is the word of promise: "At this time I will come, and Sarah will have a son."
verses.textEn: For this was how the promise was stated: "At the appointed time I will return, and Sarah will have a son."

verses.textZh: 不但如此，利百加也是这样：既然从一个人，就是从我们的祖宗以撒怀了孕，
verses.textZhCnvs: 不但如此，利百加也是这样：既然从一个人，就是从我们的祖宗以撒怀了孕，
verses.textZhCuv: 不但如此，还有利百加，既从一个人，就是从我们的祖宗以撒怀了孕，（
verses.textEnNiv: Not only that, but Rebekah’s children were conceived at the same time by our father Isaac.
verses.textEnEsv: And not only so, but also when Rebekah had conceived children by one man, our forefather Isaac,
verses.textEnNkjv: And not only this, but when Rebecca also had conceived by one man, even by our father Isaac
verses.textEnNlt: This son was our ancestor Isaac. When he married Rebekah, she gave birth to twins.
verses.textEnNasb: And not only that, but there was also Rebekah, when she had conceived twins by one man, our father Isaac;
verses.textEn: Not only that, but Rebekah’s children were conceived at the same time by our father Isaac.

verses.textZh: 双生子还没有生下来，善恶也没有行出来 ，
verses.textZhCnvs: 双生子还没有生下来，善恶也没有行出来 ，
verses.textZhCuv: 双子还没有生下来，善恶还没有做出来，只因要显明神拣选人的旨意，不在乎人的行为，乃在乎召人的主。）
verses.textEnNiv: Yet, before the twins were born or had done anything good or bad—in order that God’s purpose in election might stand:
verses.textEnEsv: though they were not yet born and had done nothing either good or bad—in order that God’s purpose of election might continue, not because of works but because of him who calls—
verses.textEnNkjv: (for thechildren not yet being born, nor having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works but of Him who calls),
verses.textEnNlt: But before they were born, before they had done anything good or bad, she received a message from God. (This message shows that God chooses people according to his own purposes;
verses.textEnNasb: for though the twins were not yet born and had not done anything good or bad, so that God’s purpose according to His choice would stand, not because of works but because of Him who calls,
verses.textEn: Yet, before the twins were born or had done anything good or bad—in order that God’s purpose in election might stand:

verses.textZh: 神就对她说："将来大的要服事小的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神就对她说："将来大的要服事小的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 神就对利百加说：「将来，大的要服事小的。」
verses.textEnNiv: not by works but by him who calls—she was told, "The older will serve the younger."
verses.textEnEsv: she was told, "The older will serve the younger."
verses.textEnNkjv: it was said to her, "The older shall serve the younger."
verses.textEnNlt: he calls people, but not according to their good or bad works.) She was told, "Your older son will serve your younger son."
verses.textEnNasb: it was said to her, "The older will serve the younger."
verses.textEn: not by works but by him who calls—she was told, "The older will serve the younger."

verses.textZh: 正如经上所记的： "我爱雅各， 却恶以扫。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 正如经上所记的： "我爱雅各， 却恶以扫。"
verses.textZhCuv: 正如经上所记：雅各是我所爱的；以扫是我所恶的。
verses.textEnNiv: Just as it is written: "Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated."
verses.textEnEsv: As it is written, "Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated."
verses.textEnNkjv: As it is written, "Jacob I have loved, but Esau I have hated."
verses.textEnNlt: In the words of the Scriptures, "I loved Jacob, but I rejected Esau."
verses.textEnNasb: Just as it is written: "Jacob I have loved, but Esau I have hated."
verses.textEn: Just as it is written: "Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated."

verses.textZh: 既是这样，我们可以说甚么呢？神不公平吗？绝对不会！
verses.textZhCnvs: 既是这样，我们可以说甚么呢？神不公平吗？绝对不会！
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，我们可说什么呢？难道神有什么不公平吗？断乎没有！
verses.textEnNiv: What then shall we say? Is God unjust? Not at all!
verses.textEnEsv: What shall we say then? Is there injustice on God’s part? By no means!
verses.textEnNkjv: What shall we say then? Isthere unrighteousness with God? Certainly not!
verses.textEnNlt: Are we saying, then, that God was unfair? Of course not!
verses.textEnNasb: What shall we say then? There is no injustice with God, is there? Far from it!
verses.textEn: What then shall we say? Is God unjust? Not at all!

verses.textZh: 因为他对摩西说： "我要怜悯谁，就怜悯谁； 我要恩待谁，就恩待谁。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他对摩西说： "我要怜悯谁，就怜悯谁； 我要恩待谁，就恩待谁。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因他对摩西说： 我要怜悯谁就怜悯谁， 要恩待谁就恩待谁。
verses.textEnNiv: For he says to Moses, "I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion."
verses.textEnEsv: For he says to Moses, "I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion."
verses.textEnNkjv: For He says to Moses, "I will have mercy on whomever I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whomever I will have compassion."
verses.textEnNlt: For God said to Moses, "I will show mercy to anyone I choose, and I will show compassion to anyone I choose."
verses.textEnNasb: For He says to Moses, "I will have mercy on whomever I have mercy, and I will show compassion to whomever I show compassion."
verses.textEn: For he says to Moses, "I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion."

verses.textZh: 这样看来，既不是出于人意，也不是由于人为 ，只在于那怜悯人的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样看来，既不是出于人意，也不是由于人为 ，只在于那怜悯人的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 据此看来，这不在乎那定意的，也不在乎那奔跑的，只在乎发怜悯的神。
verses.textEnNiv: It does not, therefore, depend on human desire or effort, but on God’s mercy.
verses.textEnEsv: So then it depends not on human will or exertion, but on God, who has mercy.
verses.textEnNkjv: So then itis not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who shows mercy.
verses.textEnNlt: So it is God who decides to show mercy. We can neither choose it nor work for it.
verses.textEnNasb: So then, it does not depend on the person who wants it nor the one who runs, but on God who has mercy.
verses.textEn: It does not, therefore, depend on human desire or effort, but on God’s mercy.

verses.textZh: 经上有话对法老说："我把你兴起来，是要借着你显出我的大能，并且使我的名传遍全地。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 经上有话对法老说："我把你兴起来，是要借着你显出我的大能，并且使我的名传遍全地。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为经上有话向法老说：「我将你兴起来，特要在你身上彰显我的权能，并要使我的名传遍天下。」
verses.textEnNiv: For Scripture says to Pharaoh: "I raised you up for this very purpose, that I might display my power in you and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth."
verses.textEnEsv: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, "For this very purpose I have raised you up, that I might show my power in you, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth."
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Scripture says to the Pharaoh, "For this very purpose I have raised you up, that I may show My power in you, and that My name may be declared in all the earth."
