verses.textEnNlt: For the Scriptures say that God told Pharaoh, "I have appointed you for the very purpose of displaying my power in you and to spread my fame throughout the earth."
verses.textEnNasb: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, "For this very reason I raised you up, in order to demonstrate My power in you, and that My name might be proclaimed throughout the earth."
verses.textEn: For Scripture says to Pharaoh: "I raised you up for this very purpose, that I might display my power in you and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth."

verses.textZh: 这样看来，他愿意怜悯谁就怜悯谁，愿意谁刚硬就使谁刚硬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样看来，他愿意怜悯谁就怜悯谁，愿意谁刚硬就使谁刚硬。
verses.textZhCuv: 如此看来，神要怜悯谁就怜悯谁，要叫谁刚硬就叫谁刚硬。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore God has mercy on whom he wants to have mercy, and he hardens whom he wants to harden.
verses.textEnEsv: So then he has mercy on whomever he wills, and he hardens whomever he wills.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore He has mercy on whom He wills, and whom He wills He hardens.
verses.textEnNlt: So you see, God chooses to show mercy to some, and he chooses to harden the hearts of others so they refuse to listen.
verses.textEnNasb: So then He has mercy on whom He desires, and He hardens whom He desires.
verses.textEn: Therefore God has mercy on whom he wants to have mercy, and he hardens whom he wants to harden.

verses.textZh: 这样，你会对我说："那么他为甚么责怪人呢？有谁抗拒他的旨意呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，你会对我说："那么他为甚么责怪人呢？有谁抗拒他的旨意呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，你必对我说：「他为什么还指责人呢？有谁抗拒他的旨意呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: One of you will say to me: "Then why does God still blame us? For who is able to resist his will?"
verses.textEnEsv: You will say to me then, "Why does he still find fault? For who can resist his will?"
verses.textEnNkjv: You will say to me then, "Why does He still find fault? For who has resisted His will?"
verses.textEnNlt: Well then, you might say, "Why does God blame people for not responding? Haven’t they simply done what he makes them do?"
verses.textEnNasb: You will say to me then, "Why does He still find fault? For who has resisted His will?"
verses.textEn: One of you will say to me: "Then why does God still blame us? For who is able to resist his will?"

verses.textZh: 你这个人哪，你是谁，竟敢跟神顶嘴呢？被造的怎么可以对造他的说："你为甚么把我做成这个样子呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这个人哪，你是谁，竟敢跟神顶嘴呢？被造的怎么可以对造他的说："你为甚么把我做成这个样子呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 你这个人哪，你是谁，竟敢向神强嘴呢？受造之物岂能对造他的说：「你为什么这样造我呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: But who are you, a human being, to talk back to God? "Shall what is formed say to the one who formed it, ‘Why did you make me like this?’ "
verses.textEnEsv: But who are you, O man, to answer back to God? Will what is molded say to its molder, "Why have you made me like this?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed say to him who formed it, "Why have you made me like this?"
verses.textEnNlt: No, don’t say that. Who are you, a mere human being, to argue with God? Should the thing that was created say to the one who created it, "Why have you made me like this?"
verses.textEnNasb: On the contrary, who are you, you foolish person, who answers back to God? The thing molded will not say to the molder, "Why did you make me like this," will it?
verses.textEn: But who are you, a human being, to talk back to God? "Shall what is formed say to the one who formed it, ‘Why did you make me like this?’ "

verses.textZh: 陶匠难道没有权用同一团的泥，又做贵重的、又做卑贱的器皿吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 陶匠难道没有权用同一团的泥，又做贵重的、又做卑贱的器皿吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 窑匠难道没有权柄从一团泥里拿一块做成贵重的器皿，又拿一块做成卑贱的器皿吗？
verses.textEnNiv: Does not the potter have the right to make out of the same lump of clay some pottery for special purposes and some for common use?
verses.textEnEsv: Has the potter no right over the clay, to make out of the same lump one vessel for honorable use and another for dishonorable use?
verses.textEnNkjv: Does not the potter have power over the clay, from the same lump to make one vessel for honor and another for dishonor?
verses.textEnNlt: When a potter makes jars out of clay, doesn’t he have a right to use the same lump of clay to make one jar for decoration and another to throw garbage into?
verses.textEnNasb: Or does the potter not have a right over the clay, to make from the same lump one object for honorable use, and another for common use?
verses.textEn: Does not the potter have the right to make out of the same lump of clay some pottery for special purposes and some for common use?

verses.textZh: 如果神有意要显明他的忿怒，彰显他的大能，而多多容忍那可怒、预备遭毁灭的器皿，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果神有意要显明他的忿怒，彰显他的大能，而多多容忍那可怒、预备遭毁灭的器皿，
verses.textZhCuv: 倘若神要显明他的忿怒，彰显他的权能，就多多忍耐宽容那可怒、预备遭毁灭的器皿，
verses.textEnNiv: What if God, although choosing to show his wrath and make his power known, bore with great patience the objects of his wrath—prepared for destruction?
verses.textEnEsv: What if God, desiring to show his wrath and to make known his power, has endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,
verses.textEnNkjv: What if God, wanting to show His wrath and to make His power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, even though God has the right to show his anger and his power, he is very patient with those on whom his anger falls, who are destined for destruction.
verses.textEnNasb: What if God, although willing to demonstrate His wrath and to make His power known, endured with great patience objects of wrath prepared for destruction?
verses.textEn: What if God, although choosing to show his wrath and make his power known, bore with great patience the objects of his wrath—prepared for destruction?

verses.textZh: 为了要使他丰盛的荣耀，彰显在那蒙恩、早已预备要得荣耀的器皿上，这又有甚么不可呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了要使他丰盛的荣耀，彰显在那蒙恩、早已预备要得荣耀的器皿上，这又有甚么不可呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 又要将他丰盛的荣耀彰显在那蒙怜悯、早预备得荣耀的器皿上。
verses.textEnNiv: What if he did this to make the riches of his glory known to the objects of his mercy, whom he prepared in advance for glory—
verses.textEnEsv: in order to make known the riches of his glory for vessels of mercy, which he has prepared beforehand for glory—
verses.textEnNkjv: and that He might make known the riches of His glory on the vessels of mercy, which He had prepared beforehand for glory,
verses.textEnNlt: He does this to make the riches of his glory shine even brighter on those to whom he shows mercy, who were prepared in advance for glory.
verses.textEnNasb: And He did so to make known the riches of His glory upon objects of mercy, which He prepared beforehand for glory,
verses.textEn: What if he did this to make the riches of his glory known to the objects of his mercy, whom he prepared in advance for glory—

verses.textZh: 这器皿就是我们这些不但从犹太人中，也从外族人中蒙召的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这器皿就是我们这些不但从犹太人中，也从外族人中蒙召的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 这器皿就是我们被神所召的，不但是从犹太人中，也是从外邦人中。这有什么不可呢？
verses.textEnNiv: even us, whom he also called, not only from the Jews but also from the Gentiles?
verses.textEnEsv: even us whom he has called, not from the Jews only but also from the Gentiles?
verses.textEnNkjv: even us whom He called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?
verses.textEnNlt: And we are among those whom he selected, both from the Jews and from the Gentiles.
verses.textEnNasb: namely us, whom He also called, not only from among Jews, but also from among Gentiles,
verses.textEn: even us, whom he also called, not only from the Jews but also from the Gentiles?

verses.textZh: 就如神在何西阿书上说的： "我要称那不是我子民的为我的子民， 那不蒙爱的为蒙爱的；
verses.textZhCnvs: 就如神在何西阿书上说的： "我要称那不是我子民的为我的子民， 那不蒙爱的为蒙爱的；
verses.textZhCuv: 就像神在何西阿书上说： 那本来不是我子民的， 我要称为「我的子民」； 本来不是蒙爱的， 我要称为「蒙爱的」。
verses.textEnNiv: As he says in Hosea: "I will call them ‘my people’ who are not my people; and I will call her ‘my loved one’ who is not my loved one,"
verses.textEnEsv: As indeed he says in Hosea, "Those who were not my people I will call ‘my people,’ and her who was not beloved I will call ‘beloved.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: As He says also in Hosea: "I will call them My people, who were not My people, And her beloved, who was not beloved."
verses.textEnNlt: Concerning the Gentiles, God says in the prophecy of Hosea, "Those who were not my people, I will now call my people. And I will love those whom I did not love before."
verses.textEnNasb: as He also says in Hosea: "I will call those who were not My people, ‘My people,’ And her who was not beloved, ‘beloved.’ "
verses.textEn: As he says in Hosea: "I will call them ‘my people’ who are not my people; and I will call her ‘my loved one’ who is not my loved one,"

verses.textZh: 从前在甚么地方对他们说： 你们不是我的子民， 将来就在那里称他们为永活神的儿子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前在甚么地方对他们说： 你们不是我的子民， 将来就在那里称他们为永活神的儿子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 从前在什么地方对他们说： 你们不是我的子民， 将来就在那里称他们为「永生神的儿子」。
verses.textEnNiv: and, "In the very place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘children of the living God.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: "And in the very place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’"
verses.textEnNkjv: "And it shall come to pass in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not My people,’ There they shall be called sons of the living God."
verses.textEnNlt: And, "Then, at the place where they were told, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘children of the living God.’"
verses.textEnNasb: "And it shall be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘you are not My people,’ There they shall be called sons of the living God."
verses.textEn: and, "In the very place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘children of the living God.’ "

verses.textZh: 以赛亚指着以色列人大声说："以色列子孙的数目虽然多如海沙，得救的不过是剩下的余数；
verses.textZhCnvs: 以赛亚指着以色列人大声说："以色列子孙的数目虽然多如海沙，得救的不过是剩下的余数；
verses.textZhCuv: 以赛亚指着以色列人喊着说：「以色列人虽多如海沙，得救的不过是剩下的余数；
verses.textEnNiv: Isaiah cries out concerning Israel: "Though the number of the Israelites be like the sand by the sea, only the remnant will be saved.
verses.textEnEsv: And Isaiah cries out concerning Israel: "Though the number of the sons of Israel be as the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will be saved,
verses.textEnNkjv: Isaiah also cries out concerning Israel: "Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, The remnant will be saved.
verses.textEnNlt: And concerning Israel, Isaiah the prophet cried out, "Though the people of Israel are as numerous as the sand of the seashore, only a remnant will be saved.
verses.textEnNasb: Isaiah cries out concerning Israel, "Though the number of the sons of Israel may be like the sand of the sea, only the remnant will be saved;
verses.textEn: Isaiah cries out concerning Israel: "Though the number of the Israelites be like the sand by the sea, only the remnant will be saved.

verses.textZh: 因为主必在地上迅速而彻底地成就他的话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为主必在地上迅速而彻底地成就他的话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为主要在世上施行他的话，叫他的话都成全，速速地完结。」
verses.textEnNiv: For the Lord will carry out his sentence on earth with speed and finality."
verses.textEnEsv: for the Lord will carry out his sentence upon the earth fully and without delay."
verses.textEnNkjv: For He will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, Because the Lord will make a short work upon the earth."
verses.textEnNlt: For the Lord will carry out his sentence upon the earth quickly and with finality."
verses.textEnNasb: for the Lord will execute His word on the earth, thoroughly and quickly."
verses.textEn: For the Lord will carry out his sentence on earth with speed and finality."

verses.textZh: 又如以赛亚早已说过的： "如果不是万军之主给我们存留后裔， 我们早就像所多玛 和蛾摩拉一样了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又如以赛亚早已说过的： "如果不是万军之主给我们存留后裔， 我们早就像所多玛 和蛾摩拉一样了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又如以赛亚先前说过： 若不是万军之主给我们存留余种， 我们早已像所多玛、蛾摩拉的样子了。
verses.textEnNiv: It is just as Isaiah said previously: "Unless the Lord Almighty had left us descendants, we would have become like Sodom, we would have been like Gomorrah."
verses.textEnEsv: And as Isaiah predicted, "If the Lord of hosts had not left us offspring, we would have been like Sodom and become like Gomorrah."
verses.textEnNkjv: And as Isaiah said before: "Unless the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, We would have become like Sodom, And we would have been made like Gomorrah."
verses.textEnNlt: And Isaiah said the same thing in another place: "If the Lord of Heaven’s Armies had not spared a few of our children, we would have been wiped out like Sodom, destroyed like Gomorrah."
verses.textEnNasb: And just as Isaiah foretold: "If the Lord of armies had not left us descendants, We would have become like Sodom, and would have been like Gomorrah."
verses.textEn: It is just as Isaiah said previously: "Unless the Lord Almighty had left us descendants, we would have become like Sodom, we would have been like Gomorrah."

verses.textZh: 既是这样，我们还有甚么可说的呢？那不追求义的外族人却得了义，就是因信而得的义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 既是这样，我们还有甚么可说的呢？那不追求义的外族人却得了义，就是因信而得的义。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，我们可说什么呢？那本来不追求义的外邦人反得了义，就是因信而得的义。
verses.textEnNiv: What then shall we say? That the Gentiles, who did not pursue righteousness, have obtained it, a righteousness that is by faith;
verses.textEnEsv: What shall we say, then? That Gentiles who did not pursue righteousness have attained it, that is, a righteousness that is by faith;
verses.textEnNkjv: What shall we say then? That Gentiles, who did not pursue righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness of faith;
verses.textEnNlt: What does all this mean? Even though the Gentiles were not trying to follow God’s standards, they were made right with God. And it was by faith that this took place.
verses.textEnNasb: What shall we say then? That Gentiles, who did not pursue righteousness, attained righteousness, but the righteousness that is by faith;
verses.textEn: What then shall we say? That the Gentiles, who did not pursue righteousness, have obtained it, a righteousness that is by faith;

verses.textZh: 但以色列人追求律法的义 ，却达不到律法的要求。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但以色列人追求律法的义 ，却达不到律法的要求。
verses.textZhCuv: 但以色列人追求律法的义，反得不着律法的义。
verses.textEnNiv: but the people of Israel, who pursued the law as the way of righteousness, have not attained their goal.
verses.textEnEsv: but that Israel who pursued a law that would lead to righteousness did not succeed in reaching that law.
verses.textEnNkjv: but Israel, pursuing the law of righteousness, has not attained to the law of righteousness.
verses.textEnNlt: But the people of Israel, who tried so hard to get right with God by keeping the law, never succeeded.
verses.textEnNasb: however, Israel, pursuing a law of righteousness, did not arrive at that law.
verses.textEn: but the people of Israel, who pursued the law as the way of righteousness, have not attained their goal.

verses.textZh: 这是甚么缘故呢？因为他们不凭信心，只靠行为。他们绊倒在那绊脚石上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是甚么缘故呢？因为他们不凭信心，只靠行为。他们绊倒在那绊脚石上，
verses.textZhCuv: 这是什么缘故呢？是因为他们不凭着信心求，只凭着行为求；他们正跌在那绊脚石上。
verses.textEnNiv: Why not? Because they pursued it not by faith but as if it were by works. They stumbled over the stumbling stone.
verses.textEnEsv: Why? Because they did not pursue it by faith, but as if it were based on works. They have stumbled over the stumbling stone,
verses.textEnNkjv: Why? Because theydid not seekit by faith, but as it were, by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumbling stone.
verses.textEnNlt: Why not? Because they were trying to get right with God by keeping the law instead of by trusting in him. They stumbled over the great rock in their path.
verses.textEnNasb: Why? Because they did not pursue it by faith, but as though they could by works. They stumbled over the stumbling stone,
verses.textEn: Why not? Because they pursued it not by faith but as if it were by works. They stumbled over the stumbling stone.

verses.textZh: 正如经上所记： "看哪，我在锡安放了一块绊脚石， 是绊倒人的盘石； 信靠他的人， 必不致失望。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 正如经上所记： "看哪，我在锡安放了一块绊脚石， 是绊倒人的盘石； 信靠他的人， 必不致失望。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就如经上所记： 我在锡安放一块绊脚的石头，跌人的磐石； 信靠他的人必不至于羞愧。
verses.textEnNiv: As it is written: "See, I lay in Zion a stone that causes people to stumble and a rock that makes them fall, and the one who believes in him will never be put to shame."
verses.textEnEsv: as it is written, "Behold, I am laying in Zion a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offense; and whoever believes in him will not be put to shame."
verses.textEnNkjv: As it is written: "Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and rock of offense, And whoever believes on Him will not be put to shame."
verses.textEnNlt: God warned them of this in the Scriptures when he said, "I am placing a stone in Jerusalem that makes people stumble, a rock that makes them fall. But anyone who trusts in him will never be disgraced."
verses.textEnNasb: just as it is written: "Behold, I am laying in Zion a stone of stumbling and a rock of offense, And the one who believes in Him will not be put to shame."
verses.textEn: As it is written: "See, I lay in Zion a stone that causes people to stumble and a rock that makes them fall, and the one who believes in him will never be put to shame."

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我心里切切盼望的，并且为以色列人向神祈求的，是要他们得救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我心里切切盼望的，并且为以色列人向神祈求的，是要他们得救。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我心里所愿的，向神所求的，是要以色列人得救。
verses.textEnNiv: Brothers and sisters, my heart’s desire and prayer to God for the Israelites is that they may be saved.
verses.textEnEsv: Brothers, my heart’s desire and prayer to God for them is that they may be saved.
verses.textEnNkjv: Brethren, my heart’s desire and prayer to God for Israel is that they may be saved.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear brothers and sisters, the longing of my heart and my prayer to God is for the people of Israel to be saved.
verses.textEnNasb: Brothers and sisters, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God for them is for their salvation.
verses.textEn: Brothers and sisters, my heart’s desire and prayer to God for the Israelites is that they may be saved.

verses.textZh: 我可以为他们作证，他们对神有热心，但不是按着真见识；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我可以为他们作证，他们对神有热心，但不是按着真见识；
verses.textZhCuv: 我可以证明，他们向神有热心，但不是按着真知识；
verses.textEnNiv: For I can testify about them that they are zealous for God, but their zeal is not based on knowledge.
verses.textEnEsv: For I bear them witness that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I bear them witness that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.
verses.textEnNlt: I know what enthusiasm they have for God, but it is misdirected zeal.
verses.textEnNasb: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not in accordance with knowledge.
verses.textEn: For I can testify about them that they are zealous for God, but their zeal is not based on knowledge.

verses.textZh: 他们既然不明白神的义，而又企图建立自己的义，就不服神的义了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们既然不明白神的义，而又企图建立自己的义，就不服神的义了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为不知道神的义，想要立自己的义，就不服神的义了。
verses.textEnNiv: Since they did not know the righteousness of God and sought to establish their own, they did not submit to God’s righteousness.
verses.textEnEsv: For, being ignorant of the righteousness of God, and seeking to establish their own, they did not submit to God’s righteousness.
verses.textEnNkjv: For they being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted to the righteousness of God.
verses.textEnNlt: For they don’t understand God’s way of making people right with himself. Refusing to accept God’s way, they cling to their own way of getting right with God by trying to keep the law.
verses.textEnNasb: For not knowing about God’s righteousness and seeking to establish their own, they did not subject themselves to the righteousness of God.
verses.textEn: Since they did not know the righteousness of God and sought to establish their own, they did not submit to God’s righteousness.

verses.textZh: 因为律法的终极就是基督，使所有信的人都得着义。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为律法的终极就是基督，使所有信的人都得着义。
verses.textZhCuv: 律法的总结就是基督，使凡信他的都得着义。
verses.textEnNiv: Christ is the culmination of the law so that there may be righteousness for everyone who believes.
verses.textEnEsv: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.
verses.textEnNlt: For Christ has already accomplished the purpose for which the law was given. As a result, all who believe in him are made right with God.
verses.textEnNasb: For Christ is the end of the Law for righteousness to everyone who believes.
verses.textEn: Christ is the culmination of the law so that there may be righteousness for everyone who believes.

verses.textZh: 论到出于律法的义，摩西写着说："遵行这些事的人就必因这些事而活。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到出于律法的义，摩西写着说："遵行这些事的人就必因这些事而活。"
verses.textZhCuv: 摩西写着说：「人若行那出于律法的义，就必因此活着。」
verses.textEnNiv: Moses writes this about the righteousness that is by the law: "The person who does these things will live by them."
verses.textEnEsv: For Moses writes about the righteousness that is based on the law, that the person who does the commandments shall live by them.
verses.textEnNkjv: For Moses writes about the righteousness which is of the law, "The man who does those things shall live by them."
verses.textEnNlt: For Moses writes that the law’s way of making a person right with God requires obedience to all of its commands.
verses.textEnNasb: For Moses writes of the righteousness that is based on the Law, that the person who performs them will live by them.
verses.textEn: Moses writes this about the righteousness that is by the law: "The person who does these things will live by them."

verses.textZh: 但那出于信心的义却这样说："你心里不要说：‘谁要升到天上去呢？’
verses.textZhCnvs: 但那出于信心的义却这样说："你心里不要说：‘谁要升到天上去呢？’
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有出于信心的义如此说：「你不要心里说：谁要升到天上去呢？（就是要领下基督来；）
verses.textEnNiv: But the righteousness that is by faith says: "Do not say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ " (that is, to bring Christ down)
verses.textEnEsv: But the righteousness based on faith says, "Do not say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’" (that is, to bring Christ down)
verses.textEnNkjv: But the righteousness of faith speaks in this way, "Do not say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ " (that is, to bring Christ down fromabove)
verses.textEnNlt: But faith’s way of getting right with God says, "Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will go up to heaven?’ (to bring Christ down to earth).
verses.textEnNasb: But the righteousness based on faith speaks as follows: "Do not say in your heart, ‘Who will go up into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down),
verses.textEn: But the righteousness that is by faith says: "Do not say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ " (that is, to bring Christ down)

verses.textZh: 或是说：‘谁要下到深渊去呢？’ "
verses.textZhCnvs: 或是说：‘谁要下到深渊去呢？’ "
verses.textZhCuv: 谁要下到阴间去呢？（就是要领基督从死里上来。）」
verses.textEnNiv: "or ‘Who will descend into the deep?’ " (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead).
verses.textEnEsv: "or ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’" (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead).
verses.textEnNkjv: or, " ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ " (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead).
verses.textEnNlt: And don’t say, ‘Who will go down to the place of the dead?’ (to bring Christ back to life again)."
verses.textEnNasb: or ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead)."
verses.textEn: "or ‘Who will descend into the deep?’ " (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead).

verses.textZh: 然而那出于信心的义还说甚么呢？ "这话与你相近， 在你口里，也在你心里。" 这话就是我们所传信心的信息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而那出于信心的义还说甚么呢？ "这话与你相近， 在你口里，也在你心里。" 这话就是我们所传信心的信息。
verses.textZhCuv: 他到底怎么说呢？他说： 这道离你不远， 正在你口里，在你心里－ （就是我们所传信主的道。）
verses.textEnNiv: But what does it say? "The word is near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart," that is, the message concerning faith that we proclaim:
verses.textEnEsv: But what does it say? "The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart" (that is, the word of faith that we proclaim);
verses.textEnNkjv: But what does it say? "The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart" (that is, the word of faith which we preach):
verses.textEnNlt: In fact, it says, "The message is very close at hand; it is on your lips and in your heart." And that message is the very message about faith that we preach:
verses.textEnNasb: But what does it say? "The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart"—that is, the word of faith which we are preaching,
verses.textEn: But what does it say? "The word is near you; it is in your mouth and in your heart," that is, the message concerning faith that we proclaim:

verses.textZh: 你若口里认耶稣为主，心里信神使他从死人中复活，就必得救；
verses.textZhCnvs: 你若口里认耶稣为主，心里信神使他从死人中复活，就必得救；
verses.textZhCuv: 你若口里认耶稣为主，心里信神叫他从死里复活，就必得救。
verses.textEnNiv: If you declare with your mouth, "Jesus is Lord," and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.
verses.textEnEsv: because, if you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.
verses.textEnNkjv: that if you confess with your mouth the Lord Jesus and believe in your heart that God has raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.
verses.textEnNlt: If you openly declare that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.
verses.textEnNasb: that if you confess with your mouth Jesus as Lord, and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved;
verses.textEn: If you declare with your mouth, "Jesus is Lord," and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

verses.textZh: 因为心里相信就必称义，用口承认就必得救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为心里相信就必称义，用口承认就必得救。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为，人心里相信就可以称义，口里承认就可以得救。
verses.textEnNiv: For it is with your heart that you believe and are justified, and it is with your mouth that you profess your faith and are saved.
verses.textEnEsv: For with the heart one believes and is justified, and with the mouth one confesses and is saved.
verses.textEnNkjv: For with the heart one believes unto righteousness, and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
verses.textEnNlt: For it is by believing in your heart that you are made right with God, and it is by openly declaring your faith that you are saved.
verses.textEnNasb: for with the heart a person believes, resulting in righteousness, and with the mouth he confesses, resulting in salvation.
verses.textEn: For it is with your heart that you believe and are justified, and it is with your mouth that you profess your faith and are saved.

verses.textZh: 经上说："所有信靠他的人，必不致失望。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 经上说："所有信靠他的人，必不致失望。"
verses.textZhCuv: 经上说：「凡信他的人必不至于羞愧。」
verses.textEnNiv: As Scripture says, "Anyone who believes in him will never be put to shame."
verses.textEnEsv: For the Scripture says, "Everyone who believes in him will not be put to shame."
verses.textEnNkjv: For the Scripture says, "Whoever believes on Him will not be put to shame."
verses.textEnNlt: As the Scriptures tell us, "Anyone who trusts in him will never be disgraced."
verses.textEnNasb: For the Scripture says, "Whoever believes in Him will not be put to shame."
verses.textEn: As Scripture says, "Anyone who believes in him will never be put to shame."

verses.textZh: 其实并不分犹太人和希腊人，因为大家同有一位主；他厚待所有求告他的人，
verses.textZhCnvs: 其实并不分犹太人和希腊人，因为大家同有一位主；他厚待所有求告他的人，
verses.textZhCuv: 犹太人和希腊人并没有分别，因为众人同有一位主；他也厚待一切求告他的人。
verses.textEnNiv: For there is no difference between Jew and Gentile—the same Lord is Lord of all and richly blesses all who call on him,
verses.textEnEsv: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, bestowing his riches on all who call on him.
verses.textEnNkjv: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek, for the same Lord over all is rich to all who call upon Him.
verses.textEnNlt: Jew and Gentile are the same in this respect. They have the same Lord, who gives generously to all who call on him.
verses.textEnNasb: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, abounding in riches for all who call on Him;
verses.textEn: For there is no difference between Jew and Gentile—the same Lord is Lord of all and richly blesses all who call on him,

verses.textZh: 因为"凡求告主名的，都必得救。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为"凡求告主名的，都必得救。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为「凡求告主名的就必得救」。
verses.textEnNiv: for, "Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved."
verses.textEnEsv: For "everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved."
verses.textEnNkjv: For "whoever calls on the name of the Lord shall be saved."
verses.textEnNlt: For "Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved."
verses.textEnNasb: for "Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved."
verses.textEn: for, "Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved."

verses.textZh: 然而，人还没有信他，怎能求告他呢？没有听见他，怎能信他呢？没有人传扬，怎能听见呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而，人还没有信他，怎能求告他呢？没有听见他，怎能信他呢？没有人传扬，怎能听见呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，人未曾信他，怎能求他呢？未曾听见他，怎能信他呢？没有传道的，怎能听见呢？
verses.textEnNiv: How, then, can they call on the one they have not believed in? And how can they believe in the one of whom they have not heard? And how can they hear without someone preaching to them?
verses.textEnEsv: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? And how are they to believe in him of whom they have never heard? And how are they to hear without someone preaching?
verses.textEnNkjv: How then shall they call on Him in whom they have not believed? And how shall they believe in Him of whom they have not heard? And how shall they hear without a preacher?
verses.textEnNlt: But how can they call on him to save them unless they believe in him? And how can they believe in him if they have never heard about him? And how can they hear about him unless someone tells them?
verses.textEnNasb: How then are they to call on Him in whom they have not believed? How are they to believe in Him whom they have not heard? And how are they to hear without a preacher?
verses.textEn: How, then, can they call on the one they have not believed in? And how can they believe in the one of whom they have not heard? And how can they hear without someone preaching to them?

verses.textZh: 如果没有蒙差遣，怎能传扬呢？如经上所记："那些传美事报喜讯的人，他们的脚踪多么美！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果没有蒙差遣，怎能传扬呢？如经上所记："那些传美事报喜讯的人，他们的脚踪多么美！"
verses.textZhCuv: 若没有奉差遣，怎能传道呢？如经上所记：「报福音、传喜信的人，他们的脚踪何等佳美！」
verses.textEnNiv: And how can anyone preach unless they are sent? As it is written: "How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news!"
verses.textEnEsv: And how are they to preach unless they are sent? As it is written, "How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the good news!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And how shall they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: "How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the gospel of peace, Who bring glad tidings of good things!"
verses.textEnNlt: And how will anyone go and tell them without being sent? That is why the Scriptures say, "How beautiful are the feet of messengers who bring good news!"
verses.textEnNasb: But how are they to preach unless they are sent? Just as it is written: "How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news of good things!"
verses.textEn: And how can anyone preach unless they are sent? As it is written: "How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news!"

verses.textZh: 但并不是所有的人都顺从福音，因为以赛亚说："主啊，我们所传的，有谁信呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但并不是所有的人都顺从福音，因为以赛亚说："主啊，我们所传的，有谁信呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 只是人没有都听从福音，因为以赛亚说：「主啊，我们所传的有谁信呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: But not all the Israelites accepted the good news. For Isaiah says, "Lord, who has believed our message?"
verses.textEnEsv: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Isaiah says, "Lord, who has believed what he has heard from us?"
verses.textEnNkjv: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Isaiah says, "Lord, who has believed our report?"
verses.textEnNlt: But not everyone welcomes the Good News, for Isaiah the prophet said, " Lord , who has believed our message?"
verses.textEnNasb: However, they did not all heed the good news; for Isaiah says, "Lord, who has believed our report?"
verses.textEn: But not all the Israelites accepted the good news. For Isaiah says, "Lord, who has believed our message?"

verses.textZh: 可见信心是从所听的道来的，所听的道是借着基督的话来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可见信心是从所听的道来的，所听的道是借着基督的话来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 可见，信道是从听道来的，听道是从基督的话来的。
verses.textEnNiv: Consequently, faith comes from hearing the message, and the message is heard through the word about Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: So faith comes from hearing, and hearing through the word of Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: So then faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
verses.textEnNlt: So faith comes from hearing, that is, hearing the Good News about Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: So faith comes from hearing, and hearing by the word of Christ.
verses.textEn: Consequently, faith comes from hearing the message, and the message is heard through the word about Christ.

verses.textZh: 但是我要说，他们没有听见吗？他们的确听见了，如经上所记： "他们的声音传遍全地， 他们的言语传到地极。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是我要说，他们没有听见吗？他们的确听见了，如经上所记： "他们的声音传遍全地， 他们的言语传到地极。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但我说，人没有听见吗？诚然听见了。 他们的声音传遍天下； 他们的言语传到地极。
verses.textEnNiv: But I ask: Did they not hear? Of course they did: "Their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world."
verses.textEnEsv: But I ask, have they not heard? Indeed they have, for "Their voice has gone out to all the earth, and their words to the ends of the world."
verses.textEnNkjv: But I say, have they not heard? Yes indeed: "Their sound has gone out to all the earth, And their words to the ends of the world."
verses.textEnNlt: But I ask, have the people of Israel actually heard the message? Yes, they have: "The message has gone throughout the earth, and the words to all the world."
verses.textEnNasb: But I say, surely they have never heard, have they? On the contrary: "Their voice has gone out into all the earth, And their words to the ends of the world."
verses.textEn: But I ask: Did they not hear? Of course they did: "Their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world."

verses.textZh: 我再说：以色列人真的不明白吗？首先，摩西说： "我要使你们对那不是子民的生嫉妒， 对那无知的民族起忿怒。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我再说：以色列人真的不明白吗？首先，摩西说： "我要使你们对那不是子民的生嫉妒， 对那无知的民族起忿怒。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我再说，以色列人不知道吗？先有摩西说： 我要用那不成子民的惹动你们的愤恨； 我要用那无知的民触动你们的怒气。
verses.textEnNiv: Again I ask: Did Israel not understand? First, Moses says, "I will make you envious by those who are not a nation; I will make you angry by a nation that has no understanding."
verses.textEnEsv: But I ask, did Israel not understand? First Moses says, "I will make you jealous of those who are not a nation; with a foolish nation I will make you angry."
verses.textEnNkjv: But I say, did Israel not know? First Moses says: "I will provoke you to jealousy by thosewhoare not a nation, I will move you to anger by a foolish nation."
verses.textEnNlt: But I ask, did the people of Israel really understand? Yes, they did, for even in the time of Moses, God said, "I will rouse your jealousy through people who are not even a nation. I will provoke your anger through the foolish Gentiles."
verses.textEnNasb: But I say, surely Israel did not know, did they? First Moses says, "I will make you jealous with those who are not a nation, With a foolish nation I will anger you."
verses.textEn: Again I ask: Did Israel not understand? First, Moses says, "I will make you envious by those who are not a nation; I will make you angry by a nation that has no understanding."

verses.textZh: 后来，以赛亚也放胆地说： "没有寻找我的，我让他们找到； 没有求问我的，我向他们显现。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，以赛亚也放胆地说： "没有寻找我的，我让他们找到； 没有求问我的，我向他们显现。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又有以赛亚放胆说： 没有寻找我的，我叫他们遇见； 没有访问我的，我向他们显现。
verses.textEnNiv: And Isaiah boldly says, "I was found by those who did not seek me; I revealed myself to those who did not ask for me."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Isaiah is so bold as to say, "I have been found by those who did not seek me; I have shown myself to those who did not ask for me."
verses.textEnNkjv: But Isaiah is very bold and says: "I was found by those who did not seek Me; I was made manifest to those who did not ask for Me."
verses.textEnNlt: And later Isaiah spoke boldly for God, saying, "I was found by people who were not looking for me. I showed myself to those who were not asking for me."
verses.textEnNasb: And Isaiah is very bold and says, "I was found by those who did not seek Me, I revealed Myself to those who did not ask for Me."
verses.textEn: And Isaiah boldly says, "I was found by those who did not seek me; I revealed myself to those who did not ask for me."

verses.textZh: 论到以色列人，他却说： "我整天向那悖逆顶嘴的子民伸开双手。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 论到以色列人，他却说： "我整天向那悖逆顶嘴的子民伸开双手。"
verses.textZhCuv: 至于以色列人，他说：「我整天伸手招呼那悖逆顶嘴的百姓。」
verses.textEnNiv: But concerning Israel he says, "All day long I have held out my hands to a disobedient and obstinate people."
verses.textEnEsv: But of Israel he says, "All day long I have held out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people."
verses.textEnNkjv: But to Israel he says: "All day long I have stretched out My hands To a disobedient and contrary people."
verses.textEnNlt: But regarding Israel, God said, "All day long I opened my arms to them, but they were disobedient and rebellious."
verses.textEnNasb: But as for Israel, He says, "I have spread out My hands all day long to a disobedient and obstinate people."
verses.textEn: But concerning Israel he says, "All day long I have held out my hands to a disobedient and obstinate people."

verses.textZh: 那么我要说，难道神丢弃了他的子民吗？绝对没有！因为我自己也是以色列人，是亚伯拉罕的后裔，属于便雅悯支派的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么我要说，难道神丢弃了他的子民吗？绝对没有！因为我自己也是以色列人，是亚伯拉罕的后裔，属于便雅悯支派的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我且说，神弃绝了他的百姓吗？断乎没有！因为我也是以色列人，亚伯拉罕的后裔，属便雅悯支派的。
verses.textEnNiv: I ask then: Did God reject his people? By no means! I am an Israelite myself, a descendant of Abraham, from the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.textEnEsv: I ask, then, has God rejected his people? By no means! For I myself am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, a member of the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.textEnNkjv: I say then, has God cast away His people? Certainly not! For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.textEnNlt: I ask, then, has God rejected his own people, the nation of Israel? Of course not! I myself am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham and a member of the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.textEnNasb: I say then, God has not rejected His people, has He? Far from it! For I too am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.textEn: I ask then: Did God reject his people? By no means! I am an Israelite myself, a descendant of Abraham, from the tribe of Benjamin.

verses.textZh: 神并没有丢弃他预先知道的子民。难道你们不知道在经上以利亚的话是怎样说的吗？他向神控诉以色列人：
verses.textZhCnvs: 神并没有丢弃他预先知道的子民。难道你们不知道在经上以利亚的话是怎样说的吗？他向神控诉以色列人：
verses.textZhCuv: 神并没有弃绝他预先所知道的百姓。你们岂不晓得经上论到以利亚是怎么说的呢？他在神面前怎样控告以色列人说：
verses.textEnNiv: God did not reject his people, whom he foreknew. Don’t you know what Scripture says in the passage about Elijah—how he appealed to God against Israel:
verses.textEnEsv: God has not rejected his people whom he foreknew. Do you not know what the Scripture says of Elijah, how he appeals to God against Israel?
verses.textEnNkjv: God has not cast away His people whom He foreknew. Or do you not know what the Scripture says of Elijah, how he pleads with God against Israel, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: No, God has not rejected his own people, whom he chose from the very beginning. Do you realize what the Scriptures say about this? Elijah the prophet complained to God about the people of Israel and said,
verses.textEnNasb: God has not rejected His people whom He foreknew. Or do you not know what the Scripture says in the passage about Elijah, how he pleads with God against Israel?
verses.textEn: God did not reject his people, whom he foreknew. Don’t you know what Scripture says in the passage about Elijah—how he appealed to God against Israel:

verses.textZh: "主啊，他们杀了你的众先知，拆毁了你的祭坛，只剩下我一个人，他们还在寻索我的性命。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "主啊，他们杀了你的众先知，拆毁了你的祭坛，只剩下我一个人，他们还在寻索我的性命。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「主啊，他们杀了你的先知，拆了你的祭坛，只剩下我一个人；他们还要寻索我的命。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Lord, they have killed your prophets and torn down your altars; I am the only one left, and they are trying to kill me" ?
verses.textEnEsv: "Lord, they have killed your prophets, they have demolished your altars, and I alone am left, and they seek my life."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Lord, they have killed Your prophets and torn down Your altars, and I alone am left, and they seek my life"?
verses.textEnNlt: " Lord , they have killed your prophets and torn down your altars. I am the only one left, and now they are trying to kill me, too."
verses.textEnNasb: "Lord, they have killed Your prophets, they have torn down Your altars, and I alone am left, and they are seeking my life."
verses.textEn: "Lord, they have killed your prophets and torn down your altars; I am the only one left, and they are trying to kill me" ?

verses.textZh: 但神怎样回答他呢？"我为自己留下了七千人，是没有向巴力屈膝的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但神怎样回答他呢？"我为自己留下了七千人，是没有向巴力屈膝的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 神的回话是怎么说的呢？他说：「我为自己留下七千人，是未曾向巴力屈膝的。」
verses.textEnNiv: And what was God’s answer to him? "I have reserved for myself seven thousand who have not bowed the knee to Baal."
verses.textEnEsv: But what is God’s reply to him? "I have kept for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal."
verses.textEnNkjv: But what does the divine response say to him? "I have reserved for Myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal."
verses.textEnNlt: And do you remember God’s reply? He said, "No, I have 7,000 others who have never bowed down to Baal!"
verses.textEnNasb: But what is the divine response to him? "I have kept for Myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal."
verses.textEn: And what was God’s answer to him? "I have reserved for myself seven thousand who have not bowed the knee to Baal."

verses.textZh: 因此，现在也是这样，按着恩典的拣选，还有剩下的余数。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，现在也是这样，按着恩典的拣选，还有剩下的余数。
verses.textZhCuv: 如今也是这样，照着拣选的恩典，还有所留的余数。
verses.textEnNiv: So too, at the present time there is a remnant chosen by grace.
verses.textEnEsv: So too at the present time there is a remnant, chosen by grace.
verses.textEnNkjv: Even so then, at this present time there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
verses.textEnNlt: It is the same today, for a few of the people of Israel have remained faithful because of God’s grace—his undeserved kindness in choosing them.
verses.textEnNasb: In the same way then, there has also come to be at the present time a remnant according to God’s gracious choice.
verses.textEn: So too, at the present time there is a remnant chosen by grace.

verses.textZh: 既然是靠着恩典，就不再是由于行为了；不然的话，恩典就不再是恩典了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 既然是靠着恩典，就不再是由于行为了；不然的话，恩典就不再是恩典了。
verses.textZhCuv: 既是出于恩典，就不在乎行为；不然，恩典就不是恩典了。
verses.textEnNiv: And if by grace, then it cannot be based on works; if it were, grace would no longer be grace.
verses.textEnEsv: But if it is by grace, it is no longer on the basis of works; otherwise grace would no longer be grace.
verses.textEnNkjv: And if by grace, then itis no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if itis of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.
verses.textEnNlt: And since it is through God’s kindness, then it is not by their good works. For in that case, God’s grace would not be what it really is—free and undeserved.
verses.textEnNasb: But if it is by grace, it is no longer on the basis of works, since otherwise grace is no longer grace.
verses.textEn: And if by grace, then it cannot be based on works; if it were, grace would no longer be grace.

verses.textZh: 那又怎么样呢？以色列人恳切寻找的，他们没有得到，蒙拣选的人倒得着了。其余的人都成了顽固的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 那又怎么样呢？以色列人恳切寻找的，他们没有得到，蒙拣选的人倒得着了。其余的人都成了顽固的，
verses.textZhCuv: 这是怎么样呢？以色列人所求的，他们没有得着。惟有蒙拣选的人得着了；其余的就成了顽梗不化的。
verses.textEnNiv: What then? What the people of Israel sought so earnestly they did not obtain. The elect among them did, but the others were hardened,
verses.textEnEsv: What then? Israel failed to obtain what it was seeking. The elect obtained it, but the rest were hardened,
verses.textEnNkjv: What then? Israel has not obtained what it seeks; but the elect have obtained it, and the rest were blinded.
verses.textEnNlt: So this is the situation: Most of the people of Israel have not found the favor of God they are looking for so earnestly. A few have—the ones God has chosen—but the hearts of the rest were hardened.
verses.textEnNasb: What then? What Israel is seeking, it has not obtained, but those who were chosen obtained it, and the rest were hardened;
verses.textEn: What then? What the people of Israel sought so earnestly they did not obtain. The elect among them did, but the others were hardened,

verses.textZh: 正如经上所记： "神给了他们麻木的灵， 有眼睛却看不见， 有耳朵却听不到， 直到今日。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 正如经上所记： "神给了他们麻木的灵， 有眼睛却看不见， 有耳朵却听不到， 直到今日。"
verses.textZhCuv: 如经上所记：神给他们昏迷的心， 眼睛不能看见， 耳朵不能听见， 直到今日。
verses.textEnNiv: as it is written: "God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that could not see and ears that could not hear, to this very day."
verses.textEnEsv: as it is written, "God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that would not see and ears that would not hear, down to this very day."
verses.textEnNkjv: Just as it is written: "God has given them a spirit of stupor, Eyes that they should not see And ears that they should not hear, To this very day."
verses.textEnNlt: As the Scriptures say, "God has put them into a deep sleep. To this day he has shut their eyes so they do not see, and closed their ears so they do not hear."
verses.textEnNasb: just as it is written: "God gave them a spirit of stupor, Eyes to see not and ears to hear not, Down to this very day."
verses.textEn: as it is written: "God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that could not see and ears that could not hear, to this very day."

verses.textZh: 大卫也说： "愿他们的筵席成为他们的网罗、陷阱、 绊脚石和报应；
verses.textZhCnvs: 大卫也说： "愿他们的筵席成为他们的网罗、陷阱、 绊脚石和报应；
verses.textZhCuv: 大卫也说： 愿他们的筵席变为网罗，变为机槛， 变为绊脚石，作他们的报应。
verses.textEnNiv: And David says: "May their table become a snare and a trap, a stumbling block and a retribution for them.
verses.textEnEsv: And David says, "Let their table become a snare and a trap, a stumbling block and a retribution for them;
verses.textEnNkjv: And David says: "Let their table become a snare and a trap, A stumbling block and a recompense to them.
verses.textEnNlt: Likewise, David said, "Let their bountiful table become a snare, a trap that makes them think all is well. Let their blessings cause them to stumble, and let them get what they deserve.
verses.textEnNasb: And David says, "May their table become a snare and a trap, And a stumbling block and a retribution to them.
verses.textEn: And David says: "May their table become a snare and a trap, a stumbling block and a retribution for them.

verses.textZh: 愿他们的眼睛昏暗，不能看见； 愿他们的背脊常常弯曲。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他们的眼睛昏暗，不能看见； 愿他们的背脊常常弯曲。"
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他们的眼睛昏蒙，不得看见； 愿你时常弯下他们的腰。
verses.textEnNiv: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever."
verses.textEnEsv: let their eyes be darkened so that they cannot see, and bend their backs forever."
verses.textEnNkjv: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they do not see, And bow down their back always."
verses.textEnNlt: Let their eyes go blind so they cannot see, and let their backs be bent forever."
verses.textEnNasb: "May their eyes be darkened to see not, And bend their backs continually."
verses.textEn: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever."

verses.textZh: 那么我要说，他们失足是要倒下去吗？绝对不是！反而因为他们的过犯，救恩就临到外族人，为了要激起他们奋发。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么我要说，他们失足是要倒下去吗？绝对不是！反而因为他们的过犯，救恩就临到外族人，为了要激起他们奋发。
verses.textZhCuv: 我且说，他们失脚是要他们跌倒吗？断乎不是！反倒因他们的过失，救恩便临到外邦人，要激动他们发愤。
verses.textEnNiv: Again I ask: Did they stumble so as to fall beyond recovery? Not at all! Rather, because of their transgression, salvation has come to the Gentiles to make Israel envious.
verses.textEnEsv: So I ask, did they stumble in order that they might fall? By no means! Rather, through their trespass salvation has come to the Gentiles, so as to make Israel jealous.
verses.textEnNkjv: I say then, have they stumbled that they should fall? Certainly not! But through their fall, to provoke them to jealousy, salvation hascome to the Gentiles.
verses.textEnNlt: Did God’s people stumble and fall beyond recovery? Of course not! They were disobedient, so God made salvation available to the Gentiles. But he wanted his own people to become jealous and claim it for themselves.
verses.textEnNasb: I say then, they did not stumble so as to fall, did they? Far from it! But by their wrongdoing salvation has come to the Gentiles, to make them jealous.
verses.textEn: Again I ask: Did they stumble so as to fall beyond recovery? Not at all! Rather, because of their transgression, salvation has come to the Gentiles to make Israel envious.

verses.textZh: 既然他们的过犯可以使世人富足，他们的失败可以使外族人富足，何况他们的丰盛呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 既然他们的过犯可以使世人富足，他们的失败可以使外族人富足，何况他们的丰盛呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 若他们的过失为天下的富足，他们的缺乏为外邦人的富足，何况他们的丰满呢？
verses.textEnNiv: But if their transgression means riches for the world, and their loss means riches for the Gentiles, how much greater riches will their full inclusion bring!
verses.textEnEsv: Now if their trespass means riches for the world, and if their failure means riches for the Gentiles, how much more will their full inclusion mean!
verses.textEnNkjv: Now if their fall is riches for the world, and their failure riches for the Gentiles, how much more their fullness!
verses.textEnNlt: Now if the Gentiles were enriched because the people of Israel turned down God’s offer of salvation, think how much greater a blessing the world will share when they finally accept it.
verses.textEnNasb: Now if their wrongdoing proves to be riches for the world, and their failure, riches for the Gentiles, how much more will their fulfillment be!
verses.textEn: But if their transgression means riches for the world, and their loss means riches for the Gentiles, how much greater riches will their full inclusion bring!

verses.textZh: 我现在对你们外族人说话，因为我是外族人的使徒，所以尊重我的职分，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我现在对你们外族人说话，因为我是外族人的使徒，所以尊重我的职分，
verses.textZhCuv: 我对你们外邦人说这话；因我是外邦人的使徒，所以敬重 我的职分，
verses.textEnNiv: I am talking to you Gentiles. Inasmuch as I am the apostle to the Gentiles, I take pride in my ministry
verses.textEnEsv: Now I am speaking to you Gentiles. Inasmuch then as I am an apostle to the Gentiles, I magnify my ministry
verses.textEnNkjv: For I speak to you Gentiles; inasmuch as I am an apostle to the Gentiles, I magnify my ministry,
verses.textEnNlt: I am saying all this especially for you Gentiles. God has appointed me as the apostle to the Gentiles. I stress this,
verses.textEnNasb: But I am speaking to you who are Gentiles. Therefore insofar as I am an apostle of Gentiles, I magnify my ministry
verses.textEn: I am talking to you Gentiles. Inasmuch as I am the apostle to the Gentiles, I take pride in my ministry

verses.textZh: 这样也许可以激起我骨肉之亲奋发，使他们中间有一些人得救。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样也许可以激起我骨肉之亲奋发，使他们中间有一些人得救。
verses.textZhCuv: 或者可以激动我骨肉之亲发愤，好救他们一些人。
verses.textEnNiv: in the hope that I may somehow arouse my own people to envy and save some of them.
verses.textEnEsv: in order somehow to make my fellow Jews jealous, and thus save some of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy thosewhoare my flesh and save some of them.
verses.textEnNlt: for I want somehow to make the people of Israel jealous of what you Gentiles have, so I might save some of them.
verses.textEnNasb: if somehow I may move my own people to jealousy and save some of them.
verses.textEn: in the hope that I may somehow arouse my own people to envy and save some of them.

verses.textZh: 如果他们被舍弃，世人就可以与神复和；他们蒙接纳，不就等于从死人中复活吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果他们被舍弃，世人就可以与神复和；他们蒙接纳，不就等于从死人中复活吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 若他们被丢弃，天下就得与神和好，他们被收纳，岂不是死而复生吗？
verses.textEnNiv: For if their rejection brought reconciliation to the world, what will their acceptance be but life from the dead?
verses.textEnEsv: For if their rejection means the reconciliation of the world, what will their acceptance mean but life from the dead?
verses.textEnNkjv: For if their being cast away is the reconciling of the world, what will their acceptance be but life from the dead?
verses.textEnNlt: For since their rejection meant that God offered salvation to the rest of the world, their acceptance will be even more wonderful. It will be life for those who were dead!
verses.textEnNasb: For if their rejection proves to be the reconciliation of the world, what will their acceptance be but life from the dead?
verses.textEn: For if their rejection brought reconciliation to the world, what will their acceptance be but life from the dead?

verses.textZh: 如果首先献上的生面是圣的，整团面也是圣的；如果树根是圣的，树枝也是圣的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果首先献上的生面是圣的，整团面也是圣的；如果树根是圣的，树枝也是圣的。
verses.textZhCuv: 所献的新面若是圣洁，全团也就圣洁了；树根若是圣洁，树枝也就圣洁了。
verses.textEnNiv: If the part of the dough offered as firstfruits is holy, then the whole batch is holy; if the root is holy, so are the branches.
verses.textEnEsv: If the dough offered as firstfruits is holy, so is the whole lump, and if the root is holy, so are the branches.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if the firstfruit is holy, the lump is also holy; and if the root is holy, so are the branches.
verses.textEnNlt: And since Abraham and the other patriarchs were holy, their descendants will also be holy—just as the entire batch of dough is holy because the portion given as an offering is holy. For if the roots of the tree are holy, the branches will be, too.
verses.textEnNasb: If the first piece of dough is holy, the lump is also; and if the root is holy, the branches are as well.
verses.textEn: If the part of the dough offered as firstfruits is holy, then the whole batch is holy; if the root is holy, so are the branches.

verses.textZh: 如果把几根树枝折下来，让你这野橄榄可以接上去，一同分享那橄榄树根的汁浆，
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果把几根树枝折下来，让你这野橄榄可以接上去，一同分享那橄榄树根的汁浆，
verses.textZhCuv: 若有几根枝子被折下来，你这野橄榄得接在其中，一同得着橄榄根的肥汁，
verses.textEnNiv: If some of the branches have been broken off, and you, though a wild olive shoot, have been grafted in among the others and now share in the nourishing sap from the olive root,
verses.textEnEsv: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, although a wild olive shoot, were grafted in among the others and now share in the nourishing root of the olive tree,
verses.textEnNkjv: And if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive tree, were grafted in among them, and with them became a partaker of the root and fatness of the olive tree,
verses.textEnNlt: But some of these branches from Abraham’s tree—some of the people of Israel—have been broken off. And you Gentiles, who were branches from a wild olive tree, have been grafted in. So now you also receive the blessing God has promised Abraham and his children, sharing in the rich nourishment from the root of God’s special olive tree.
verses.textEnNasb: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became partaker with them of the rich root of the olive tree,
verses.textEn: If some of the branches have been broken off, and you, though a wild olive shoot, have been grafted in among the others and now share in the nourishing sap from the olive root,

verses.textZh: 你就不可向那些树枝夸口。你若要夸口，就应当想想：不是你支持着树根，而是树根支持着你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你就不可向那些树枝夸口。你若要夸口，就应当想想：不是你支持着树根，而是树根支持着你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你就不可向旧枝子夸口；若是夸口，当知道不是你托着根，乃是根托着你。
verses.textEnNiv: do not consider yourself to be superior to those other branches. If you do, consider this: You do not support the root, but the root supports you.
verses.textEnEsv: do not be arrogant toward the branches. If you are, remember it is not you who support the root, but the root that supports you.
verses.textEnNkjv: do not boast against the branches. But if you do boast, rememberthat you do not support the root, but the root supports you.
verses.textEnNlt: But you must not brag about being grafted in to replace the branches that were broken off. You are just a branch, not the root.
verses.textEnNasb: do not be arrogant toward the branches; but if you are arrogant, remember that it is not you who supports the root, but the root supports you.
verses.textEn: do not consider yourself to be superior to those other branches. If you do, consider this: You do not support the root, but the root supports you.

verses.textZh: 那么你会说，那些树枝被折下来，就是要把我接上去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那么你会说，那些树枝被折下来，就是要把我接上去。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若说，那枝子被折下来是特为叫我接上。
verses.textEnNiv: You will say then, "Branches were broken off so that I could be grafted in."
verses.textEnEsv: Then you will say, "Branches were broken off so that I might be grafted in."
verses.textEnNkjv: You will say then, "Branches were broken off that I might be grafted in."
verses.textEnNlt: "Well," you may say, "those branches were broken off to make room for me."
verses.textEnNasb: You will say then, "Branches were broken off so that I might be grafted in."
verses.textEn: You will say then, "Branches were broken off so that I could be grafted in."

verses.textZh: 不错，他们因为不信而被折下来，你因着信才站立得住。只是不可心高气傲，倒要存畏惧的心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不错，他们因为不信而被折下来，你因着信才站立得住。只是不可心高气傲，倒要存畏惧的心。
verses.textZhCuv: 不错！他们因为不信，所以被折下来；你因为信，所以立得住；你不可自高，反要惧怕。
verses.textEnNiv: Granted. But they were broken off because of unbelief, and you stand by faith. Do not be arrogant, but tremble.
verses.textEnEsv: That is true. They were broken off because of their unbelief, but you stand fast through faith. So do not become proud, but fear.
verses.textEnNkjv: Well said. Because of unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by faith. Do not be haughty, but fear.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, but remember—those branches were broken off because they didn’t believe in Christ, and you are there because you do believe. So don’t think highly of yourself, but fear what could happen.
verses.textEnNasb: Quite right, they were broken off for their unbelief, but you stand by your faith. Do not be conceited, but fear;
verses.textEn: Granted. But they were broken off because of unbelief, and you stand by faith. Do not be arrogant, but tremble.

verses.textZh: 神既然不顾惜那本来的树枝，也不会顾惜你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神既然不顾惜那本来的树枝，也不会顾惜你。
verses.textZhCuv: 神既不爱惜原来的枝子，也必不爱惜你。
verses.textEnNiv: For if God did not spare the natural branches, he will not spare you either.
verses.textEnEsv: For if God did not spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if God did not spare the natural branches, He may not spare you either.
verses.textEnNlt: For if God did not spare the original branches, he won’t spare you either.
verses.textEnNasb: for if God did not spare the natural branches, He will not spare you, either.
verses.textEn: For if God did not spare the natural branches, he will not spare you either.

verses.textZh: 所以要留意神的恩慈和严厉：对跌倒的人，他是严厉的；对你，只要你继续在他的恩慈里，他是恩慈的；不然的话，你也会被砍下来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以要留意神的恩慈和严厉：对跌倒的人，他是严厉的；对你，只要你继续在他的恩慈里，他是恩慈的；不然的话，你也会被砍下来。
verses.textZhCuv: 可见，神的恩慈和严厉向那跌倒的人是严厉的，向你是有恩慈的，只要你长久在他的恩慈里；不然，你也要被砍下来。
verses.textEnNiv: Consider therefore the kindness and sternness of God: sternness to those who fell, but kindness to you, provided that you continue in his kindness. Otherwise, you also will be cut off.
verses.textEnEsv: Note then the kindness and the severity of God: severity toward those who have fallen, but God’s kindness to you, provided you continue in his kindness. Otherwise you too will be cut off.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore consider the goodness and severity of God: on those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in His goodness. Otherwise you also will be cut off.
verses.textEnNlt: Notice how God is both kind and severe. He is severe toward those who disobeyed, but kind to you if you continue to trust in his kindness. But if you stop trusting, you also will be cut off.
verses.textEnNasb: See then the kindness and severity of God: to those who fell, severity, but to you, God’s kindness, if you continue in His kindness; for otherwise you too will be cut off.
verses.textEn: Consider therefore the kindness and sternness of God: sternness to those who fell, but kindness to you, provided that you continue in his kindness. Otherwise, you also will be cut off.

verses.textZh: 至于他们，如果不是继续不信，他们仍然会被接上去，因为神能够把他们再接上去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于他们，如果不是继续不信，他们仍然会被接上去，因为神能够把他们再接上去。
verses.textZhCuv: 而且他们若不是长久不信，仍要被接上，因为神能够把他们重新接上。
verses.textEnNiv: And if they do not persist in unbelief, they will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
verses.textEnEsv: And even they, if they do not continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God has the power to graft them in again.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they also, if they do not continue in unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
verses.textEnNlt: And if the people of Israel turn from their unbelief, they will be grafted in again, for God has the power to graft them back into the tree.
verses.textEnNasb: And they also, if they do not continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in; for God is able to graft them in again.
verses.textEn: And if they do not persist in unbelief, they will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

verses.textZh: 你这从野生的橄榄树上砍下来的，尚且可以不自然地接在栽种的橄榄树上，那些本来就有的树枝，不是更能够接在原来的橄榄树上吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这从野生的橄榄树上砍下来的，尚且可以不自然地接在栽种的橄榄树上，那些本来就有的树枝，不是更能够接在原来的橄榄树上吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 你是从那天生的野橄榄上砍下来的，尚且逆着性得接在好橄榄上，何况这本树的枝子，要接在本树上呢！
verses.textEnNiv: After all, if you were cut out of an olive tree that is wild by nature, and contrary to nature were grafted into a cultivated olive tree, how much more readily will these, the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree!
verses.textEnEsv: For if you were cut from what is by nature a wild olive tree, and grafted, contrary to nature, into a cultivated olive tree, how much more will these, the natural branches, be grafted back into their own olive tree.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if you were cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and were grafted contrary to nature into a cultivated olive tree, how much more will these, who are natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?
verses.textEnNlt: You, by nature, were a branch cut from a wild olive tree. So if God was willing to do something contrary to nature by grafting you into his cultivated tree, he will be far more eager to graft the original branches back into the tree where they belong.
verses.textEnNasb: For if you were cut off from what is by nature a wild olive tree, and contrary to nature were grafted into a cultivated olive tree, how much more will these who are the natural branches be grafted into their own olive tree?
verses.textEn: After all, if you were cut out of an olive tree that is wild by nature, and contrary to nature were grafted into a cultivated olive tree, how much more readily will these, the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree!

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我不愿意你们对这奥秘一无所知，免得你们自以为聪明。这奥秘就是以色列人当中有一部分是硬心的，直到外族人的全数满了；
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我不愿意你们对这奥秘一无所知，免得你们自以为聪明。这奥秘就是以色列人当中有一部分是硬心的，直到外族人的全数满了；
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我不愿意你们不知道这奥秘（恐怕你们自以为聪明），就是以色列人有几分是硬心的，等到外邦人的数目添满了，
verses.textEnNiv: I do not want you to be ignorant of this mystery, brothers and sisters, so that you may not be conceited: Israel has experienced a hardening in part until the full number of the Gentiles has come in,
verses.textEnEsv: Lest you be wise in your own sight, I do not want you to be unaware of this mystery, brothers: a partial hardening has come upon Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I do not desire, brethren, that you should be ignorant of this mystery, lest you should be wise in your own opinion, that blindness in part has happened to Israel until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in.
verses.textEnNlt: I want you to understand this mystery, dear brothers and sisters, so that you will not feel proud about yourselves. Some of the people of Israel have hard hearts, but this will last only until the full number of Gentiles comes to Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: For I do not want you, brothers and sisters, to be uninformed of this mystery—so that you will not be wise in your own estimation—that a partial hardening has happened to Israel until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in;
verses.textEn: I do not want you to be ignorant of this mystery, brothers and sisters, so that you may not be conceited: Israel has experienced a hardening in part until the full number of the Gentiles has come in,

verses.textZh: 这样，全以色列都要得救，如经上所记： "拯救者必从锡安出来， 除掉雅各家的不敬虔的心；
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，全以色列都要得救，如经上所记： "拯救者必从锡安出来， 除掉雅各家的不敬虔的心；
verses.textZhCuv: 于是以色列全家都要得救。如经上所记： 必有一位救主从锡安出来， 要消除雅各家的一切罪恶；
verses.textEnNiv: and in this way all Israel will be saved. As it is written: "The deliverer will come from Zion; he will turn godlessness away from Jacob.
verses.textEnEsv: And in this way all Israel will be saved, as it is written, "The Deliverer will come from Zion, he will banish ungodliness from Jacob";
verses.textEnNkjv: And so all Israel will be saved, as it is written: "The Deliverer will come out of Zion, And He will turn away ungodliness from Jacob;
verses.textEnNlt: And so all Israel will be saved. As the Scriptures say, "The one who rescues will come from Jerusalem, and he will turn Israel away from ungodliness.
verses.textEnNasb: and so all Israel will be saved; just as it is written: "The Deliverer will come from Zion, He will remove ungodliness from Jacob."
verses.textEn: and in this way all Israel will be saved. As it is written: "The deliverer will come from Zion; he will turn godlessness away from Jacob.

verses.textZh: 我除去他们罪恶的时候， 就与他们立这样的约。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我除去他们罪恶的时候， 就与他们立这样的约。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：我除去他们罪的时候， 这就是我与他们所立的约。
verses.textEnNiv: And this is my covenant with them when I take away their sins."
verses.textEnEsv: "and this will be my covenant with them when I take away their sins."
verses.textEnNkjv: For this is My covenant with them, When I take away their sins."
verses.textEnNlt: And this is my covenant with them, that I will take away their sins."
verses.textEnNasb: "This is My covenant with them, When I take away their sins."
verses.textEn: And this is my covenant with them when I take away their sins."

verses.textZh: 就福音来说，因你们的缘故，他们是仇敌；就拣选来说，因祖宗的缘故，他们是蒙爱的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就福音来说，因你们的缘故，他们是仇敌；就拣选来说，因祖宗的缘故，他们是蒙爱的。
verses.textZhCuv: 就着福音说，他们为你们的缘故是仇敌；就着拣选说，他们为列祖的缘故是蒙爱的。
verses.textEnNiv: As far as the gospel is concerned, they are enemies for your sake; but as far as election is concerned, they are loved on account of the patriarchs,
verses.textEnEsv: As regards the gospel, they are enemies for your sake. But as regards election, they are beloved for the sake of their forefathers.
verses.textEnNkjv: Concerning the gospel theyare enemies for your sake, but concerning the election theyare beloved for the sake of the fathers.
verses.textEnNlt: Many of the people of Israel are now enemies of the Good News, and this benefits you Gentiles. Yet they are still the people he loves because he chose their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
verses.textEnNasb: In relation to the gospel they are enemies on your account, but in relation to God’s choice they are beloved on account of the fathers;
verses.textEn: As far as the gospel is concerned, they are enemies for your sake; but as far as election is concerned, they are loved on account of the patriarchs,

verses.textZh: 因为神的恩赏和呼召是决不会反悔的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神的恩赏和呼召是决不会反悔的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为神的恩赐和选召是没有后悔的。
verses.textEnNiv: for God’s gifts and his call are irrevocable.
verses.textEnEsv: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.
verses.textEnNlt: For God’s gifts and his call can never be withdrawn.
verses.textEnNasb: for the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.
verses.textEn: for God’s gifts and his call are irrevocable.

verses.textZh: 正如你们从前不顺服神，现在却因着他们的不顺服，你们倒蒙了怜悯；
verses.textZhCnvs: 正如你们从前不顺服神，现在却因着他们的不顺服，你们倒蒙了怜悯；
verses.textZhCuv: 你们从前不顺服神，如今因他们的不顺服，你们倒蒙了怜恤。
verses.textEnNiv: Just as you who were at one time disobedient to God have now received mercy as a result of their disobedience,
verses.textEnEsv: For just as you were at one time disobedient to God but now have received mercy because of their disobedience,
verses.textEnNkjv: For as you were once disobedient to God, yet have now obtained mercy through their disobedience,
verses.textEnNlt: Once, you Gentiles were rebels against God, but when the people of Israel rebelled against him, God was merciful to you instead.
verses.textEnNasb: For just as you once were disobedient to God, but now have been shown mercy because of their disobedience,
verses.textEn: Just as you who were at one time disobedient to God have now received mercy as a result of their disobedience,

verses.textZh: 照样，他们因着你们所蒙的怜悯，现在也不顺服，使他们现在也可以蒙怜悯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，他们因着你们所蒙的怜悯，现在也不顺服，使他们现在也可以蒙怜悯。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样，他们也是不顺服，叫他们因着施给你们的怜恤，现在也就蒙怜恤。
verses.textEnNiv: so they too have now become disobedient in order that they too may now receive mercy as a result of God’s mercy to you.
verses.textEnEsv: so they too have now been disobedient in order that by the mercy shown to you they also may now receive mercy.
verses.textEnNkjv: even so these also have now been disobedient, that through the mercy shown you they also may obtain mercy.
verses.textEnNlt: Now they are the rebels, and God’s mercy has come to you so that they, too, will share in God’s mercy.
verses.textEnNasb: so these also now have been disobedient, that because of the mercy shown to you they also may now be shown mercy.
verses.textEn: so they too have now become disobedient in order that they too may now receive mercy as a result of God’s mercy to you.

verses.textZh: 因为神把所有的人都圈在不顺服之中，为了要怜悯所有的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神把所有的人都圈在不顺服之中，为了要怜悯所有的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为神将众人都圈在不顺服之中，特意要怜恤众人。
verses.textEnNiv: For God has bound everyone over to disobedience so that he may have mercy on them all.
verses.textEnEsv: For God has consigned all to disobedience, that he may have mercy on all.
verses.textEnNkjv: For God has committed them all to disobedience, that He might have mercy on all.
verses.textEnNlt: For God has imprisoned everyone in disobedience so he could have mercy on everyone.
verses.textEnNasb: For God has shut up all in disobedience, so that He may show mercy to all.
verses.textEn: For God has bound everyone over to disobedience so that he may have mercy on them all.

verses.textZh: 神的丰富、智慧和知识，是多么高深啊！他的判断是多么难测，他的道路是多么难寻！
verses.textZhCnvs: 神的丰富、智慧和知识，是多么高深啊！他的判断是多么难测，他的道路是多么难寻！
verses.textZhCuv: 深哉，神丰富的智慧和知识！ 他的判断何其难测！ 他的踪迹何其难寻！
verses.textEnNiv: Oh, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable his judgments, and his paths beyond tracing out!
verses.textEnEsv: Oh, the depth of the riches and wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments and how inscrutable his ways!
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments and His ways past finding out!
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, how great are God’s riches and wisdom and knowledge! How impossible it is for us to understand his decisions and his ways!
verses.textEnNasb: Oh, the depth of the riches, both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments and unfathomable His ways!
verses.textEn: Oh, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable his judgments, and his paths beyond tracing out!

verses.textZh: "谁知道主的心意， 谁作过他的参谋？"
verses.textZhCnvs: "谁知道主的心意， 谁作过他的参谋？"
verses.textZhCuv: 谁知道主的心？ 谁作过他的谋士呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?"
verses.textEnEsv: "For who has known the mind of the Lord, or who has been his counselor?"
verses.textEnNkjv: "For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has become His counselor?"
verses.textEnNlt: For who can know the Lord ’s thoughts? Who knows enough to give him advice?
verses.textEnNasb: For who has known the mind of the Lord, or who became His counselor?
verses.textEn: "Who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?"

verses.textZh: "谁先给了他， 以致他要偿还呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: "谁先给了他， 以致他要偿还呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 谁是先给了他， 使他后来偿还呢？
verses.textEnNiv: "Who has ever given to God, that God should repay them?"
verses.textEnEsv: "Or who has given a gift to him that he might be repaid?"
verses.textEnNkjv: "Or who has first given to Him And it shall be repaid to him?"
verses.textEnNlt: And who has given him so much that he needs to pay it back?
verses.textEnNasb: Or who has first given to Him, that it would be paid back to him?
verses.textEn: "Who has ever given to God, that God should repay them?"

verses.textZh: 因为万有都是本于他，倚靠他，归于他。愿荣耀归给他，直到永远。阿们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为万有都是本于他，倚靠他，归于他。愿荣耀归给他，直到永远。阿们。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为万有都是本于他， 倚靠他，归于他。 愿荣耀归给他，直到永远。阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: For from him and through him and for him are all things. To him be the glory forever! Amen.
verses.textEnEsv: For from him and through him and to him are all things. To him be glory forever. Amen.
verses.textEnNkjv: For of Him and through Him and to Him are all things, to whom be glory forever. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: For everything comes from him and exists by his power and is intended for his glory. All glory to him forever! Amen.
verses.textEnNasb: For from Him, and through Him, and to Him are all things. To Him be the glory forever. Amen.
verses.textEn: For from him and through him and for him are all things. To him be the glory forever! Amen.

verses.textZh: 所以弟兄们，我凭着神的仁慈劝你们，要把身体献上，作圣洁而蒙神悦纳的活祭；这是你们理所当然的事奉 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以弟兄们，我凭着神的仁慈劝你们，要把身体献上，作圣洁而蒙神悦纳的活祭；这是你们理所当然的事奉 。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，弟兄们，我以神的慈悲劝你们，将身体献上，当作活祭，是圣洁的，是神所喜悦的；你们如此事奉乃是理所当然的。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, I urge you, brothers and sisters, in view of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God—this is your true and proper worship.
verses.textEnEsv: I appeal to you therefore, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and acceptable to God, which is your spiritual worship.
verses.textEnNkjv: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that you present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, whichis your reasonable service.
verses.textEnNlt: And so, dear brothers and sisters, I plead with you to give your bodies to God because of all he has done for you. Let them be a living and holy sacrifice—the kind he will find acceptable. This is truly the way to worship him.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I urge you, brothers and sisters, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies as a living and holy sacrifice, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service of worship.
verses.textEn: Therefore, I urge you, brothers and sisters, in view of God’s mercy, to offer your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God—this is your true and proper worship.

verses.textZh: 不要模仿这个世代，倒要借着心意的更新而改变过来，使你们可以察验出甚么是神的旨意，就是察验出甚么是美好的、蒙他悦纳的和完全的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要模仿这个世代，倒要借着心意的更新而改变过来，使你们可以察验出甚么是神的旨意，就是察验出甚么是美好的、蒙他悦纳的和完全的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要效法这个世界，只要心意更新而变化，叫你们察验何为神的善良、纯全、可喜悦的旨意。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is—his good, pleasing and perfect will.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewal of your mind, that by testing you may discern what is the will of God, what is good and acceptable and perfect.
verses.textEnNkjv: And do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, that you may prove what is that good and acceptable and perfect will of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t copy the behavior and customs of this world, but let God transform you into a new person by changing the way you think. Then you will learn to know God’s will for you, which is good and pleasing and perfect.
verses.textEnNasb: And do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what the will of God is, that which is good and acceptable and perfect.
verses.textEn: Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is—his good, pleasing and perfect will.

verses.textZh: 我凭着所赐给我的恩典，对你们各人说，不可自视太高，高于所当看的，反而应该照着神分给各人信心的大小，看得适中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我凭着所赐给我的恩典，对你们各人说，不可自视太高，高于所当看的，反而应该照着神分给各人信心的大小，看得适中。
verses.textZhCuv: 我凭着所赐我的恩对你们各人说：不要看自己过于所当看的；要照着神所分给各人信心的大小，看得合乎中道。
verses.textEnNiv: For by the grace given me I say to every one of you: Do not think of yourself more highly than you ought, but rather think of yourself with sober judgment, in accordance with the faith God has distributed to each of you.
verses.textEnEsv: For by the grace given to me I say to everyone among you not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think, but to think with sober judgment, each according to the measure of faith that God has assigned.
verses.textEnNkjv: For I say, through the grace given to me, to everyone who is among you, not to think ofhimself more highly than he ought to think, but to think soberly, as God has dealt to each one a measure of faith.
verses.textEnNlt: Because of the privilege and authority God has given me, I give each of you this warning: Don’t think you are better than you really are. Be honest in your evaluation of yourselves, measuring yourselves by the faith God has given us.
verses.textEnNasb: For through the grace given to me I say to everyone among you not to think more highly of himself than he ought to think; but to think so as to have sound judgment, as God has allotted to each a measure of faith.
verses.textEn: For by the grace given me I say to every one of you: Do not think of yourself more highly than you ought, but rather think of yourself with sober judgment, in accordance with the faith God has distributed to each of you.

verses.textZh: 就像一个身体有许多肢体，各肢体都有不同的功用；
verses.textZhCnvs: 就像一个身体有许多肢体，各肢体都有不同的功用；
verses.textZhCuv: 正如我们一个身子上有好些肢体，肢体也不都是一样的用处。
verses.textEnNiv: For just as each of us has one body with many members, and these members do not all have the same function,
verses.textEnEsv: For as in one body we have many members, and the members do not all have the same function,
verses.textEnNkjv: For as we have many members in one body, but all the members do not have the same function,
verses.textEnNlt: Just as our bodies have many parts and each part has a special function,
verses.textEnNasb: For just as we have many parts in one body and all the body’s parts do not have the same function,
verses.textEn: For just as each of us has one body with many members, and these members do not all have the same function,

verses.textZh: 照样，我们大家在基督里成为一个身体，也是互相作肢体。
verses.textZhCnvs: 照样，我们大家在基督里成为一个身体，也是互相作肢体。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们这许多人，在基督里成为一身，互相联络作肢体，也是如此。
verses.textEnNiv: so in Christ we, though many, form one body, and each member belongs to all the others.
verses.textEnEsv: so we, though many, are one body in Christ, and individually members one of another.
verses.textEnNkjv: so we, being many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another.
verses.textEnNlt: so it is with Christ’s body. We are many parts of one body, and we all belong to each other.
verses.textEnNasb: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually parts of one another.
verses.textEn: so in Christ we, though many, form one body, and each member belongs to all the others.

verses.textZh: 照着所赐给我们的恩典，我们各有不同的恩赐：说预言的，就应当照着信心的程度去说；
verses.textZhCnvs: 照着所赐给我们的恩典，我们各有不同的恩赐：说预言的，就应当照着信心的程度去说；
verses.textZhCuv: 按我们所得的恩赐，各有不同。或说预言，就当照着信心的程度说预言；
verses.textEnNiv: We have different gifts, according to the grace given to each of us. If your gift is prophesying, then prophesy in accordance with your faith;
