verses.textEnEsv: Having gifts that differ according to the grace given to us, let us use them: if prophecy, in proportion to our faith;
verses.textEnNkjv: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, letususethem: if prophecy, letus prophesy in proportion to our faith;
verses.textEnNlt: In his grace, God has given us different gifts for doing certain things well. So if God has given you the ability to prophesy, speak out with as much faith as God has given you.
verses.textEnNasb: However, since we have gifts that differ according to the grace given to us, each of us is to use them properly: if prophecy, in proportion to one’s faith;
verses.textEn: We have different gifts, according to the grace given to each of us. If your gift is prophesying, then prophesy in accordance with your faith;

verses.textZh: 服事人的，就应当照着恩赐去服事；教导的，就应当照着恩赐教导；
verses.textZhCnvs: 服事人的，就应当照着恩赐去服事；教导的，就应当照着恩赐教导；
verses.textZhCuv: 或作执事，就当专一执事；或作教导的，就当专一教导；
verses.textEnNiv: if it is serving, then serve; if it is teaching, then teach;
verses.textEnEsv: if service, in our serving; the one who teaches, in his teaching;
verses.textEnNkjv: or ministry, letususeit in our ministering; he who teaches, in teaching;
verses.textEnNlt: If your gift is serving others, serve them well. If you are a teacher, teach well.
verses.textEnNasb: if service, in the act of serving; or the one who teaches, in the act of teaching;
verses.textEn: if it is serving, then serve; if it is teaching, then teach;

verses.textZh: 劝慰的，就应当照着恩赐劝慰；把财物分给人的要真诚；领导的要殷勤；行善的要乐意。
verses.textZhCnvs: 劝慰的，就应当照着恩赐劝慰；把财物分给人的要真诚；领导的要殷勤；行善的要乐意。
verses.textZhCuv: 或作劝化的，就当专一劝化；施舍的，就当诚实；治理的，就当殷勤；怜悯人的，就当甘心。
verses.textEnNiv: if it is to encourage, then give encouragement; if it is giving, then give generously; if it is to lead, do it diligently; if it is to show mercy, do it cheerfully.
verses.textEnEsv: the one who exhorts, in his exhortation; the one who contributes, in generosity; the one who leads, with zeal; the one who does acts of mercy, with cheerfulness.
verses.textEnNkjv: he who exhorts, in exhortation; he who gives, with liberality; he who leads, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.
verses.textEnNlt: If your gift is to encourage others, be encouraging. If it is giving, give generously. If God has given you leadership ability, take the responsibility seriously. And if you have a gift for showing kindness to others, do it gladly.
verses.textEnNasb: or the one who exhorts, in the work of exhortation; the one who gives, with generosity; the one who is in leadership, with diligence; the one who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.
verses.textEn: if it is to encourage, then give encouragement; if it is giving, then give generously; if it is to lead, do it diligently; if it is to show mercy, do it cheerfully.

verses.textZh: 爱，不可虚伪；恶，要厌恶；善，要持守。
verses.textZhCnvs: 爱，不可虚伪；恶，要厌恶；善，要持守。
verses.textZhCuv: 爱人不可虚假。恶，要厌恶；善，要亲近。
verses.textEnNiv: Love must be sincere. Hate what is evil; cling to what is good.
verses.textEnEsv: Let love be genuine. Abhor what is evil; hold fast to what is good.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor what is evil. Cling to what is good.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t just pretend to love others. Really love them. Hate what is wrong. Hold tightly to what is good.
verses.textEnNasb: Love must be free of hypocrisy. Detest what is evil; cling to what is good.
verses.textEn: Love must be sincere. Hate what is evil; cling to what is good.

verses.textZh: 要以手足之爱彼此相亲，用恭敬的心互相礼让。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要以手足之爱彼此相亲，用恭敬的心互相礼让。
verses.textZhCuv: 爱弟兄，要彼此亲热；恭敬人，要彼此推让。
verses.textEnNiv: Be devoted to one another in love. Honor one another above yourselves.
verses.textEnEsv: Love one another with brotherly affection. Outdo one another in showing honor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Be kindly affectionate to one another with brotherly love, in honor giving preference to one another;
verses.textEnNlt: Love each other with genuine affection, and take delight in honoring each other.
verses.textEnNasb: Be devoted to one another in brotherly love; give preference to one another in honor,
verses.textEn: Be devoted to one another in love. Honor one another above yourselves.

verses.textZh: 殷勤不可懒惰，心灵要火热，常常服事主；
verses.textZhCnvs: 殷勤不可懒惰，心灵要火热，常常服事主；
verses.textZhCuv: 殷勤，不可懒惰；要心里火热，常常服事主。
verses.textEnNiv: Never be lacking in zeal, but keep your spiritual fervor, serving the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not be slothful in zeal, be fervent in spirit, serve the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord;
verses.textEnNlt: Never be lazy, but work hard and serve the Lord enthusiastically.
verses.textEnNasb: not lagging behind in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord;
verses.textEn: Never be lacking in zeal, but keep your spiritual fervor, serving the Lord.

verses.textZh: 在盼望中要喜乐，在患难中要坚忍，祷告要恒切。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在盼望中要喜乐，在患难中要坚忍，祷告要恒切。
verses.textZhCuv: 在指望中要喜乐；在患难中要忍耐；祷告要恒切。
verses.textEnNiv: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, faithful in prayer.
verses.textEnEsv: Rejoice in hope, be patient in tribulation, be constant in prayer.
verses.textEnNkjv: rejoicing in hope, patient in tribulation, continuing steadfastly in prayer;
verses.textEnNlt: Rejoice in our confident hope. Be patient in trouble, and keep on praying.
verses.textEnNasb: rejoicing in hope, persevering in tribulation, devoted to prayer,
verses.textEn: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, faithful in prayer.

verses.textZh: 圣徒有缺乏的，就要接济；客旅要热诚地款待。
verses.textZhCnvs: 圣徒有缺乏的，就要接济；客旅要热诚地款待。
verses.textZhCuv: 圣徒缺乏，要帮补；客，要一味地款待。
verses.textEnNiv: Share with the Lord’s people who are in need. Practice hospitality.
verses.textEnEsv: Contribute to the needs of the saints and seek to show hospitality.
verses.textEnNkjv: distributing to the needs of the saints, given to hospitality.
verses.textEnNlt: When God’s people are in need, be ready to help them. Always be eager to practice hospitality.
verses.textEnNasb: contributing to the needs of the saints, practicing hospitality.
verses.textEn: Share with the Lord’s people who are in need. Practice hospitality.

verses.textZh: 迫害你们的，要为他们祝福；只可祝福，不可咒诅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迫害你们的，要为他们祝福；只可祝福，不可咒诅。
verses.textZhCuv: 逼迫你们的，要给他们祝福；只要祝福，不可咒诅。
verses.textEnNiv: Bless those who persecute you; bless and do not curse.
verses.textEnEsv: Bless those who persecute you; bless and do not curse them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Bless those who persecute you; bless and do not curse.
verses.textEnNlt: Bless those who persecute you. Don’t curse them; pray that God will bless them.
verses.textEnNasb: Bless those who persecute you; bless and do not curse.
verses.textEn: Bless those who persecute you; bless and do not curse.

verses.textZh: 要与喜乐的人一同喜乐，与哀哭的人一同哀哭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要与喜乐的人一同喜乐，与哀哭的人一同哀哭。
verses.textZhCuv: 与喜乐的人要同乐；与哀哭的人要同哭。
verses.textEnNiv: Rejoice with those who rejoice; mourn with those who mourn.
verses.textEnEsv: Rejoice with those who rejoice, weep with those who weep.
verses.textEnNkjv: Rejoice with those who rejoice, and weep with those who weep.
verses.textEnNlt: Be happy with those who are happy, and weep with those who weep.
verses.textEnNasb: Rejoice with those who rejoice, and weep with those who weep.
verses.textEn: Rejoice with those who rejoice; mourn with those who mourn.

verses.textZh: 要彼此同心，不可心高气傲，倒要俯就卑微的。不可自以为聪明。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要彼此同心，不可心高气傲，倒要俯就卑微的。不可自以为聪明。
verses.textZhCuv: 要彼此同心；不要志气高大，倒要俯就卑微的人 。不要自以为聪明。
verses.textEnNiv: Live in harmony with one another. Do not be proud, but be willing to associate with people of low position. Do not be conceited.
verses.textEnEsv: Live in harmony with one another. Do not be haughty, but associate with the lowly. Never be wise in your own sight.
verses.textEnNkjv: Be of the same mind toward one another. Do not set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Do not be wise in your own opinion.
verses.textEnNlt: Live in harmony with each other. Don’t be too proud to enjoy the company of ordinary people. And don’t think you know it all!
verses.textEnNasb: Be of the same mind toward one another; do not be haughty in mind, but associate with the lowly. Do not be wise in your own estimation.
verses.textEn: Live in harmony with one another. Do not be proud, but be willing to associate with people of low position. Do not be conceited.

verses.textZh: 不可以恶报恶。大家以为美的事，要努力去作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可以恶报恶。大家以为美的事，要努力去作。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要以恶报恶；众人以为美的事要留心去做。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not repay anyone evil for evil. Be careful to do what is right in the eyes of everyone.
verses.textEnEsv: Repay no one evil for evil, but give thought to do what is honorable in the sight of all.
verses.textEnNkjv: Repay no one evil for evil. Have regard for good things in the sight of all men.
verses.textEnNlt: Never pay back evil with more evil. Do things in such a way that everyone can see you are honorable.
verses.textEnNasb: Never repay evil for evil to anyone. Respect what is right in the sight of all people.
verses.textEn: Do not repay anyone evil for evil. Be careful to do what is right in the eyes of everyone.

verses.textZh: 可能的话，总要尽你们的所能与人和睦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可能的话，总要尽你们的所能与人和睦。
verses.textZhCuv: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。
verses.textEnNiv: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verses.textEnEsv: If possible, so far as it depends on you, live peaceably with all.
verses.textEnNkjv: If it is possible, as much as depends on you, live peaceably with all men.
verses.textEnNlt: Do all that you can to live in peace with everyone.
verses.textEnNasb: If possible, so far as it depends on you, be at peace with all people.
verses.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.

verses.textZh: 亲爱的啊，不要为自己伸冤，宁可等候主的忿怒，因为经上记着，主说："伸冤在我，我必报应。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亲爱的啊，不要为自己伸冤，宁可等候主的忿怒，因为经上记着，主说："伸冤在我，我必报应。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亲爱的弟兄，不要自己伸冤，宁可让步，听凭主怒 ；因为经上记着：「主说：『伸冤在我，我必报应。』」
verses.textEnNiv: Do not take revenge, my dear friends, but leave room for God’s wrath, for it is written: "It is mine to avenge; I will repay," says the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: Beloved, never avenge yourselves, but leave it to the wrath of God, for it is written, "Vengeance is mine, I will repay, says the Lord."
verses.textEnNkjv: Beloved, do not avenge yourselves, but rather give place to wrath; for it is written, "Vengeance is Mine, I will repay," says the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Dear friends, never take revenge. Leave that to the righteous anger of God. For the Scriptures say, "I will take revenge; I will pay them back," says the Lord .
verses.textEnNasb: Never take your own revenge, beloved, but leave room for the wrath of God, for it is written: "Vengeance is Mine, I will repay," says the Lord.
verses.textEn: Do not take revenge, my dear friends, but leave room for God’s wrath, for it is written: "It is mine to avenge; I will repay," says the Lord.

verses.textZh: 相反地，"如果你的仇敌饿了，就给他吃；如果渴了，就给他喝。因为你这样作，就是把炭火堆在他的头上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 相反地，"如果你的仇敌饿了，就给他吃；如果渴了，就给他喝。因为你这样作，就是把炭火堆在他的头上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，「你的仇敌若饿了，就给他吃，若渴了，就给他喝；因为你这样行就是把炭火堆在他的头上。」
verses.textEnNiv: On the contrary: "If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him something to drink. In doing this, you will heap burning coals on his head."
verses.textEnEsv: To the contrary, "if your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him something to drink; for by so doing you will heap burning coals on his head."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore "If your enemy is hungry, feed him; If he is thirsty, give him a drink; For in so doing you will heap coals of fire on his head."
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, "If your enemies are hungry, feed them. If they are thirsty, give them something to drink. In doing this, you will heap burning coals of shame on their heads."
verses.textEnNasb: "But if your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in so doing you will heap burning coals on his head."
verses.textEn: On the contrary: "If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him something to drink. In doing this, you will heap burning coals on his head."

verses.textZh: 不可被恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可被恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t let evil conquer you, but conquer evil by doing good.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verses.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

verses.textZh: 政府的权柄，人人都应当服从。因为没有一样权柄不是从神来的；掌权的都是神设立的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 政府的权柄，人人都应当服从。因为没有一样权柄不是从神来的；掌权的都是神设立的。
verses.textZhCuv: 在上有权柄的，人人当顺服他，因为没有权柄不是出于神的。凡掌权的都是神所命的。
verses.textEnNiv: Let everyone be subject to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which God has established. The authorities that exist have been established by God.
verses.textEnEsv: Let every person be subject to the governing authorities. For there is no authority except from God, and those that exist have been instituted by God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let every soul be subject to the governing authorities. For there is no authority except from God, and the authorities that exist are appointed by God.
verses.textEnNlt: Everyone must submit to governing authorities. For all authority comes from God, and those in positions of authority have been placed there by God.
verses.textEnNasb: Every person is to be subject to the governing authorities. For there is no authority except from God, and those which exist are established by God.
verses.textEn: Let everyone be subject to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which God has established. The authorities that exist have been established by God.

verses.textZh: 所以抗拒掌权的，就是反对神所设立的；反对的人必自招刑罚。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以抗拒掌权的，就是反对神所设立的；反对的人必自招刑罚。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，抗拒掌权的就是抗拒神的命；抗拒的必自取刑罚。
verses.textEnNiv: Consequently, whoever rebels against the authority is rebelling against what God has instituted, and those who do so will bring judgment on themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore whoever resists the authorities resists what God has appointed, and those who resist will incur judgment.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore whoever resists the authority resists the ordinance of God, and those who resist will bring judgment on themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: So anyone who rebels against authority is rebelling against what God has instituted, and they will be punished.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore whoever resists authority has opposed the ordinance of God; and they who have opposed will receive condemnation upon themselves.
verses.textEn: Consequently, whoever rebels against the authority is rebelling against what God has instituted, and those who do so will bring judgment on themselves.

verses.textZh: 执政的不是要使行善的惧怕，而是要使作恶的惧怕。你想不怕掌权的吗？只要行善，就会得到称赞；
verses.textZhCnvs: 执政的不是要使行善的惧怕，而是要使作恶的惧怕。你想不怕掌权的吗？只要行善，就会得到称赞；
verses.textZhCuv: 作官的原不是叫行善的惧怕，乃是叫作恶的惧怕。你愿意不惧怕掌权的吗？你只要行善，就可得他的称赞；
verses.textEnNiv: For rulers hold no terror for those who do right, but for those who do wrong. Do you want to be free from fear of the one in authority? Then do what is right and you will be commended.
verses.textEnEsv: For rulers are not a terror to good conduct, but to bad. Would you have no fear of the one who is in authority? Then do what is good, and you will receive his approval,
verses.textEnNkjv: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to evil. Do you want to be unafraid of the authority? Do what is good, and you will have praise from the same.
verses.textEnNlt: For the authorities do not strike fear in people who are doing right, but in those who are doing wrong. Would you like to live without fear of the authorities? Do what is right, and they will honor you.
verses.textEnNasb: For rulers are not a cause of fear for good behavior, but for evil. Do you want to have no fear of authority? Do what is good and you will have praise from the same;
verses.textEn: For rulers hold no terror for those who do right, but for those who do wrong. Do you want to be free from fear of the one in authority? Then do what is right and you will be commended.

verses.textZh: 因为他是神的仆役，是对你有益的。但如果你作恶，就应当惧怕；因为他佩剑，不是没有作用的。他是神的仆役，是向作恶的人施行刑罚的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为他是神的仆役，是对你有益的。但如果你作恶，就应当惧怕；因为他佩剑，不是没有作用的。他是神的仆役，是向作恶的人施行刑罚的。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为他是神的用人，是与你有益的。你若作恶，却当惧怕，因为他不是空空地佩剑；他是神的用人，是伸冤的，刑罚那作恶的。
verses.textEnNiv: For the one in authority is God’s servant for your good. But if you do wrong, be afraid, for rulers do not bear the sword for no reason. They are God’s servants, agents of wrath to bring punishment on the wrongdoer.
verses.textEnEsv: for he is God’s servant for your good. But if you do wrong, be afraid, for he does not bear the sword in vain. For he is the servant of God, an avenger who carries out God’s wrath on the wrongdoer.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he is God’s minister to you for good. But if you do evil, be afraid; for he does not bear the sword in vain; for he is God’s minister, an avenger to execute wrath on him who practices evil.
verses.textEnNlt: The authorities are God’s servants, sent for your good. But if you are doing wrong, of course you should be afraid, for they have the power to punish you. They are God’s servants, sent for the very purpose of punishing those who do what is wrong.
verses.textEnNasb: for it is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do what is evil, be afraid; for it does not bear the sword for nothing; for it is a servant of God, an avenger who brings wrath on the one who practices evil.
verses.textEn: For the one in authority is God’s servant for your good. But if you do wrong, be afraid, for rulers do not bear the sword for no reason. They are God’s servants, agents of wrath to bring punishment on the wrongdoer.

verses.textZh: 所以你们必须服从，不但是因为刑罚，也是因为良心的缘故。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以你们必须服从，不但是因为刑罚，也是因为良心的缘故。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们必须顺服，不但是因为刑罚，也是因为良心。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, it is necessary to submit to the authorities, not only because of possible punishment but also as a matter of conscience.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore one must be in subjection, not only to avoid God’s wrath but also for the sake of conscience.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore you must be subject, not only because of wrath but also for conscience’ sake.
verses.textEnNlt: So you must submit to them, not only to avoid punishment, but also to keep a clear conscience.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore it is necessary to be in subjection, not only because of wrath, but also for the sake of conscience.
verses.textEn: Therefore, it is necessary to submit to the authorities, not only because of possible punishment but also as a matter of conscience.

verses.textZh: 因此，你们也当纳税，因为他们是神的差役，专责处理这事的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你们也当纳税，因为他们是神的差役，专责处理这事的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们纳粮，也为这个缘故；因他们是神的差役，常常特管这事。
verses.textEnNiv: This is also why you pay taxes, for the authorities are God’s servants, who give their full time to governing.
verses.textEnEsv: For because of this you also pay taxes, for the authorities are ministers of God, attending to this very thing.
verses.textEnNkjv: For because of this you also pay taxes, for they are God’s ministers attending continually to this very thing.
verses.textEnNlt: Pay your taxes, too, for these same reasons. For government workers need to be paid. They are serving God in what they do.
verses.textEnNasb: For because of this you also pay taxes, for rulers are servants of God, devoting themselves to this very thing.
verses.textEn: This is also why you pay taxes, for the authorities are God’s servants, who give their full time to governing.

verses.textZh: 你们要向各人清还所欠的；应当纳税的，就要给他纳税；应当进贡的，就给他进贡；应当敬畏的，就敬畏他；应当尊敬的，就尊敬他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要向各人清还所欠的；应当纳税的，就要给他纳税；应当进贡的，就给他进贡；应当敬畏的，就敬畏他；应当尊敬的，就尊敬他。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡人所当得的，就给他。当得粮的，给他纳粮；当得税的，给他上税；当惧怕的，惧怕他；当恭敬的，恭敬他。
verses.textEnNiv: Give to everyone what you owe them: If you owe taxes, pay taxes; if revenue, then revenue; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.
verses.textEnEsv: Pay to all what is owed to them: taxes to whom taxes are owed, revenue to whom revenue is owed, respect to whom respect is owed, honor to whom honor is owed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Render therefore to all their due: taxes to whom taxes aredue, customs to whom customs, fear to whom fear, honor to whom honor.
verses.textEnNlt: Give to everyone what you owe them: Pay your taxes and government fees to those who collect them, and give respect and honor to those who are in authority.
verses.textEnNasb: Pay to all what is due them: tax to whom tax is due; custom to whom custom; respect to whom respect; honor to whom honor.
verses.textEn: Give to everyone what you owe them: If you owe taxes, pay taxes; if revenue, then revenue; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.

verses.textZh: 不要欠人的债；但在彼此相爱的事上，要觉得是欠了人的债。爱别人的，就成全了律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不要欠人的债；但在彼此相爱的事上，要觉得是欠了人的债。爱别人的，就成全了律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡事都不可亏欠人，惟有彼此相爱要常以为亏欠，因为爱人的就完全了律法。
verses.textEnNiv: Let no debt remain outstanding, except the continuing debt to love one another, for whoever loves others has fulfilled the law.
verses.textEnEsv: Owe no one anything, except to love each other, for the one who loves another has fulfilled the law.
verses.textEnNkjv: Owe no one anything except to love one another, for he who loves another has fulfilled the law.
verses.textEnNlt: Owe nothing to anyone—except for your obligation to love one another. If you love your neighbor, you will fulfill the requirements of God’s law.
verses.textEnNasb: Owe nothing to anyone except to love one another; for the one who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the Law.
verses.textEn: Let no debt remain outstanding, except the continuing debt to love one another, for whoever loves others has fulfilled the law.

verses.textZh: 那"不可奸淫，不可杀人，不可偷盗，不可贪心"等等的诫命，都包括在"爱人如己"这一句话里面了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那"不可奸淫，不可杀人，不可偷盗，不可贪心"等等的诫命，都包括在"爱人如己"这一句话里面了。
verses.textZhCuv: 像那不可奸淫，不可杀人，不可偷盗，不可贪婪，或有别的诫命，都包在爱人如己这一句话之内了。
verses.textEnNiv: The commandments, "You shall not commit adultery," "You shall not murder," "You shall not steal," "You shall not covet," and whatever other command there may be, are summed up in this one command: "Love your neighbor as yourself."
verses.textEnEsv: For the commandments, "You shall not commit adultery, You shall not murder, You shall not steal, You shall not covet," and any other commandment, are summed up in this word: "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."
verses.textEnNkjv: For the commandments, "You shall not commit adultery," "You shall not murder," "You shall not steal," "You shall not bear false witness," "You shall not covet," and if thereis any other commandment, are all summed up in this saying, namely, "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."
verses.textEnNlt: For the commandments say, "You must not commit adultery. You must not murder. You must not steal. You must not covet." These—and other such commandments—are summed up in this one commandment: "Love your neighbor as yourself."
verses.textEnNasb: For this, "You shall not commit adultery, You shall not murder, You shall not steal, You shall not covet," and if there is any other commandment, it is summed up in this saying, "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."
verses.textEn: The commandments, "You shall not commit adultery," "You shall not murder," "You shall not steal," "You shall not covet," and whatever other command there may be, are summed up in this one command: "Love your neighbor as yourself."

verses.textZh: 爱是不加害于人的，所以爱是成全律法的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 爱是不加害于人的，所以爱是成全律法的。
verses.textZhCuv: 爱是不加害与人的，所以爱就完全了律法。
verses.textEnNiv: Love does no harm to a neighbor. Therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.
verses.textEnEsv: Love does no wrong to a neighbor; therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
verses.textEnNkjv: Love does no harm to a neighbor; therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.
verses.textEnNlt: Love does no wrong to others, so love fulfills the requirements of God’s law.
verses.textEnNasb: Love does no wrong to a neighbor; therefore love is the fulfillment of the Law.
verses.textEn: Love does no harm to a neighbor. Therefore love is the fulfillment of the law.

verses.textZh: 还有，你们知道这是甚么时期了，现在正是你们应该睡醒的时候，因为我们得救，现在比初信的时候更加接近了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有，你们知道这是甚么时期了，现在正是你们应该睡醒的时候，因为我们得救，现在比初信的时候更加接近了。
verses.textZhCuv: 再者，你们晓得，现今就是该趁早睡醒的时候；因为我们得救，现今比初信的时候更近了。
verses.textEnNiv: And do this, understanding the present time: The hour has already come for you to wake up from your slumber, because our salvation is nearer now than when we first believed.
verses.textEnEsv: Besides this you know the time, that the hour has come for you to wake from sleep. For salvation is nearer to us now than when we first believed.
verses.textEnNkjv: And do this, knowing the time, that now itis high time to awake out of sleep; for now our salvation is nearer than when we first believed.
verses.textEnNlt: This is all the more urgent, for you know how late it is; time is running out. Wake up, for our salvation is nearer now than when we first believed.
verses.textEnNasb: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already the hour for you to awaken from sleep; for now salvation is nearer to us than when we first believed.
verses.textEn: And do this, understanding the present time: The hour has already come for you to wake up from your slumber, because our salvation is nearer now than when we first believed.

verses.textZh: 黑夜已深，白昼近了，所以我们要除掉暗昧的行为，带上光明的武器。
verses.textZhCnvs: 黑夜已深，白昼近了，所以我们要除掉暗昧的行为，带上光明的武器。
verses.textZhCuv: 黑夜已深，白昼将近。我们就当脱去暗昧的行为，带上光明的兵器。
verses.textEnNiv: The night is nearly over; the day is almost here. So let us put aside the deeds of darkness and put on the armor of light.
verses.textEnEsv: The night is far gone; the day is at hand. So then let us cast off the works of darkness and put on the armor of light.
verses.textEnNkjv: The night is far spent, the day is at hand. Therefore let us cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armor of light.
verses.textEnNlt: The night is almost gone; the day of salvation will soon be here. So remove your dark deeds like dirty clothes, and put on the shining armor of right living.
verses.textEnNasb: The night is almost gone, and the day is near. Therefore let’s rid ourselves of the deeds of darkness and put on the armor of light.
verses.textEn: The night is nearly over; the day is almost here. So let us put aside the deeds of darkness and put on the armor of light.

verses.textZh: 行事为人要光明磊落，好象行在白昼。不可荒宴醉酒，不可放荡纵欲，不可纷争嫉妒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 行事为人要光明磊落，好象行在白昼。不可荒宴醉酒，不可放荡纵欲，不可纷争嫉妒。
verses.textZhCuv: 行事为人要端正，好像行在白昼。不可荒宴醉酒；不可好色邪荡；不可争竞嫉妒。
verses.textEnNiv: Let us behave decently, as in the daytime, not in carousing and drunkenness, not in sexual immorality and debauchery, not in dissension and jealousy.
verses.textEnEsv: Let us walk properly as in the daytime, not in orgies and drunkenness, not in sexual immorality and sensuality, not in quarreling and jealousy.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let us walk properly, as in the day, not in revelry and drunkenness, not in lewdness and lust, not in strife and envy.
verses.textEnNlt: Because we belong to the day, we must live decent lives for all to see. Don’t participate in the darkness of wild parties and drunkenness, or in sexual promiscuity and immoral living, or in quarreling and jealousy.
verses.textEnNasb: Let’s behave properly as in the day, not in carousing and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and debauchery, not in strife and jealousy.
verses.textEn: Let us behave decently, as in the daytime, not in carousing and drunkenness, not in sexual immorality and debauchery, not in dissension and jealousy.

verses.textZh: 总要披戴主耶稣基督，不要为肉体安排，去放纵私欲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 总要披戴主耶稣基督，不要为肉体安排，去放纵私欲。
verses.textZhCuv: 总要披戴主耶稣基督，不要为肉体安排，去放纵私欲。
verses.textEnNiv: Rather, clothe yourselves with the Lord Jesus Christ, and do not think about how to gratify the desires of the flesh.
verses.textEnEsv: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, to gratify its desires.
verses.textEnNkjv: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, to fulfillits lusts.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, clothe yourself with the presence of the Lord Jesus Christ. And don’t let yourself think about ways to indulge your evil desires.
verses.textEnNasb: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh in regard to its lusts.
verses.textEn: Rather, clothe yourselves with the Lord Jesus Christ, and do not think about how to gratify the desires of the flesh.

verses.textZh: 你们要接纳信心软弱的人，不要论断引起争论的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要接纳信心软弱的人，不要论断引起争论的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 信心软弱的，你们要接纳，但不要辩论所疑惑的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Accept the one whose faith is weak, without quarreling over disputable matters.
verses.textEnEsv: As for the one who is weak in faith, welcome him, but not to quarrel over opinions.
verses.textEnNkjv: Receive one who is weak in the faith, but not to disputes over doubtful things.
verses.textEnNlt: Accept other believers who are weak in faith, and don’t argue with them about what they think is right or wrong.
verses.textEnNasb: Now accept the one who is weak in faith, but not to have quarrels over opinions.
verses.textEn: Accept the one whose faith is weak, without quarreling over disputable matters.

verses.textZh: 有人相信所有的食物都可以吃，信心软弱的人却只吃蔬菜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人相信所有的食物都可以吃，信心软弱的人却只吃蔬菜。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人信百物都可吃；但那软弱的，只吃蔬菜。
verses.textEnNiv: One person’s faith allows them to eat anything, but another, whose faith is weak, eats only vegetables.
verses.textEnEsv: One person believes he may eat anything, while the weak person eats only vegetables.
verses.textEnNkjv: For one believes he may eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.
verses.textEnNlt: For instance, one person believes it’s all right to eat anything. But another believer with a sensitive conscience will eat only vegetables.
verses.textEnNasb: One person has faith that he may eat all things, but the one who is weak eats only vegetables.
verses.textEn: One person’s faith allows them to eat anything, but another, whose faith is weak, eats only vegetables.

verses.textZh: 吃的人不要轻看不吃的人，不吃的人也不要批评吃的人，因为神已经接纳他了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 吃的人不要轻看不吃的人，不吃的人也不要批评吃的人，因为神已经接纳他了。
verses.textZhCuv: 吃的人不可轻看不吃的人；不吃的人不可论断吃的人；因为神已经收纳他了。
verses.textEnNiv: The one who eats everything must not treat with contempt the one who does not, and the one who does not eat everything must not judge the one who does, for God has accepted them.
verses.textEnEsv: Let not the one who eats despise the one who abstains, and let not the one who abstains pass judgment on the one who eats, for God has welcomed him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let not him who eats despise him who does not eat, and let not him who does not eat judge him who eats; for God has received him.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who feel free to eat anything must not look down on those who don’t. And those who don’t eat certain foods must not condemn those who do, for God has accepted them.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who eats is not to regard with contempt the one who does not eat, and the one who does not eat is not to judge the one who eats, for God has accepted him.
verses.textEn: The one who eats everything must not treat with contempt the one who does not, and the one who does not eat everything must not judge the one who does, for God has accepted them.

verses.textZh: 你是谁，竟然批评别人的家仆呢？他或站稳或跌倒，只和自己的主人有关；但他必定站稳，因为主能够使他站稳。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你是谁，竟然批评别人的家仆呢？他或站稳或跌倒，只和自己的主人有关；但他必定站稳，因为主能够使他站稳。
verses.textZhCuv: 你是谁，竟论断别人的仆人呢？他或站住或跌倒，自有他的主人在；而且他也必要站住，因为主能使他站住。
verses.textEnNiv: Who are you to judge someone else’s servant? To their own master, servants stand or fall. And they will stand, for the Lord is able to make them stand.
verses.textEnEsv: Who are you to pass judgment on the servant of another? It is before his own master that he stands or falls. And he will be upheld, for the Lord is able to make him stand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who are you to judge another’s servant? To his own master he stands or falls. Indeed, he will be made to stand, for God is able to make him stand.
verses.textEnNlt: Who are you to condemn someone else’s servants? Their own master will judge whether they stand or fall. And with the Lord’s help, they will stand and receive his approval.
verses.textEnNasb: Who are you to judge the servant of another? To his own master he stands or falls; and he will stand, for the Lord is able to make him stand.
verses.textEn: Who are you to judge someone else’s servant? To their own master, servants stand or fall. And they will stand, for the Lord is able to make them stand.

verses.textZh: 有人认为这日比那日好，也有人认为日日都是一样；只要各人自己心意坚定就可以了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有人认为这日比那日好，也有人认为日日都是一样；只要各人自己心意坚定就可以了。
verses.textZhCuv: 有人看这日比那日强；有人看日日都是一样。只是各人心里要意见坚定。
verses.textEnNiv: One person considers one day more sacred than another; another considers every day alike. Each of them should be fully convinced in their own mind.
verses.textEnEsv: One person esteems one day as better than another, while another esteems all days alike. Each one should be fully convinced in his own mind.
verses.textEnNkjv: One person esteems one day above another; another esteems every day alike. Let each be fully convinced in his own mind.
verses.textEnNlt: In the same way, some think one day is more holy than another day, while others think every day is alike. You should each be fully convinced that whichever day you choose is acceptable.
verses.textEnNasb: One person values one day over another, another values every day the same. Each person must be fully convinced in his own mind.
verses.textEn: One person considers one day more sacred than another; another considers every day alike. Each of them should be fully convinced in their own mind.

verses.textZh: 守日的人是为主守的，吃的人是为主吃的，因为他感谢神；不吃的人是为主不吃，他也感谢神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 守日的人是为主守的，吃的人是为主吃的，因为他感谢神；不吃的人是为主不吃，他也感谢神。
verses.textZhCuv: 守日的人是为主守的。吃的人是为主吃的，因他感谢神；不吃的人是为主不吃的，也感谢神。
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever regards one day as special does so to the Lord. Whoever eats meat does so to the Lord, for they give thanks to God; and whoever abstains does so to the Lord and gives thanks to God.
verses.textEnEsv: The one who observes the day, observes it in honor of the Lord. The one who eats, eats in honor of the Lord, since he gives thanks to God, while the one who abstains, abstains in honor of the Lord and gives thanks to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks; and he who does not eat, to the Lord he does not eat, and gives God thanks.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who worship the Lord on a special day do it to honor him. Those who eat any kind of food do so to honor the Lord, since they give thanks to God before eating. And those who refuse to eat certain foods also want to please the Lord and give thanks to God.
verses.textEnNasb: The one who observes the day, observes it for the Lord, and the one who eats, does so with regard to the Lord, for he gives thanks to God; and the one who does not eat, it is for the Lord that he does not eat, and he gives thanks to God.
verses.textEn: Whoever regards one day as special does so to the Lord. Whoever eats meat does so to the Lord, for they give thanks to God; and whoever abstains does so to the Lord and gives thanks to God.

verses.textZh: 我们没有一个人为自己活，也没有一个人为自己死。我们若活着，是为主而活；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们没有一个人为自己活，也没有一个人为自己死。我们若活着，是为主而活；
verses.textZhCuv: 我们没有一个人为自己活，也没有一个人为自己死。
verses.textEnNiv: For none of us lives for ourselves alone, and none of us dies for ourselves alone.
verses.textEnEsv: For none of us lives to himself, and none of us dies to himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: For none of us lives to himself, and no one dies to himself.
verses.textEnNlt: For we don’t live for ourselves or die for ourselves.
verses.textEnNasb: For not one of us lives for himself, and not one dies for himself;
verses.textEn: For none of us lives for ourselves alone, and none of us dies for ourselves alone.

verses.textZh: 我们若死了，是为主而死。所以，我们无论活着或是死了，总是属于主的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们若死了，是为主而死。所以，我们无论活着或是死了，总是属于主的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们若活着，是为主而活；若死了，是为主而死。所以，我们或活或死总是主的人。
verses.textEnNiv: If we live, we live for the Lord; and if we die, we die for the Lord. So, whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: For if we live, we live to the Lord, and if we die, we die to the Lord. So then, whether we live or whether we die, we are the Lord’s.
verses.textEnNkjv: For if we live, we live to the Lord; and if we die, we die to the Lord. Therefore, whether we live or die, we are the Lord’s.
verses.textEnNlt: If we live, it’s to honor the Lord. And if we die, it’s to honor the Lord. So whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: for if we live, we live for the Lord, or if we die, we die for the Lord; therefore whether we live or die, we are the Lord’s.
verses.textEn: If we live, we live for the Lord; and if we die, we die for the Lord. So, whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord.

verses.textZh: 为了这缘故，基督死了，又活过来，就是要作死人和活人的主。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为了这缘故，基督死了，又活过来，就是要作死人和活人的主。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，基督死了，又活了，为要作死人并活人的主。
verses.textEnNiv: For this very reason, Christ died and returned to life so that he might be the Lord of both the dead and the living.
verses.textEnEsv: For to this end Christ died and lived again, that he might be Lord both of the dead and of the living.
verses.textEnNkjv: For to this end Christ died and rose and lived again, that He might be Lord of both the dead and the living.
verses.textEnNlt: Christ died and rose again for this very purpose—to be Lord both of the living and of the dead.
verses.textEnNasb: For to this end Christ died and lived again, that He might be Lord both of the dead and of the living.
verses.textEn: For this very reason, Christ died and returned to life so that he might be the Lord of both the dead and the living.

verses.textZh: 这样，你为甚么批评你的弟兄呢？为甚么又轻看你的弟兄呢？我们都要站在神的审判台前；
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样，你为甚么批评你的弟兄呢？为甚么又轻看你的弟兄呢？我们都要站在神的审判台前；
verses.textZhCuv: 你这个人，为什么论断弟兄呢？又为什么轻看弟兄呢？因我们都要站在神的台前。
verses.textEnNiv: You, then, why do you judge your brother or sister ? Or why do you treat them with contempt? For we will all stand before God’s judgment seat.
verses.textEnEsv: Why do you pass judgment on your brother? Or you, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of God;
verses.textEnNkjv: But why do you judge your brother? Or why do you show contempt for your brother? For we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: So why do you condemn another believer ? Why do you look down on another believer? Remember, we will all stand before the judgment seat of God.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for you, why do you judge your brother or sister? Or you as well, why do you regard your brother or sister with contempt? For we will all appear before the judgment seat of God.
verses.textEn: You, then, why do you judge your brother or sister ? Or why do you treat them with contempt? For we will all stand before God’s judgment seat.

verses.textZh: 因为经上记着： "主说，我指着我的永生起誓： 万膝必向我跪拜， 万口必称颂神。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为经上记着： "主说，我指着我的永生起誓： 万膝必向我跪拜， 万口必称颂神。"
verses.textZhCuv: 经上写着： 主说：我凭着我的永生起誓： 万膝必向我跪拜； 万口必向我承认。
verses.textEnNiv: It is written: " ‘As surely as I live,’ says the Lord, ‘every knee will bow before me; every tongue will acknowledge God.’ "
verses.textEnEsv: for it is written, "As I live, says the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God."
verses.textEnNkjv: For it is written: "As I live, says the Lord, Every knee shall bow to Me, And every tongue shall confess to God."
verses.textEnNlt: For the Scriptures say, "‘As surely as I live,’ says the Lord , ‘every knee will bend to me, and every tongue will declare allegiance to God. ’"
verses.textEnNasb: For it is written: "As I live, says the Lord, to Me every knee will bow, And every tongue will give praise to God."
verses.textEn: It is written: " ‘As surely as I live,’ says the Lord, ‘every knee will bow before me; every tongue will acknowledge God.’ "

verses.textZh: 这样看来，我们各人都要把自己的事向神交代。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样看来，我们各人都要把自己的事向神交代。
verses.textZhCuv: 这样看来，我们各人必要将自己的事在神面前说明。
verses.textEnNiv: So then, each of us will give an account of ourselves to God.
verses.textEnEsv: So then each of us will give an account of himself to God.
verses.textEnNkjv: So then each of us shall give account of himself to God.
verses.textEnNlt: Yes, each of us will give a personal account to God.
verses.textEnNasb: So then each one of us will give an account of himself to God.
verses.textEn: So then, each of us will give an account of ourselves to God.

verses.textZh: 所以，我们不要再彼此批评了；倒要立定主意，决不作绊倒弟兄或使他跌倒的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我们不要再彼此批评了；倒要立定主意，决不作绊倒弟兄或使他跌倒的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我们不可再彼此论断，宁可定意谁也不给弟兄放下绊脚跌人之物。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore let us stop passing judgment on one another. Instead, make up your mind not to put any stumbling block or obstacle in the way of a brother or sister.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore let us not pass judgment on one another any longer, but rather decide never to put a stumbling block or hindrance in the way of a brother.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore let us not judge one another anymore, but rather resolve this, not to put a stumbling block or a cause to fall in our brother’s way.
verses.textEnNlt: So let’s stop condemning each other. Decide instead to live in such a way that you will not cause another believer to stumble and fall.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore let’s not judge one another anymore, but rather determine this: not to put an obstacle or a stumbling block in a brother’s or sister’s way.
verses.textEn: Therefore let us stop passing judgment on one another. Instead, make up your mind not to put any stumbling block or obstacle in the way of a brother or sister.

verses.textZh: 我知道，并且在主耶稣里深信，没有一样东西的本身是不洁的，但如果有人认为是不洁的，对他来说那东西就成为不洁了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我知道，并且在主耶稣里深信，没有一样东西的本身是不洁的，但如果有人认为是不洁的，对他来说那东西就成为不洁了。
verses.textZhCuv: 我凭着主耶稣确知深信，凡物本来没有不洁净的；惟独人以为不洁净的，在他就不洁净了。
verses.textEnNiv: I am convinced, being fully persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean in itself. But if anyone regards something as unclean, then for that person it is unclean.
verses.textEnEsv: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean in itself, but it is unclean for anyone who thinks it unclean.
verses.textEnNkjv: I know and am convinced by the Lord Jesus that thereis nothing unclean of itself; but to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him itis unclean.
verses.textEnNlt: I know and am convinced on the authority of the Lord Jesus that no food, in and of itself, is wrong to eat. But if someone believes it is wrong, then for that person it is wrong.
verses.textEnNasb: I know and am convinced in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean in itself; but to the one who thinks something is unclean, to that person it is unclean.
verses.textEn: I am convinced, being fully persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean in itself. But if anyone regards something as unclean, then for that person it is unclean.

verses.textZh: 如果你为了食物使你的弟兄忧愁，你就不再是凭着爱心行事了。你不可因着你的食物，使基督已经替他死了的人灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你为了食物使你的弟兄忧愁，你就不再是凭着爱心行事了。你不可因着你的食物，使基督已经替他死了的人灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 你若因食物叫弟兄忧愁，就不是按着爱人的道理行。基督已经替他死，你不可因你的食物叫他败坏。
verses.textEnNiv: If your brother or sister is distressed because of what you eat, you are no longer acting in love. Do not by your eating destroy someone for whom Christ died.
verses.textEnEsv: For if your brother is grieved by what you eat, you are no longer walking in love. By what you eat, do not destroy the one for whom Christ died.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet if your brother is grieved because of your food, you are no longer walking in love. Do not destroy with your food the one for whom Christ died.
verses.textEnNlt: And if another believer is distressed by what you eat, you are not acting in love if you eat it. Don’t let your eating ruin someone for whom Christ died.
verses.textEnNasb: For if because of food your brother or sister is hurt, you are no longer walking in accordance with love. Do not destroy with your choice of food that person for whom Christ died.
verses.textEn: If your brother or sister is distressed because of what you eat, you are no longer acting in love. Do not by your eating destroy someone for whom Christ died.

verses.textZh: 所以，不可使你们看为好的被人毁谤；
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，不可使你们看为好的被人毁谤；
verses.textZhCuv: 不可叫你的善被人毁谤；
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore do not let what you know is good be spoken of as evil.
verses.textEnEsv: So do not let what you regard as good be spoken of as evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore do not let your good be spoken of as evil;
verses.textEnNlt: Then you will not be criticized for doing something you believe is good.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore do not let what is for you a good thing be spoken of as evil;
verses.textEn: Therefore do not let what you know is good be spoken of as evil.

verses.textZh: 因为神的国不在于吃喝，而在于公义、和睦，以及圣灵里的喜乐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为神的国不在于吃喝，而在于公义、和睦，以及圣灵里的喜乐。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为神的国不在乎吃喝，只在乎公义、和平，并圣灵中的喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of eating and drinking, but of righteousness, peace and joy in the Holy Spirit,
verses.textEnEsv: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of eating and drinking but of righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: for the kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: For the Kingdom of God is not a matter of what we eat or drink, but of living a life of goodness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: for the kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEn: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of eating and drinking, but of righteousness, peace and joy in the Holy Spirit,

verses.textZh: 这样服事基督的人，必蒙神喜悦，又得众人嘉许。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这样服事基督的人，必蒙神喜悦，又得众人嘉许。
verses.textZhCuv: 在这几样上服事基督的，就为神所喜悦，又为人所称许。
verses.textEnNiv: because anyone who serves Christ in this way is pleasing to God and receives human approval.
verses.textEnEsv: Whoever thus serves Christ is acceptable to God and approved by men.
verses.textEnNkjv: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.
verses.textEnNlt: If you serve Christ with this attitude, you will please God, and others will approve of you, too.
verses.textEnNasb: For the one who serves Christ in this way is acceptable to God and approved by other people.
verses.textEn: because anyone who serves Christ in this way is pleasing to God and receives human approval.

verses.textZh: 所以，我们总要追求和睦的事，与彼此造就的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，我们总要追求和睦的事，与彼此造就的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，我们务要追求和睦的事与彼此建立德行的事。
verses.textEnNiv: Let us therefore make every effort to do what leads to peace and to mutual edification.
verses.textEnEsv: So then let us pursue what makes for peace and for mutual upbuilding.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore let us pursue the things whichmake for peace and the things by which one may edify another.
verses.textEnNlt: So then, let us aim for harmony in the church and try to build each other up.
verses.textEnNasb: So then we pursue the things which make for peace and the building up of one another.
verses.textEn: Let us therefore make every effort to do what leads to peace and to mutual edification.

verses.textZh: 不可因食物的缘故拆毁神的工作。一切都是洁净的，但人若因食物绊倒弟兄，对他来说，这就是恶事了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不可因食物的缘故拆毁神的工作。一切都是洁净的，但人若因食物绊倒弟兄，对他来说，这就是恶事了。
verses.textZhCuv: 不可因食物毁坏神的工程。凡物固然洁净，但有人因食物叫人跌倒，就是他的罪了。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not destroy the work of God for the sake of food. All food is clean, but it is wrong for a person to eat anything that causes someone else to stumble.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not, for the sake of food, destroy the work of God. Everything is indeed clean, but it is wrong for anyone to make another stumble by what he eats.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not destroy the work of God for the sake of food. All things indeed are pure, but itis evil for the man who eats with offense.
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t tear apart the work of God over what you eat. Remember, all foods are acceptable, but it is wrong to eat something if it makes another person stumble.
verses.textEnNasb: Do not tear down the work of God for the sake of food. All things indeed are clean, but they are evil for the person who eats and causes offense.
verses.textEn: Do not destroy the work of God for the sake of food. All food is clean, but it is wrong for a person to eat anything that causes someone else to stumble.

verses.textZh: 无论是吃肉，是喝酒，或是甚么使你的弟兄跌倒的事，一律不要作才好。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无论是吃肉，是喝酒，或是甚么使你的弟兄跌倒的事，一律不要作才好。
verses.textZhCuv: 无论是吃肉是喝酒，是什么别的事，叫弟兄跌倒，一概不做才好。
verses.textEnNiv: It is better not to eat meat or drink wine or to do anything else that will cause your brother or sister to fall.
verses.textEnEsv: It is good not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything that causes your brother to stumble.
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis good neither to eat meat nor drink wine nor doanything by which your brother stumbles or is offended or is made weak.
verses.textEnNlt: It is better not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else if it might cause another believer to stumble.
verses.textEnNasb: It is good not to eat meat or to drink wine, or to do anything by which your brother or sister stumbles.
verses.textEn: It is better not to eat meat or drink wine or to do anything else that will cause your brother or sister to fall.

verses.textZh: 你所信的，你自己要在神面前持守。人在经自己考验后认可的事上能够不自责，他就有福了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你所信的，你自己要在神面前持守。人在经自己考验后认可的事上能够不自责，他就有福了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你有信心，就当在神面前守着。人在自己以为可行的事上能不自责，就有福了。
verses.textEnNiv: So whatever you believe about these things keep between yourself and God. Blessed is the one who does not condemn himself by what he approves.
verses.textEnEsv: The faith that you have, keep between yourself and God. Blessed is the one who has no reason to pass judgment on himself for what he approves.
verses.textEnNkjv: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who does not condemn himself in what he approves.
verses.textEnNlt: You may believe there’s nothing wrong with what you are doing, but keep it between yourself and God. Blessed are those who don’t feel guilty for doing something they have decided is right.
verses.textEnNasb: The faith which you have, have as your own conviction before God. Happy is the one who does not condemn himself in what he approves.
verses.textEn: So whatever you believe about these things keep between yourself and God. Blessed is the one who does not condemn himself by what he approves.

verses.textZh: 但如果有人存着疑惑的心去吃，他就被定罪了，因为他不是出于信心。凡不是出于信心的，都是罪。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但如果有人存着疑惑的心去吃，他就被定罪了，因为他不是出于信心。凡不是出于信心的，都是罪。
verses.textZhCuv: 若有疑心而吃的，就必有罪，因为他吃不是出于信心。凡不出于信心的都是罪。
verses.textEnNiv: But whoever has doubts is condemned if they eat, because their eating is not from faith; and everything that does not come from faith is sin.
verses.textEnEsv: But whoever has doubts is condemned if he eats, because the eating is not from faith. For whatever does not proceed from faith is sin.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because hedoes not eat from faith; for whatever is not from faith is sin.
verses.textEnNlt: But if you have doubts about whether or not you should eat something, you are sinning if you go ahead and do it. For you are not following your convictions. If you do anything you believe is not right, you are sinning.
verses.textEnNasb: But the one who doubts is condemned if he eats, because his eating is not from faith; and whatever is not from faith is sin.
verses.textEn: But whoever has doubts is condemned if they eat, because their eating is not from faith; and everything that does not come from faith is sin.

verses.textZh: 我们坚强的人，应该担当不坚强的人的软弱，不应该求自己的喜悦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们坚强的人，应该担当不坚强的人的软弱，不应该求自己的喜悦。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们坚固的人应该担代不坚固人的软弱，不求自己的喜悦。
verses.textEnNiv: We who are strong ought to bear with the failings of the weak and not to please ourselves.
verses.textEnEsv: We who are strong have an obligation to bear with the failings of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: We then who are strong ought to bear with the scruples of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
verses.textEnNlt: We who are strong must be considerate of those who are sensitive about things like this. We must not just please ourselves.
verses.textEnNasb: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of those without strength, and not just please ourselves.
verses.textEn: We who are strong ought to bear with the failings of the weak and not to please ourselves.

verses.textZh: 我们各人务要叫邻舍喜悦，好让他得到益处、得到造就。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们各人务要叫邻舍喜悦，好让他得到益处、得到造就。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们各人务要叫邻舍喜悦，使他得益处，建立德行。
verses.textEnNiv: Each of us should please our neighbors for their good, to build them up.
verses.textEnEsv: Let each of us please his neighbor for his good, to build him up.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let each of us please his neighbor for his good, leading to edification.
verses.textEnNlt: We should help others do what is right and build them up in the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: Each of us is to please his neighbor for his good, to his edification.
verses.textEn: Each of us should please our neighbors for their good, to build them up.

verses.textZh: 因为连基督也不求自己的喜悦；反而像经上所记的："辱骂你的人的辱骂，都落在我的身上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为连基督也不求自己的喜悦；反而像经上所记的："辱骂你的人的辱骂，都落在我的身上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 因为基督也不求自己的喜悦，如经上所记：「辱骂你人的辱骂都落在我身上。」
verses.textEnNiv: For even Christ did not please himself but, as it is written: "The insults of those who insult you have fallen on me."
verses.textEnEsv: For Christ did not please himself, but as it is written, "The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me."
verses.textEnNkjv: For even Christ did not please Himself; but as it is written, "The reproaches of those who reproached You fell on Me."
verses.textEnNlt: For even Christ didn’t live to please himself. As the Scriptures say, "The insults of those who insult you, O God, have fallen on me."
verses.textEnNasb: For even Christ did not please Himself, but as it is written: "The taunts of those who taunt You have fallen on Me."
verses.textEn: For even Christ did not please himself but, as it is written: "The insults of those who insult you have fallen on me."

verses.textZh: 从前经上所写的，都是为教训我们而写的，好使我们借着忍耐和圣经中的安慰得着盼望。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从前经上所写的，都是为教训我们而写的，好使我们借着忍耐和圣经中的安慰得着盼望。
verses.textZhCuv: 从前所写的圣经都是为教训我们写的，叫我们因圣经所生的忍耐和安慰可以得着盼望。
verses.textEnNiv: For everything that was written in the past was written to teach us, so that through the endurance taught in the Scriptures and the encouragement they provide we might have hope.
verses.textEnEsv: For whatever was written in former days was written for our instruction, that through endurance and through the encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.
verses.textEnNkjv: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that we through the patience and comfort of the Scriptures might have hope.
verses.textEnNlt: Such things were written in the Scriptures long ago to teach us. And the Scriptures give us hope and encouragement as we wait patiently for God’s promises to be fulfilled.
verses.textEnNasb: For whatever was written in earlier times was written for our instruction, so that through perseverance and the encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.
verses.textEn: For everything that was written in the past was written to teach us, so that through the endurance taught in the Scriptures and the encouragement they provide we might have hope.

verses.textZh: 愿赐忍耐和安慰的神，使你们彼此同心，效法基督耶稣，
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿赐忍耐和安慰的神，使你们彼此同心，效法基督耶稣，
verses.textZhCuv: 但愿赐忍耐安慰的神叫你们彼此同心，效法基督耶稣，
verses.textEnNiv: May the God who gives endurance and encouragement give you the same attitude of mind toward each other that Christ Jesus had,
verses.textEnEsv: May the God of endurance and encouragement grant you to live in such harmony with one another, in accord with Christ Jesus,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now may the God of patience and comfort grant you to be like-minded toward one another, according to Christ Jesus,
verses.textEnNlt: May God, who gives this patience and encouragement, help you live in complete harmony with each other, as is fitting for followers of Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: Now may the God who gives perseverance and encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another, according to Christ Jesus,
verses.textEn: May the God who gives endurance and encouragement give you the same attitude of mind toward each other that Christ Jesus had,

verses.textZh: 同心一致地荣耀我们主耶稣基督的父神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 同心一致地荣耀我们主耶稣基督的父神。
verses.textZhCuv: 一心一口荣耀神－我们主耶稣基督的父！
verses.textEnNiv: so that with one mind and one voice you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: that together you may with one voice glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: that you may with one mind and one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: Then all of you can join together with one voice, giving praise and glory to God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: so that with one purpose and one voice you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.textEn: so that with one mind and one voice you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.textZh: 因此，你们应当彼此接纳，就像基督接纳了你们一样，使荣耀归于神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，你们应当彼此接纳，就像基督接纳了你们一样，使荣耀归于神。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以，你们要彼此接纳，如同基督接纳你们一样，使荣耀归与神。
verses.textEnNiv: Accept one another, then, just as Christ accepted you, in order to bring praise to God.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore welcome one another as Christ has welcomed you, for the glory of God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore receive one another, just as Christ also received us, to the glory of God.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, accept each other just as Christ has accepted you so that God will be given glory.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, accept one another, just as Christ also accepted us, for the glory of God.
verses.textEn: Accept one another, then, just as Christ accepted you, in order to bring praise to God.

verses.textZh: 我说，基督为了神的真理，成了受割礼的人的仆人，为的是要证实对祖先的应许，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说，基督为了神的真理，成了受割礼的人的仆人，为的是要证实对祖先的应许，
verses.textZhCuv: 我说，基督是为神真理作了受割礼人的执事，要证实所应许列祖的话，
verses.textEnNiv: For I tell you that Christ has become a servant of the Jews on behalf of God’s truth, so that the promises made to the patriarchs might be confirmed
verses.textEnEsv: For I tell you that Christ became a servant to the circumcised to show God’s truthfulness, in order to confirm the promises given to the patriarchs,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I say that Jesus Christ has become a servant to the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made to the fathers,
verses.textEnNlt: Remember that Christ came as a servant to the Jews to show that God is true to the promises he made to their ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: For I say that Christ has become a servant to the circumcision in behalf of the truth of God, to confirm the promises given to the fathers,
verses.textEn: For I tell you that Christ has become a servant of the Jews on behalf of God’s truth, so that the promises made to the patriarchs might be confirmed

verses.textZh: 使外族人因着所蒙的怜悯荣耀神；如经上所记： "因此我要在列邦中称赞你， 歌颂你的名。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 使外族人因着所蒙的怜悯荣耀神；如经上所记： "因此我要在列邦中称赞你， 歌颂你的名。"
verses.textZhCuv: 并叫外邦人因他的怜悯荣耀神。如经上所记： 因此，我要在外邦中称赞你， 歌颂你的名；
verses.textEnNiv: and, moreover, that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written: "Therefore I will praise you among the Gentiles; I will sing the praises of your name."
verses.textEnEsv: and in order that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, "Therefore I will praise you among the Gentiles, and sing to your name."
verses.textEnNkjv: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for His mercy, as it is written: "For this reason I will confess to You among the Gentiles, And sing to Your name."
verses.textEnNlt: He also came so that the Gentiles might give glory to God for his mercies to them. That is what the psalmist meant when he wrote: "For this, I will praise you among the Gentiles; I will sing praises to your name."
verses.textEnNasb: and for the Gentiles to glorify God for His mercy; as it is written: "Therefore I will give praise to You among the Gentiles, And I will sing praises to Your name."
verses.textEn: and, moreover, that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written: "Therefore I will praise you among the Gentiles; I will sing the praises of your name."

verses.textZh: 又说： "列邦啊，当与他的子民一同快乐。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又说： "列邦啊，当与他的子民一同快乐。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又说： 你们外邦人当与主的百姓一同欢乐；
verses.textEnNiv: Again, it says, "Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people."
verses.textEnEsv: And again it says, "Rejoice, O Gentiles, with his people."
verses.textEnNkjv: And again he says: "Rejoice, O Gentiles, with His people!"
verses.textEnNlt: And in another place it is written, "Rejoice with his people, you Gentiles."
verses.textEnNasb: Again he says, "Rejoice, you Gentiles, with His people."
verses.textEn: Again, it says, "Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people."

verses.textZh: 又说： "万国啊， 你们当赞美主； 愿万民都颂赞他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 又说： "万国啊， 你们当赞美主； 愿万民都颂赞他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又说： 外邦啊，你们当赞美主！ 万民哪，你们都当颂赞他！
verses.textEnNiv: And again, "Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles; let all the peoples extol him."
verses.textEnEsv: And again, "Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles, and let all the peoples extol him."
verses.textEnNkjv: And again: "Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Laud Him, all you peoples!"
verses.textEnNlt: And yet again, "Praise the Lord , all you Gentiles. Praise him, all you people of the earth."
verses.textEnNasb: And again, "Praise the Lord all you Gentiles, And let all the peoples praise Him."
verses.textEn: And again, "Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles; let all the peoples extol him."

verses.textZh: 以赛亚也说： "将来必有耶西的根， 就是那兴起来治理列邦的； 列邦都寄望于他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 以赛亚也说： "将来必有耶西的根， 就是那兴起来治理列邦的； 列邦都寄望于他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 又有以赛亚说： 将来有耶西的根， 就是那兴起来要治理外邦的； 外邦人要仰望他。
verses.textEnNiv: And again, Isaiah says, "The Root of Jesse will spring up, one who will arise to rule over the nations; in him the Gentiles will hope."
verses.textEnEsv: And again Isaiah says, "The root of Jesse will come, even he who arises to rule the Gentiles; in him will the Gentiles hope."
verses.textEnNkjv: And again, Isaiah says: "There shall be a root of Jesse; And He who shall rise to reign over the Gentiles, In Him the Gentiles shall hope."
verses.textEnNlt: And in another place Isaiah said, "The heir to David’s throne will come, and he will rule over the Gentiles. They will place their hope on him."
verses.textEnNasb: Again Isaiah says, "There shall come the root of Jesse, And He who arises to rule over the Gentiles, In Him will the Gentiles hope."
verses.textEn: And again, Isaiah says, "The Root of Jesse will spring up, one who will arise to rule over the nations; in him the Gentiles will hope."

verses.textZh: 愿那赐盼望的神，因着你们的信，把一切喜乐平安充满你们，使你们靠着圣灵的大能满有盼望。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿那赐盼望的神，因着你们的信，把一切喜乐平安充满你们，使你们靠着圣灵的大能满有盼望。
verses.textZhCuv: 但愿使人有盼望的神，因信将诸般的喜乐、平安充满你们的心，使你们藉着圣灵的能力大有盼望！
verses.textEnNiv: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, so that by the power of the Holy Spirit you may abound in hope.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: I pray that God, the source of hope, will fill you completely with joy and peace because you trust in him. Then you will overflow with confident hope through the power of the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, so that you will abound in hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEn: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.

verses.textZh: 我的弟兄们，我个人深信你们自己也满有良善，充满丰富的知识，也能够彼此劝导。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的弟兄们，我个人深信你们自己也满有良善，充满丰富的知识，也能够彼此劝导。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我自己也深信你们是满有良善，充足了诸般的知识，也能彼此劝戒。
verses.textEnNiv: I myself am convinced, my brothers and sisters, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with knowledge and competent to instruct one another.
verses.textEnEsv: I myself am satisfied about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge and able to instruct one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I myself am confident concerning you, my brethren, that you also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
verses.textEnNlt: I am fully convinced, my dear brothers and sisters, that you are full of goodness. You know these things so well you can teach each other all about them.
verses.textEnNasb: And concerning you, my brothers and sisters, I myself also am convinced that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge and able also to admonish one another.
verses.textEn: I myself am convinced, my brothers and sisters, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with knowledge and competent to instruct one another.

verses.textZh: 但有些地方，我写得稍为大胆一点，是要提醒你们；我因着神赐给我的恩典，
verses.textZhCnvs: 但有些地方，我写得稍为大胆一点，是要提醒你们；我因着神赐给我的恩典，
verses.textZhCuv: 但我稍微放胆写信给你们，是要提醒你们的记性，特因神所给我的恩典，
verses.textEnNiv: Yet I have written you quite boldly on some points to remind you of them again, because of the grace God gave me
verses.textEnEsv: But on some points I have written to you very boldly by way of reminder, because of the grace given me by God
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written more boldly to you on some points, as reminding you, because of the grace given to me by God,
verses.textEnNlt: Even so, I have been bold enough to write about some of these points, knowing that all you need is this reminder. For by God’s grace,
verses.textEnNasb: But I have written very boldly to you on some points so as to remind you again, because of the grace that was given to me from God,
verses.textEn: Yet I have written you quite boldly on some points to remind you of them again, because of the grace God gave me

verses.textZh: 为外族人作了基督耶稣的仆役，作了神福音的祭司，使所献上的外族人得蒙悦纳，靠着圣灵成为圣洁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 为外族人作了基督耶稣的仆役，作了神福音的祭司，使所献上的外族人得蒙悦纳，靠着圣灵成为圣洁。
verses.textZhCuv: 使我为外邦人作基督耶稣的仆役，作神福音的祭司，叫所献上的外邦人，因着圣灵成为圣洁，可蒙悦纳。
verses.textEnNiv: to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles. He gave me the priestly duty of proclaiming the gospel of God, so that the Gentiles might become an offering acceptable to God, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnEsv: to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles in the priestly service of the gospel of God, so that the offering of the Gentiles may be acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNkjv: that I might be a minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering of the Gentiles might be acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNlt: I am a special messenger from Christ Jesus to you Gentiles. I bring you the Good News so that I might present you as an acceptable offering to God, made holy by the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, ministering as a priest the gospel of God, so that my offering of the Gentiles may become acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEn: to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles. He gave me the priestly duty of proclaiming the gospel of God, so that the Gentiles might become an offering acceptable to God, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

verses.textZh: 所以，在神的事上，我在基督耶稣里倒有可以引以为荣的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，在神的事上，我在基督耶稣里倒有可以引以为荣的。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以论到神的事，我在基督耶稣里有可夸的。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I glory in Christ Jesus in my service to God.
verses.textEnEsv: In Christ Jesus, then, I have reason to be proud of my work for God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I have reason to glory in Christ Jesus in the things whichpertain to God.
verses.textEnNlt: So I have reason to be enthusiastic about all Christ Jesus has done through me in my service to God.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore in Christ Jesus I have found reason for boasting in things pertaining to God.
verses.textEn: Therefore I glory in Christ Jesus in my service to God.

verses.textZh: 我立定主意，不在宣扬过基督的地方传福音，免得建立在别人的根基上，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我立定主意，不在宣扬过基督的地方传福音，免得建立在别人的根基上，
verses.textZhCuv: 除了基督藉我做的那些事，我什么都不敢提，只提他藉我言语作为，用神迹奇事的能力，并圣灵的能力，使外邦人顺服；
verses.textEnNiv: I will not venture to speak of anything except what Christ has accomplished through me in leading the Gentiles to obey God by what I have said and done—
verses.textEnEsv: For I will not venture to speak of anything except what Christ has accomplished through me to bring the Gentiles to obedience—by word and deed,
verses.textEnNkjv: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ has not accomplished through me, in word and deed, to make the Gentiles obedient—
verses.textEnNlt: Yet I dare not boast about anything except what Christ has done through me, bringing the Gentiles to God by my message and by the way I worked among them.
verses.textEnNasb: For I will not presume to speak of anything except what Christ has accomplished through me, resulting in the obedience of the Gentiles by word and deed,
verses.textEn: I will not venture to speak of anything except what Christ has accomplished through me in leading the Gentiles to obey God by what I have said and done—

verses.textZh: 反而照经上所记： "那对他一无所闻的，将要看见； 那没有听过的，将要明白。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 反而照经上所记： "那对他一无所闻的，将要看见； 那没有听过的，将要明白。"
verses.textZhCuv: 甚至我从耶路撒冷，直转到以利哩古，到处传了基督的福音。
verses.textEnNiv: by the power of signs and wonders, through the power of the Spirit of God. So from Jerusalem all the way around to Illyricum, I have fully proclaimed the gospel of Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: by the power of signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God—so that from Jerusalem and all the way around to Illyricum I have fulfilled the ministry of the gospel of Christ;
verses.textEnNkjv: in mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God, so that from Jerusalem and round about to Illyricum I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: They were convinced by the power of miraculous signs and wonders and by the power of God’s Spirit. In this way, I have fully presented the Good News of Christ from Jerusalem all the way to Illyricum.
verses.textEnNasb: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of the Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and all around as far as Illyricum I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.
verses.textEn: by the power of signs and wonders, through the power of the Spirit of God. So from Jerusalem all the way around to Illyricum, I have fully proclaimed the gospel of Christ.

verses.textZh: 因此，我多次受到拦阻，不能到你们那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，我多次受到拦阻，不能到你们那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我立了志向，不在基督的名被称过的地方传福音，免得建造在别人的根基上。
verses.textEnNiv: It has always been my ambition to preach the gospel where Christ was not known, so that I would not be building on someone else’s foundation.
verses.textEnEsv: and thus I make it my ambition to preach the gospel, not where Christ has already been named, lest I build on someone else’s foundation,
verses.textEnNkjv: And so I have made it my aim to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build on another man’s foundation,
verses.textEnNlt: My ambition has always been to preach the Good News where the name of Christ has never been heard, rather than where a church has already been started by someone else.
verses.textEnNasb: And in this way I aspired to preach the gospel, not where Christ was already known by name, so that I would not build on another person’s foundation;
verses.textEn: It has always been my ambition to preach the gospel where Christ was not known, so that I would not be building on someone else’s foundation.

verses.textZh: 但现在这一带再没有可传的地方，而我多年来又很想去见你们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 但现在这一带再没有可传的地方，而我多年来又很想去见你们，
verses.textZhCuv: 就如经上所记： 未曾闻知他信息的，将要看见； 未曾听过的，将要明白。
verses.textEnNiv: Rather, as it is written: "Those who were not told about him will see, and those who have not heard will understand."
verses.textEnEsv: but as it is written, "Those who have never been told of him will see, and those who have never heard will understand."
verses.textEnNkjv: but as it is written: "To whom He was not announced, they shall see; And those who have not heard shall understand."
verses.textEnNlt: I have been following the plan spoken of in the Scriptures, where it says, "Those who have never been told about him will see, and those who have never heard of him will understand."
verses.textEnNasb: but just as it is written: "They who have not been told about Him will see, And they who have not heard will understand."
verses.textEn: Rather, as it is written: "Those who were not told about him will see, and those who have not heard will understand."

verses.textZh: 所以，无论我甚么时候到西班牙去，都希望趁我路过时和你们见面，先稍微满足我的心愿，然后由你们给我送行到那里去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以，无论我甚么时候到西班牙去，都希望趁我路过时和你们见面，先稍微满足我的心愿，然后由你们给我送行到那里去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我因多次被拦阻，总不得到你们那里去。
verses.textEnNiv: This is why I have often been hindered from coming to you.
verses.textEnEsv: This is the reason why I have so often been hindered from coming to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this reason I also have been much hindered from coming to you.
verses.textEnNlt: In fact, my visit to you has been delayed so long because I have been preaching in these places.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason I have often been prevented from coming to you;
verses.textEn: This is why I have often been hindered from coming to you.

verses.textZh: 不过，我现在为了供应圣徒的事要往耶路撒冷去；
verses.textZhCnvs: 不过，我现在为了供应圣徒的事要往耶路撒冷去；
verses.textZhCuv: 但如今，在这里再没有可传的地方，而且这好几年，我切心想望到西班牙去的时候，可以到你们那里，
verses.textEnNiv: But now that there is no more place for me to work in these regions, and since I have been longing for many years to visit you,
verses.textEnEsv: But now, since I no longer have any room for work in these regions, and since I have longed for many years to come to you,
verses.textEnNkjv: But now no longer having a place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come to you,
verses.textEnNlt: But now I have finished my work in these regions, and after all these long years of waiting, I am eager to visit you.
verses.textEnNasb: but now, with no further place for me in these regions, and since I have had for many years a longing to come to you
verses.textEn: But now that there is no more place for me to work in these regions, and since I have been longing for many years to visit you,

verses.textZh: 因为马其顿和亚该亚人乐意捐了一些钱，给耶路撒冷圣徒中的穷人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为马其顿和亚该亚人乐意捐了一些钱，给耶路撒冷圣徒中的穷人。
verses.textZhCuv: 盼望从你们那里经过，得见你们，先与你们彼此交往，心里稍微满足，然后蒙你们送行。
verses.textEnNiv: I plan to do so when I go to Spain. I hope to see you while passing through and to have you assist me on my journey there, after I have enjoyed your company for a while.
verses.textEnEsv: I hope to see you in passing as I go to Spain, and to be helped on my journey there by you, once I have enjoyed your company for a while.
verses.textEnNkjv: whenever I journey to Spain, I shall come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.
verses.textEnNlt: I am planning to go to Spain, and when I do, I will stop off in Rome. And after I have enjoyed your fellowship for a little while, you can provide for my journey.
verses.textEnNasb: whenever I go to Spain—for I hope to see you in passing, and to be helped on my way there by you, when I have first enjoyed your company for a while—
verses.textEn: I plan to do so when I go to Spain. I hope to see you while passing through and to have you assist me on my journey there, after I have enjoyed your company for a while.

verses.textZh: 他们是乐意的，而且那也是他们的本分 ，因为外族人既然分享了犹太人属灵的好处，就应该供应他们肉身的需要。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们是乐意的，而且那也是他们的本分 ，因为外族人既然分享了犹太人属灵的好处，就应该供应他们肉身的需要。
verses.textZhCuv: 但现在，我往耶路撒冷去供给圣徒。
verses.textEnNiv: Now, however, I am on my way to Jerusalem in the service of the Lord’s people there.
verses.textEnEsv: At present, however, I am going to Jerusalem bringing aid to the saints.
verses.textEnNkjv: But now I am going to Jerusalem to minister to the saints.
verses.textEnNlt: But before I come, I must go to Jerusalem to take a gift to the believers there.
verses.textEnNasb: but now, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.
verses.textEn: Now, however, I am on my way to Jerusalem in the service of the Lord’s people there.

verses.textZh: 等我办好这件事，把这笔款项安全地交了给他们，我就要路过你们那里到西班牙去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 等我办好这件事，把这笔款项安全地交了给他们，我就要路过你们那里到西班牙去。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为马其顿和亚该亚人乐意凑出捐项给耶路撒冷圣徒中的穷人。
verses.textEnNiv: For Macedonia and Achaia were pleased to make a contribution for the poor among the Lord’s people in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: For Macedonia and Achaia have been pleased to make some contribution for the poor among the saints at Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: For it pleased those from Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: For you see, the believers in Macedonia and Achaia have eagerly taken up an offering for the poor among the believers in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: For Macedonia and Achaia have been pleased to make a contribution for the poor among the saints in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: For Macedonia and Achaia were pleased to make a contribution for the poor among the Lord’s people in Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 我知道我到你们那里去的时候，一定会带着基督丰盛的福分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我知道我到你们那里去的时候，一定会带着基督丰盛的福分。
verses.textZhCuv: 这固然是他们乐意的，其实也算是所欠的债；因外邦人既然在他们属灵的好处上有分，就当把养身之物供给他们。
verses.textEnNiv: They were pleased to do it, and indeed they owe it to them. For if the Gentiles have shared in the Jews’ spiritual blessings, they owe it to the Jews to share with them their material blessings.
verses.textEnEsv: For they were pleased to do it, and indeed they owe it to them. For if the Gentiles have come to share in their spiritual blessings, they ought also to be of service to them in material blessings.
verses.textEnNkjv: It pleased them indeed, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister to them in material things.
verses.textEnNlt: They were glad to do this because they feel they owe a real debt to them. Since the Gentiles received the spiritual blessings of the Good News from the believers in Jerusalem, they feel the least they can do in return is to help them financially.
verses.textEnNasb: For they were pleased to do so, and they are indebted to them. For if the Gentiles have shared in their spiritual things, they are indebted to do them a service also in material things.
verses.textEn: They were pleased to do it, and indeed they owe it to them. For if the Gentiles have shared in the Jews’ spiritual blessings, they owe it to the Jews to share with them their material blessings.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我靠着我们的主耶稣基督，凭着圣灵的慈爱，劝你们和我一同竭力为我向神祈祷，
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我靠着我们的主耶稣基督，凭着圣灵的慈爱，劝你们和我一同竭力为我向神祈祷，
verses.textZhCuv: 等我办完了这事，把这善果向他们交付明白，我就要路过你们那里，往西班牙去。
verses.textEnNiv: So after I have completed this task and have made sure that they have received this contribution, I will go to Spain and visit you on the way.
