verses.textEnEsv: When therefore I have completed this and have delivered to them what has been collected, I will leave for Spain by way of you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, when I have performed this and have sealed to them this fruit, I shall go by way of you to Spain.
verses.textEnNlt: As soon as I have delivered this money and completed this good deed of theirs, I will come to see you on my way to Spain.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, when I have finished this, and have put my seal on this fruit of theirs, I will go on by way of you to Spain.
verses.textEn: So after I have completed this task and have made sure that they have received this contribution, I will go to Spain and visit you on the way.

verses.textZh: 求神救我脱离犹太地不信从的人，使我带到耶路撒冷的捐款，可以得到圣徒的悦纳；
verses.textZhCnvs: 求神救我脱离犹太地不信从的人，使我带到耶路撒冷的捐款，可以得到圣徒的悦纳；
verses.textZhCuv: 我也晓得，去的时候必带着基督丰盛的恩典而去。
verses.textEnNiv: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the full measure of the blessing of Christ.
verses.textEnEsv: I know that when I come to you I will come in the fullness of the blessing of Christ.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I know that when I come to you, I shall come in the fullness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: And I am sure that when I come, Christ will richly bless our time together.
verses.textEnNasb: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of Christ.
verses.textEn: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the full measure of the blessing of Christ.

verses.textZh: 也使我照着神的旨意，高高兴兴地到你们那里去，好和你们一同得到安息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也使我照着神的旨意，高高兴兴地到你们那里去，好和你们一同得到安息。
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，我藉着我们主耶稣基督，又藉着圣灵的爱，劝你们与我一同竭力，为我祈求神，
verses.textEnNiv: I urge you, brothers and sisters, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, to join me in my struggle by praying to God for me.
verses.textEnEsv: I appeal to you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, to strive together with me in your prayers to God on my behalf,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I beg you, brethren, through the Lord Jesus Christ, and through the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in prayers to God for me,
verses.textEnNlt: Dear brothers and sisters, I urge you in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to join in my struggle by praying to God for me. Do this because of your love for me, given to you by the Holy Spirit.
verses.textEnNasb: Now I urge you, brothers and sisters, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, to strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,
verses.textEn: I urge you, brothers and sisters, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, to join me in my struggle by praying to God for me.

verses.textZh: 愿赐平安的神与你们众人同在。阿们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿赐平安的神与你们众人同在。阿们。
verses.textZhCuv: 叫我脱离在犹太不顺从的人，也叫我为耶路撒冷所办的捐项可蒙圣徒悦纳，
verses.textEnNiv: Pray that I may be kept safe from the unbelievers in Judea and that the contribution I take to Jerusalem may be favorably received by the Lord’s people there,
verses.textEnEsv: that I may be delivered from the unbelievers in Judea, and that my service for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,
verses.textEnNkjv: that I may be delivered from those in Judea who do not believe, and that my service for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,
verses.textEnNlt: Pray that I will be rescued from those in Judea who refuse to obey God. Pray also that the believers there will be willing to accept the donation I am taking to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: that I may be rescued from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service for Jerusalem may prove acceptable to the saints;
verses.textEn: Pray that I may be kept safe from the unbelievers in Judea and that the contribution I take to Jerusalem may be favorably received by the Lord’s people there,

verses.textZh: 并叫我顺着神的旨意，欢欢喜喜地到你们那里，与你们同得安息。
verses.textZhCnvs: 并叫我顺着神的旨意，欢欢喜喜地到你们那里，与你们同得安息。
verses.textZhCuv: 并叫我顺着神的旨意，欢欢喜喜地到你们那里，与你们同得安息。
verses.textEnNiv: so that I may come to you with joy, by God’s will, and in your company be refreshed.
verses.textEnEsv: so that by God’s will I may come to you with joy and be refreshed in your company.
verses.textEnNkjv: that I may come to you with joy by the will of God, and may be refreshed together with you.
verses.textEnNlt: Then, by the will of God, I will be able to come to you with a joyful heart, and we will be an encouragement to each other.
verses.textEnNasb: so that I may come to you in joy by the will of God and relax in your company.
verses.textEn: so that I may come to you with joy, by God’s will, and in your company be refreshed.

verses.textZh: 愿赐平安的神常和你们众人同在。阿们！
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿赐平安的神常和你们众人同在。阿们！
verses.textZhCuv: 愿赐平安的神常和你们众人同在。阿们！
verses.textEnNiv: The God of peace be with you all. Amen.
verses.textEnEsv: May the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: And now may God, who gives us his peace, be with you all. Amen.
verses.textEnNasb: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
verses.textEn: The God of peace be with you all. Amen.

verses.textZh: 我向你们推荐我们的姊妹非比；她是坚革里教会的执事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我向你们推荐我们的姊妹非比；她是坚革里教会的执事。
verses.textZhCuv: 我对你们举荐我们的姊妹非比；她是坚革哩教会中的女执事。
verses.textEnNiv: I commend to you our sister Phoebe, a deacon of the church in Cenchreae.
verses.textEnEsv: I commend to you our sister Phoebe, a servant of the church at Cenchreae,
verses.textEnNkjv: I commend to you Phoebe our sister, who is a servant of the church in Cenchrea,
verses.textEnNlt: I commend to you our sister Phoebe, who is a deacon in the church in Cenchrea.
verses.textEnNasb: I recommend to you our sister Phoebe, who is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea,
verses.textEn: I commend to you our sister Phoebe, a deacon of the church in Cenchreae.

verses.textZh: 请你们在主里用合乎圣徒身分的态度去接待她。无论她在甚么事上有需要，请你们都帮助她；因为她曾经帮助许多人，也帮助了我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 请你们在主里用合乎圣徒身分的态度去接待她。无论她在甚么事上有需要，请你们都帮助她；因为她曾经帮助许多人，也帮助了我。
verses.textZhCuv: 请你们为主接待她，合乎圣徒的体统。她在何事上要你们帮助，你们就帮助她；因她素来帮助许多人，也帮助了我。
verses.textEnNiv: I ask you to receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of his people and to give her any help she may need from you, for she has been the benefactor of many people, including me.
verses.textEnEsv: that you may welcome her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and help her in whatever she may need from you, for she has been a patron of many and of myself as well.
verses.textEnNkjv: that you may receive her in the Lord in a manner worthy of the saints, and assist her in whatever business she has need of you; for indeed she has been a helper of many and of myself also.
verses.textEnNlt: Welcome her in the Lord as one who is worthy of honor among God’s people. Help her in whatever she needs, for she has been helpful to many, and especially to me.
verses.textEnNasb: that you receive her in the Lord in a manner worthy of the saints, and that you help her in whatever matter she may have need of you; for she herself has also been a helper of many, and of myself as well.
verses.textEn: I ask you to receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of his people and to give her any help she may need from you, for she has been the benefactor of many people, including me.

verses.textZh: 问候在基督耶稣里与我同工的百基拉和亚居拉；
verses.textZhCnvs: 问候在基督耶稣里与我同工的百基拉和亚居拉；
verses.textZhCuv: 问百基拉和亚居拉安。他们在基督耶稣里与我同工，
verses.textEnNiv: Greet Priscilla and Aquila, my co-workers in Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnEsv: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
verses.textEnNkjv: Greet Priscilla and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
verses.textEnNlt: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila, my co-workers in the ministry of Christ Jesus.
verses.textEnNasb: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,
verses.textEn: Greet Priscilla and Aquila, my co-workers in Christ Jesus.

verses.textZh: 他们为了我的性命，置生死于度外，不但我感激他们，连外族的众教会也感激他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们为了我的性命，置生死于度外，不但我感激他们，连外族的众教会也感激他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 也为我的命将自己的颈项置之度外。不但我感谢他们，就是外邦的众教会也感谢他们。
verses.textEnNiv: They risked their lives for me. Not only I but all the churches of the Gentiles are grateful to them.
verses.textEnEsv: who risked their necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks but all the churches of the Gentiles give thanks as well.
verses.textEnNkjv: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.
verses.textEnNlt: In fact, they once risked their lives for me. I am thankful to them, and so are all the Gentile churches.
verses.textEnNasb: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only do I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles;
verses.textEn: They risked their lives for me. Not only I but all the churches of the Gentiles are grateful to them.

verses.textZh: 也问候他们家里的教会。问候我亲爱的以拜尼妥，他是亚西亚省初结的果子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也问候他们家里的教会。问候我亲爱的以拜尼妥，他是亚西亚省初结的果子。
verses.textZhCuv: 又问在他们家中的教会安。问我所亲爱的以拜尼土安；他在亚细亚是归基督初结的果子。
verses.textEnNiv: Greet also the church that meets at their house. Greet my dear friend Epenetus, who was the first convert to Christ in the province of Asia.
verses.textEnEsv: Greet also the church in their house. Greet my beloved Epaenetus, who was the first convert to Christ in Asia.
verses.textEnNkjv: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Greet my beloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia to Christ.
verses.textEnNlt: Also give my greetings to the church that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epenetus. He was the first person from the province of Asia to become a follower of Christ.
verses.textEnNasb: also greet the church that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first convert to Christ from Asia.
verses.textEn: Greet also the church that meets at their house. Greet my dear friend Epenetus, who was the first convert to Christ in the province of Asia.

verses.textZh: 问候马利亚，她为你们多多劳苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 问候马利亚，她为你们多多劳苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 又问马利亚安；她为你们多受劳苦。
verses.textEnNiv: Greet Mary, who worked very hard for you.
verses.textEnEsv: Greet Mary, who has worked hard for you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.
verses.textEnNlt: Give my greetings to Mary, who has worked so hard for your benefit.
verses.textEnNasb: Greet Mary, who has worked hard for you.
verses.textEn: Greet Mary, who worked very hard for you.

verses.textZh: 问候曾经与我一同被囚的亲族安多尼古和犹尼亚；他们在使徒中是有名望的，也比我先在基督里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 问候曾经与我一同被囚的亲族安多尼古和犹尼亚；他们在使徒中是有名望的，也比我先在基督里。
verses.textZhCuv: 又问我亲属与我一同坐监的安多尼古和犹尼亚安；他们在使徒中是有名望的，也是比我先在基督里。
verses.textEnNiv: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my fellow Jews who have been in prison with me. They are outstanding among the apostles, and they were in Christ before I was.
verses.textEnEsv: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen and my fellow prisoners. They are well known to the apostles, and they were in Christ before me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my countrymen and my fellow prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.
verses.textEnNlt: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my fellow Jews, who were in prison with me. They are highly respected among the apostles and became followers of Christ before I did.
verses.textEnNasb: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my kinsfolk and my fellow prisoners, who are outstanding in the view of the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.
verses.textEn: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my fellow Jews who have been in prison with me. They are outstanding among the apostles, and they were in Christ before I was.

verses.textZh: 问候在主里我亲爱的暗伯利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 问候在主里我亲爱的暗伯利。
verses.textZhCuv: 又问我在主里面所亲爱的暗伯利安。
verses.textEnNiv: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend in the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: Greet Ampliatus, my beloved in the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend in the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: Greet Ampliatus, my beloved in the Lord.
verses.textEn: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend in the Lord.

verses.textZh: 问候在基督里与我们同工的珥巴努和我亲爱的士达古。
verses.textZhCnvs: 问候在基督里与我们同工的珥巴努和我亲爱的士达古。
verses.textZhCuv: 又问在基督里与我们同工的耳巴奴，并我所亲爱的士大古安。
verses.textEnNiv: Greet Urbanus, our co-worker in Christ, and my dear friend Stachys.
verses.textEnEsv: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and my beloved Stachys.
verses.textEnNkjv: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.
verses.textEnNlt: Greet Urbanus, our co-worker in Christ, and my dear friend Stachys.
verses.textEnNasb: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.
verses.textEn: Greet Urbanus, our co-worker in Christ, and my dear friend Stachys.

verses.textZh: 问候在基督里蒙称许的亚比利。问候亚里斯多博家里的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 问候在基督里蒙称许的亚比利。问候亚里斯多博家里的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 又问在基督里经过试验的亚比利安。问亚利多布家里的人安。
verses.textEnNiv: Greet Apelles, whose fidelity to Christ has stood the test. Greet those who belong to the household of Aristobulus.
verses.textEnEsv: Greet Apelles, who is approved in Christ. Greet those who belong to the family of Aristobulus.
verses.textEnNkjv: Greet Apelles, approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.
verses.textEnNlt: Greet Apelles, a good man whom Christ approves. And give my greetings to the believers from the household of Aristobulus.
verses.textEnNasb: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.
verses.textEn: Greet Apelles, whose fidelity to Christ has stood the test. Greet those who belong to the household of Aristobulus.

verses.textZh: 问候我的亲族希罗天。问候拿其舒家中在主里的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 问候我的亲族希罗天。问候拿其舒家中在主里的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 又问我亲属希罗天安。问拿其数家在主里的人安。
verses.textEnNiv: Greet Herodion, my fellow Jew. Greet those in the household of Narcissus who are in the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: Greet my kinsman Herodion. Greet those in the Lord who belong to the family of Narcissus.
verses.textEnNkjv: Greet Herodion, my countryman. Greet those who are of the household of Narcissus who are in the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Greet Herodion, my fellow Jew. Greet the Lord’s people from the household of Narcissus.
verses.textEnNasb: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet those of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.
verses.textEn: Greet Herodion, my fellow Jew. Greet those in the household of Narcissus who are in the Lord.

verses.textZh: 问候在主里劳苦的土非拿和土富撒。问候亲爱的彼息；她在主里多多劳苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 问候在主里劳苦的土非拿和土富撒。问候亲爱的彼息；她在主里多多劳苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 又问为主劳苦的土非拿氏和土富撒氏安。问可亲爱为主多受劳苦的彼息氏安。
verses.textEnNiv: Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa, those women who work hard in the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis, another woman who has worked very hard in the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: Greet those workers in the Lord, Tryphaena and Tryphosa. Greet the beloved Persis, who has worked hard in the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa, who have labored in the Lord. Greet the beloved Persis, who labored much in the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: Give my greetings to Tryphena and Tryphosa, the Lord’s workers, and to dear Persis, who has worked so hard for the Lord.
verses.textEnNasb: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, workers in the Lord. Greet Persis the beloved, who has worked hard in the Lord.
verses.textEn: Greet Tryphena and Tryphosa, those women who work hard in the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis, another woman who has worked very hard in the Lord.

verses.textZh: 问候在主里蒙拣选的鲁孚和他的母亲；她也是我在主里的母亲。
verses.textZhCnvs: 问候在主里蒙拣选的鲁孚和他的母亲；她也是我在主里的母亲。
verses.textZhCuv: 又问在主蒙拣选的鲁孚和他母亲安；他的母亲就是我的母亲。
verses.textEnNiv: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and his mother, who has been a mother to me, too.
verses.textEnEsv: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord; also his mother, who has been a mother to me as well.
verses.textEnNkjv: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
verses.textEnNlt: Greet Rufus, whom the Lord picked out to be his very own; and also his dear mother, who has been a mother to me.
verses.textEnNasb: Greet Rufus, a choice man in the Lord, also his mother and mine.
verses.textEn: Greet Rufus, chosen in the Lord, and his mother, who has been a mother to me, too.

verses.textZh: 问候亚逊其都、弗勒干、赫米、百罗巴、赫马，以及和他们在一起的弟兄们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 问候亚逊其都、弗勒干、赫米、百罗巴、赫马，以及和他们在一起的弟兄们。
verses.textZhCuv: 又问亚逊其土、弗勒干、黑米、八罗巴、黑马，并与他们在一处的弟兄们安。
verses.textEnNiv: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas and the other brothers and sisters with them.
verses.textEnEsv: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren who are with them.
verses.textEnNlt: Give my greetings to Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers and sisters who meet with them.
verses.textEnNasb: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers and sisters with them.
verses.textEn: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas and the other brothers and sisters with them.

verses.textZh: 问候非罗罗哥和犹利亚，尼利亚与他的姊妹和阿林巴，以及同他们在一起的众圣徒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 问候非罗罗哥和犹利亚，尼利亚与他的姊妹和阿林巴，以及同他们在一起的众圣徒。
verses.textZhCuv: 又问非罗罗古和犹利亚，尼利亚和他姊妹，同阿林巴并与他们在一处的众圣徒安。
verses.textEnNiv: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas and all the Lord’s people who are with them.
verses.textEnEsv: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.
verses.textEnNlt: Give my greetings to Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and to Olympas and all the believers who meet with them.
verses.textEnNasb: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.
verses.textEn: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas and all the Lord’s people who are with them.

verses.textZh: 你们要用圣洁的亲吻彼此问安。基督的众教会都问候你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们要用圣洁的亲吻彼此问安。基督的众教会都问候你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们亲嘴问安，彼此务要圣洁。基督的众教会都问你们安。
verses.textEnNiv: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ send greetings.
verses.textEnEsv: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ greet you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The churches of Christ greet you.
verses.textEnNlt: Greet each other with a sacred kiss. All the churches of Christ send you their greetings.
verses.textEnNasb: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ greet you.
verses.textEn: Greet one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ send greetings.

verses.textZh: 弟兄们，我劝你们要提防那些离间你们、绊倒你们、使你们违反你们所学的教义的人。你们也要避开他们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 弟兄们，我劝你们要提防那些离间你们、绊倒你们、使你们违反你们所学的教义的人。你们也要避开他们，
verses.textZhCuv: 弟兄们，那些离间你们、叫你们跌倒、背乎所学之道的人，我劝你们要留意躲避他们。
verses.textEnNiv: I urge you, brothers and sisters, to watch out for those who cause divisions and put obstacles in your way that are contrary to the teaching you have learned. Keep away from them.
verses.textEnEsv: I appeal to you, brothers, to watch out for those who cause divisions and create obstacles contrary to the doctrine that you have been taught; avoid them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I urge you, brethren, note those who cause divisions and offenses, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and avoid them.
verses.textEnNlt: And now I make one more appeal, my dear brothers and sisters. Watch out for people who cause divisions and upset people’s faith by teaching things contrary to what you have been taught. Stay away from them.
verses.textEnNasb: Now I urge you, brothers and sisters, keep your eye on those who cause dissensions and hindrances contrary to the teaching which you learned, and turn away from them.
verses.textEn: I urge you, brothers and sisters, to watch out for those who cause divisions and put obstacles in your way that are contrary to the teaching you have learned. Keep away from them.

verses.textZh: 因为这样的人不服事我们的主基督，只服事自己的肚腹，用花言巧语欺骗老实人的心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为这样的人不服事我们的主基督，只服事自己的肚腹，用花言巧语欺骗老实人的心。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为这样的人不服事我们的主基督，只服事自己的肚腹，用花言巧语诱惑那些老实人的心。
verses.textEnNiv: For such people are not serving our Lord Christ, but their own appetites. By smooth talk and flattery they deceive the minds of naive people.
verses.textEnEsv: For such persons do not serve our Lord Christ, but their own appetites, and by smooth talk and flattery they deceive the hearts of the naive.
verses.textEnNkjv: For those who are such do not serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly, and by smooth words and flattering speech deceive the hearts of the simple.
verses.textEnNlt: Such people are not serving Christ our Lord; they are serving their own personal interests. By smooth talk and glowing words they deceive innocent people.
verses.textEnNasb: For such people are slaves, not of our Lord Christ but of their own appetites; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the unsuspecting.
verses.textEn: For such people are not serving our Lord Christ, but their own appetites. By smooth talk and flattery they deceive the minds of naive people.

verses.textZh: 你们的顺服已经名闻各处，所以我为你们高兴。我愿你们在善事上有智慧，在恶事上毫不沾染。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们的顺服已经名闻各处，所以我为你们高兴。我愿你们在善事上有智慧，在恶事上毫不沾染。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们的顺服已经传于众人，所以我为你们欢喜；但我愿意你们在善上聪明，在恶上愚拙。
verses.textEnNiv: Everyone has heard about your obedience, so I rejoice because of you; but I want you to be wise about what is good, and innocent about what is evil.
verses.textEnEsv: For your obedience is known to all, so that I rejoice over you, but I want you to be wise as to what is good and innocent as to what is evil.
verses.textEnNkjv: For your obedience has become known to all. Therefore I am glad on your behalf; but I want you to be wise in what is good, and simple concerning evil.
verses.textEnNlt: But everyone knows that you are obedient to the Lord. This makes me very happy. I want you to be wise in doing right and to stay innocent of any wrong.
verses.textEnNasb: For the report of your obedience has reached everyone; therefore I am rejoicing over you, but I want you to be wise in what is good, and innocent in what is evil.
verses.textEn: Everyone has heard about your obedience, so I rejoice because of you; but I want you to be wise about what is good, and innocent about what is evil.

verses.textZh: 赐平安的神快要把撒但践踏在你们脚下。愿我们主耶稣的恩惠与你们同在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 赐平安的神快要把撒但践踏在你们脚下。愿我们主耶稣的恩惠与你们同在。
verses.textZhCuv: 赐平安的神快要将撒但践踏在你们脚下。愿我主耶稣基督的恩常和你们同在！
verses.textEnNiv: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus be with you.
verses.textEnEsv: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the God of peace will crush Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. May the grace of our Lord Jesus be with you.
verses.textEnNasb: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus be with you.
verses.textEn: The God of peace will soon crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus be with you.

verses.textZh: 我的同工提摩太和我的亲族路求、耶逊和所西巴德都问候你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的同工提摩太和我的亲族路求、耶逊和所西巴德都问候你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 与我同工的提摩太，和我的亲属路求、耶孙、所西巴德，问你们安。
verses.textEnNiv: Timothy, my co-worker, sends his greetings to you, as do Lucius, Jason and Sosipater, my fellow Jews.
verses.textEnEsv: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you; so do Lucius and Jason and Sosipater, my kinsmen.
verses.textEnNkjv: Timothy, my fellow worker, and Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my countrymen, greet you.
verses.textEnNlt: Timothy, my fellow worker, sends you his greetings, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my fellow Jews.
verses.textEnNasb: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, and so do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen.
verses.textEn: Timothy, my co-worker, sends his greetings to you, as do Lucius, Jason and Sosipater, my fellow Jews.

verses.textZh: 那接待我也接待全教会的该犹，问候你们。本城的司库以拉都和夸图弟兄问候你们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那接待我也接待全教会的该犹，问候你们。本城的司库以拉都和夸图弟兄问候你们。
verses.textZhCuv: 我这代笔写信的德提，在主里面问你们安。
verses.textEnNiv: I, Tertius, who wrote down this letter, greet you in the Lord.
verses.textEnEsv: I Tertius, who wrote this letter, greet you in the Lord.
verses.textEnNkjv: I, Tertius, who wrote this epistle, greet you in the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: I, Tertius, the one writing this letter for Paul, send my greetings, too, as one of the Lord’s followers.
verses.textEnNasb: I, Tertius, who have written this letter, greet you in the Lord.
verses.textEn: I, Tertius, who wrote down this letter, greet you in the Lord.

verses.textZh: 神能依照我所传的福音和耶稣基督所传的信息，照着他奥秘的启示，坚定你们。这奥秘自古以来秘而不宣，
verses.textZhCnvs: 神能依照我所传的福音和耶稣基督所传的信息，照着他奥秘的启示，坚定你们。这奥秘自古以来秘而不宣，
verses.textZhCuv: 那接待我、也接待全教会的该犹问你们安。
verses.textEnNiv: Gaius, whose hospitality I and the whole church here enjoy, sends you his greetings. Erastus, who is the city’s director of public works, and our brother Quartus send you their greetings.
verses.textEnEsv: Gaius, who is host to me and to the whole church, greets you. Erastus, the city treasurer, and our brother Quartus, greet you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Gaius, my host and thehost of the whole church, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, and Quartus, a brother.
verses.textEnNlt: Gaius says hello to you. He is my host and also serves as host to the whole church. Erastus, the city treasurer, sends you his greetings, and so does our brother Quartus.
verses.textEnNasb: Gaius, host to me and to the whole church, greets you. Erastus, the city treasurer, greets you, and Quartus, the brother.
verses.textEn: Gaius, whose hospitality I and the whole church here enjoy, sends you his greetings. Erastus, who is the city’s director of public works, and our brother Quartus send you their greetings.

verses.textZh: 但现在借着众先知所写的，照着永恒的神的谕旨，已经向万国显明出来，使他们相信而顺服。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但现在借着众先知所写的，照着永恒的神的谕旨，已经向万国显明出来，使他们相信而顺服。
verses.textZhCuv: 城内管银库的以拉都和兄弟括土问你们安。
verses.textEnNiv: Now to him who is able to establish you in accordance with my gospel, the message I proclaim about Jesus Christ, in keeping with the revelation of the mystery hidden for long ages past,
verses.textEnEsv: Now to him who is able to strengthen you according to my gospel and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery that was kept secret for long ages
verses.textEnNkjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verses.textEnNlt: Now all glory to God, who is able to make you strong, just as my Good News says. This message about Jesus Christ has revealed his plan for you Gentiles, a plan kept secret from the beginning of time.
verses.textEnNasb: Now to Him who is able to establish you according to my gospel and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which has been kept secret for long ages past,
verses.textEn: Now to him who is able to establish you in accordance with my gospel, the message I proclaim about Jesus Christ, in keeping with the revelation of the mystery hidden for long ages past,

verses.textZh: 愿荣耀借着耶稣基督，归给独一全智的神，直到永远。阿们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿荣耀借着耶稣基督，归给独一全智的神，直到永远。阿们。
verses.textZhCuv: 惟有神能照我所传的福音和所讲的耶稣基督，并照永古隐藏不言的奥秘，坚固你们的心。
verses.textEnNiv: but now revealed and made known through the prophetic writings by the command of the eternal God, so that all the Gentiles might come to the obedience that comes from faith—
verses.textEnEsv: but has now been disclosed and through the prophetic writings has been made known to all nations, according to the command of the eternal God, to bring about the obedience of faith—
verses.textEnNkjv: Now to Him who is able to establish you according to my gospel and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery kept secret since the world began
verses.textEnNlt: But now as the prophets foretold and as the eternal God has commanded, this message is made known to all Gentiles everywhere, so that they too might believe and obey him.
verses.textEnNasb: but now has been disclosed, and through the Scriptures of the prophets, in accordance with the commandment of the eternal God, has been made known to all the nations, leading to obedience of faith;
verses.textEn: but now revealed and made known through the prophetic writings by the command of the eternal God, so that all the Gentiles might come to the obedience that comes from faith—

verses.textZh: 这奥秘如今显明出来，而且按着永生神的命，藉众先知的书指示万国的民，使他们信服真道。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这奥秘如今显明出来，而且按着永生神的命，藉众先知的书指示万国的民，使他们信服真道。
verses.textZhCuv: 这奥秘如今显明出来，而且按着永生神的命，藉众先知的书指示万国的民，使他们信服真道。
verses.textEnNiv: to the only wise God be glory forever through Jesus Christ! Amen.
verses.textEnEsv: to the only wise God be glory forevermore through Jesus Christ! Amen.
verses.textEnNkjv: but now made manifest, and by the prophetic Scriptures made known to all nations, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, for obedience to the faith—
verses.textEnNlt: All glory to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, forever. Amen.
verses.textEnNasb: to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, be the glory forever. Amen.
verses.textEn: to the only wise God be glory forever through Jesus Christ! Amen.

verses.textZh: 愿荣耀，因耶稣基督，归与独一全智的神，直到永远。阿们！
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿荣耀，因耶稣基督，归与独一全智的神，直到永远。阿们！
verses.textZhCuv: 愿荣耀，因耶稣基督，归与独一全智的神，直到永远。阿们！
verses.textEnNkjv: to God, alone wise, be glory through Jesus Christ forever. Amen.
